DOTA_Tooltip_ability_zuus_static_field_a: Static Field is associated to this ability and doesn't affect abilities other than Zeus'.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_zuus_livewire_Descrip: Static Field deals more damage to nearby enemies.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_zuus_divine_rampage_D: When Thundergod's Wrath kills an enemy, it deals more damage to the other enemies.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_zuus_thundergods_wr: Strikes all enemy heroes with a bolt of lightning, dealing damage no matter where they may be. Provides True Sight around each hero before they are struck.
Damage is dealt to one enemy at a time, moving from lowest health hero to highest. If an enemy is killed by this ability, the damage for all subsequent enemies is increased.
The Lord of Heaven smites all who oppose him, near or far.
Nimbus requires Lightning Bolt to be drafted for damage.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_zuus_cloud_Descript: Creates a storm cloud anywhere on the map that automatically casts Lightning Bolt on nearby enemies.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_zuus_cloud_Note0: Grants %cloud_bounty_tooltip% gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_zuus_cloud_Note1: Affects the closest enemy unit with strikes from Zeus's current level of Lightning Bolt.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_zuus_cloud_Note2: Towers and creeps do half damage to the Nimbus.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_zuus_cloud_lore: Where the thunder god's ire grows, storm clouds quickly gather.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_zuus_heavenly_jump_: Zeus performs a Heavenly Jump, leaping forward and shocking the closest visible nearby enemy (prioritizing heroes), dealing damage as well as reducing their movement and attack speed. Zeus gets %vision_radius% unobstructed vision around him for 3 seconds.
Though temporarily barred from the heavens, Zeus can still manage a measure of godly flight.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_zuus_static_field_: Whenever Zeus attacks or hits an enemy with an ability they are shocked for a percent of their current HP.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_zuus_lightning_hand: Zeus gains bonus attack speed and his attacks create Arc Lightnings that deal a percentage of its damage. Can be toggled off to stop this effect.
A helping hand from Aghanim lets the fallen Lord of Heaven tap into some of his old strengths.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_tiny_avalanche_Desc: Bombards an area with rocks, continously doing small intervals of damage and stun to enemy units.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_tiny_avalanche_Lore: Inanimate rock becomes animate when called by the Stone Giant.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_tiny_craggy_exterio: Enemies that attack Tiny receive a stacking debuff that lowers their attack damage with each stack.
Break disables the application of new stacks.
Break does not disable the effects of existing stacks.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_tiny_toss_Descripti: Grabs the nearest unit in a %grab_radius% radius around Tiny, ally or enemy, and launches it at the target unit or rune to deal damage where they land.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_tiny_grow_Descripti: Tiny gains craggy mass, increasing his attack damage, movement speed and armor, and toss power while slowing his attack speed.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_tiny_grow_Lore: Watching a hill become a mountain is awe-inspiring - especially if the mountain begins laying waste to adversaries.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_tiny_grow_shard_Des: Units tossed by Toss or trees tossed by Tree Throw or Tree Volley now deal additional damage and slow in a larger area of effect at their landing location.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_tiny_toss_Lore: Tiny's gargantuan stature allows him to catapult even the sturdiest of warriors.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_tiny_toss_Note0: You can toss allies, but they don't take damage.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_tiny_toss_Note1: Toss deals 33% of its damage to buildings.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_tiny_toss_Note2: Debuff Immune units can be targeted but cannot be tossed.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_tiny_tree_grab_lore: Sticks and stones break all the bones, with structures sure to follow.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_tiny_tree_grab_Desc: Grabs a tree and causes Tiny to have bonus range, damage, and a splashing attack for a limited number of attacks.  The tree can be thrown, to deal your attack to a unit at a distance.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_tiny_tree_grab_Note: The cooldown begins when the tree is thrown.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_tiny_toss_tree_Desc: Throws the tree at the target unit, proccing your attack on it and splashing damage around the target.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_tiny_toss_tree_Lore: Even enemies can share in Tiny's arbor ardor.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_tiny_tree_channel_D: CHANNELED - Tiny channels to throw random trees within range towards the targeted area. Deals Tiny's attack with Tree Throw bonuses.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_tiny_tree_channel_L: Sticks thrown from stones are like to shatter many bones.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_tiny_craggy_exteri: Weapons blunted from attacking Tiny. Attack Damage reduced by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_DAMAGEOUTGOING_PERCENTAGE%%%.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_tiny_insurmountable: Tiny gains Status and Slow Resistance from Strength. Slow Resistance also reduces the impact of Attack Speed slows.
Insurmountable does not reduce the effect of Grow's Attack Speed Reduction.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_tiny_crash_landing_De: Tossed units slow and deal bonus damage to other targets at the Toss destination.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_tiny_tree_grab_Des: Attacks deal increased and splash damage, range increased by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_ATTACK_RANGE_BONUS%
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_tiny_tosstree_slow: Movement speed reduced by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_MOVESPEED_BONUS_PERCENTAGE%%% from tree trauma.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_tiny_toss_land_deb: Slowed by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_MOVESPEED_BONUS_PERCENTAGE%%%. Attack speed slow by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_ATTACKSPEED_BONUS_CONSTANT%.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_puck_illusory_orb_D:
Vector Targeted. Puck launches a magic orb that travels along the path, damaging enemy units along the way. The orb deals an additional %damage_over_time_pct%%% of its impact damage every %damage_interval%s in its area of effect, but if it exceeds the max cast range it will be destroyed. At any point, Puck may teleport to the orb's location using Ethereal Jaunt.

Can be put on alt-cast to launch the Orb straight ahead.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_puck_illusory_orb_a: For Ability Draft only, Illusory Orb ability swaps with Ethereal Jaunt while the orb is in flight.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_puck_illusory_orb_L: The playful Faerie Dragon delights in confusing others, vanishing and reappearing where unexpected.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_puck_illusory_orb_N: The Illusory Orb grants unobstructed vision around its location while it travels.
Jaunting to the Orb will disjoint projectiles.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_puck_waning_rift_De: Puck teleports to the target location and releases a burst of faerie dust that deals damage and silences enemy units nearby.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_puck_waning_rift_Fa: Waning Rift pushes enemies away. If the ability is in alt-cast state, it will pull them instead.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_puck_waning_rift_Lo: With a mischievous grin, Puck spreads its enchanted powder which disrupts magical flow.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_puck_jostling_rift_De: Waning Rift can push or pull targets.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_puck_curveball_Descri: Puck's Illusory Orb can be curved in any direction, moves faster, deals more damage and lasts longer.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_puck_phase_shift_De: CHANNELED - Puck briefly shifts into another dimension where it is immune from harm.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_puck_phase_shift_sh: Puck's attacks deal bonus magic damage. Puck attacks all enemies within its attack range every time it phase shifts.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_puck_phase_shift_Lo: With a quip and flash, Puck returns to the alien dimension from whence it came.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_puck_phase_shift_No: Puck retains collision size while under the effects of Phase Shift.
Issuing any action will cancel Phase Shift.
Puck is invulnerable during Phase Shift.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_puck_dream_coil_Des: Creates a coil of volatile magic that latches onto enemy Heroes, damaging and leashing them.  If the enemy hero stretches the coil by moving too far away, it snaps, stunning and dealing additional damage.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_puck_dream_coil_sce: All enemies affected by Dream Coil are attacked at a rate equal to %attack_rate_pct%%% of Puck's attack rate. The attacks continue while the target is stunned if they break the Dream Coil.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_puck_dream_coil_Lor: The Faerie Dragon sows confusion by forcing its enemies to vividly dream about their own mortality.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_puck_ethereal_jaunt: Teleports Puck to a flying Illusory Orb.
The Orb is an egg of potential, traveling along its own timeline.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_puck_coil_break_st: You snapped a Dream Coil! Stunned.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_puck_puckish_Descri: Whenever Puck disjoints an attack, it restores %mana_and_health_restore_pct%%% of its max health and mana. Dodging a targeted spell projectile restores %dodged_spell_multiplier%x that amount. Does not apply to attacks by Towers.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_dazzle_poison_touch: Releases a cone of poison that strikes multiple enemy units. Deals damage over time and slows the targets. Anytime the targets get attacked by Dazzle, the debuff duration is refreshed and slow is increased.
One of the few Dezun rites used for offensive purposes, the paralytic enchantment often proves useful.
The damage is not reduced by damage block abilities.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_dazzle_shallow_grav: An ally blessed with Shallow Grave, no matter how close to death, cannot die while under its protection. Healing on that ally is also amplified for the duration based on the hero's HP.
Only a seasoned acolyte of the Shadow can properly perform the rite of preventing death.
HP cannot go below 1 while under the effects of Shallow Grave, but Axe's Culling Blade will still kill the hero.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_dazzle_shadow_wave_: Sends out a bolt of power that arcs between allies, healing them while damaging any enemy units standing nearby.  Dazzle is always healed by Shadow Wave.
While it is a simplistic and routine rite among Shadow Priests, the Shadow Wave is also the most critical for success.
If enemies are near multiple allied units affected by Shadow Wave, they will take multiple instances of damage.

Shadow Wave can now target and bounce between enemies in addition to allies. When bouncing to an enemy, they will take damage and heal nearby allies equal to %scepter_heal_pct%%% of the normal healing and damage values. Dazzle will also perform an attack against any enemy that Shadow Wave bounces to.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_dazzle_innate_weave: Dazzle's abilities apply Weave to both allies and enemies they affect, increasing allied armor and reducing enemy armor. Multiple instances of this effect stack.
Applying Weave to an ally heals them for %ally_heal% per stack of Weave.
Weave applies %ally_multiplier%x stacks to allies. Weave amplifies incoming heals from Dazzle by %heal_amplification_pct%%% per stack.
His ethereal journey into the Nothl realm has allowed Dazzle to mend together the powers of light and dark, creating shifting waves of enchantments.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_dazzle_nothl_projec: Dazzle departs his body, traveling through the Nothl Realm as an invulnerable spirit that can cast spells, attack, and use items, leaving his body behind in the world with a visible tether. While active, Dazzle's basic abilities are empowered: Poison Touch hexes enemies, Shallow Grave heals upon expiration, and Shadow Wave has a shorter cooldown. The effect can be ended early, and Dazzle returns to the body at the end.
The allure of the Nothl Realm is intoxicating, but Dazzle never forgets his purpose for being there.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_dazzle_nothl_projec: When Dazzle's spirit is further than %leash_start% units from the body, the tether will begin to pull him back. The strength of the pull increases with distance.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_dazzle_nothl_projec: Nothl Projection can be cast while Dazzle is disabled. Increases healing done while in the Nothl Realm.
Ends Dazzle's sojourn in the Nothl Realm and returns his spirit to his body.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_dazzle_nothl_boon_D: Dazzle's overhealing is converted into a barrier. Weave is stronger on allies and amplifies incoming heals from Dazzle.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_dazzle_nothl_boon_N: Whenever Dazzle overheals himself or an ally, it grants that hero a physical damage barrier equal to the amount overhealed for %duration% seconds. If the overhealed target already has a larger barrier its duration will be refreshed instead.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_dazzle_poison_bloom_D: Dazzle can spread his Poison Touch when attacking enemies. Weave is stronger on enemies.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_dazzle_poison_bloom_N: Every {s:bonus_attacks_to_split} times Dazzle attacks a target affected by Poison Touch, the target takes a burst of additional damage and fires additional Poison Touch projectiles at nearby enemies. The number of additional units affected depends on the Poison Touch number of targets.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_dazzle_poison_touc: Taking damage over time with movement speed modified by %-dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_MOVESPEED_BONUS_PERCENTAGE%%%.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_dazzle_shallow_gra: Protected by Voodoo! You cannot be killed while under this effect!
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_dazzle_innate_weav: Armor modified by %fMODIFIER_PROPERTY_TOOLTIP%. Increases incoming heals from Dazzle.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_dazzle_nothl_proje: This body is an empty husk while Dazzle's soul explores the Nothl Realm.
The soul is severing from the body.
Invulnerable, will be pulled back to your body when straying too far away.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_rattletrap_battery_: Discharges high-powered shrapnel at random nearby enemy units, dealing minor magical damage and ministun.
Some of Rattletrap's contraptions don't quite work correctly, so detonating them proves useful as an offensive maneuver.
Remains active if Clockwerk is disabled.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_rattletrap_power_co:
Forms a ring of energized cogs around Clockwerk, trapping any units that are near. Enemies outside the trap that touch a cog are knocked back, losing health and mana. Once a cog has delivered a shock, it will power down. Damage is increased by %mana_burn_as_damage_pct%%% of the mana burned.

Cogs can be destroyed by enemy attacks, but Clockwerk can push them up to %projectile_distance% distance away with one hit. Clockwerk can move through the cogs freely, disabling them as he passes over.
One of Clockwerk's inventions of which he is most proud is the power cog - though it is sometimes despised by his allies.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_rattletrap_rocket_f: Fires a global range flare that explodes over a given area. Upon impact, enemies in the area take damage and are briefly slowed. Rocket flare provides vision over the impact area for %duration% seconds.
What started as a festive display has become a useful scouting and bombardment tool.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_rattletrap_hookshot: Fires a grappling device rapidly at the target location.  If the hook hits a unit, Clockwerk launches himself into the target, stunning and dealing damage to everyone in a %stun_radius% radius around the hit target. Any enemies Clockwerk collides with along the way are damaged and stunned.
If there's another allied hero within %radius_ally% of Hookshot's hit target, Clockwerk and all allies in the area receive bonus armor, while refunding a portion of Hookshot's cooldown and manacost.
A somewhat unwieldy device, the Hookshot sends the otherwise clunky Clockwerk armor flying through the air.
Hookshot will latch and take Clockwerk to allies, but not damage or disable them.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_rattletrap_overcloc:
Supercharges Clockwerks abilities:

Battery Assault: Increased radius and affects all enemies in its range.
Power Cogs: Radius increased, and Clockwerk's armor while near Power Cogs is increased.
Rocket Flares: Increased damage, vision and slow duration, and fire additional rockets to either side of the target.
Hookshot: Stun radius and duration increased.
Jetpack: Moves faster.

Clockwerk's movement and attack speed becomes slowed to a crawl after the duration runs out.
Rattletrap understands the limitations of his armor. Just as he understands the risks of pushing past them in times of need.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_rattletrap_jetpack_: Clockwerk activates a jetpack, gaining flying movement, flying vision, and bonus movement speed. Clockwerk has a severely-limited turn rate during this time and cannot attack. Jetpack can be toggled on and off for the duration of the buff.
Sure it's blown up over fourteen testing dummies, but at least they all flew!
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_rattletrap_expanded_a: Power Cogs form in a larger radius.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_rattletrap_hookup_Des: If there's another allied hero within {s:bonus_radius_ally} of Hookshot's hit target, Clockwerk and all allies in the area receive bonus armor, while refunding a portion of Hookshot's cooldown and manacost.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_rattletrap_junk_mail_: Clockwerk can consume Chainmails to permanently gain +{s:bonus_armor_per_chainmail} armor.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_rattletrap_battery: Doing periodic damage to nearby units.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_rattletrap_overclo:
Abilities are supercharged

Will become slowed after duration runs out.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_rattletrap_cog_imm: Debuff Immune while inside Power Cogs.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_rattletrap_overhea: Cooling down from Overclock. Movement and attack speed reduced.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_rattletrap_armor_po:
Clockwerk's outgoing damage increases by %damage_per_armor%%% per point of armor.

Clockwerk can consume Chainmails to permanently gain +%armor_per_chainmail% armor per Chainmail consumed. Can stack. Self-cast to consume.
Clockwerk can consume Chainmails to permanently gain +%armor_per_chainmail% armor per Chainmail consumed. Can stack. Self-cast to consume.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_rattletrap_junk_ma: Clockwerk's got Mail! Armor increased by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_PHYSICAL_ARMOR_BONUS%.
Number of Chainmails consumed for permanent bonus armor.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_lich_frost_nova_Des: Blasts the target enemy unit with damaging frost, dealing area damage and slowing movement and attack rates for %abilityduration% seconds.  The primary target receives both base and area damage.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_lich_frost_nova_Lor: Frost-mage Ethreain has not forgotten even the simplest of ice manipulation.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_lich_sinister_gaze_: CHANNELED - Hypnotizes an enemy unit, causing it to move towards a point between the two of you and drains a percentage of its current mana.
Sinister Gaze becomes an Area of Effect ability, affecting units within a radius of %aoe_scepter% in the target area. Sinister Gaze allows Lich to cast other abilities while channeling it.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_lich_frost_shield_D: Applies a magical frost shield around the target, reducing damage from attacks against it. While the shield is active, ice magic will affect nearby enemy units every %interval% seconds, dealing minor damage and slowing them.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_lich_frost_shield_F: Whenever an enemy dies under the effect of Frost Shield, its duration is increased.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_lich_frost_shield_L: First conceived of to protect him in his mortal years, the frost magic that Ethreain weaves around himself has only grown colder with time.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_lich_frost_shield_N: Spell-immune enemies are not affected by the damage or slow.
Frost Shield can be cast on buildings.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_lich_chain_frost_De: Releases an orb of frost that bounces between nearby enemy units up to %jumps% times, slowing and damaging each time it hits. Each bounce increases the damage for the subsequent bounces. Chain Frost lingers on its last target if it fails to bounce and can bounce again if new targets become available.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_lich_chain_frost_Fa: Chain Frost lingers on its last target if it fails to bounce and can bounce again if new targets become available.
Killing an enemy with Chain Frost increases the number of bounces.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_lich_chain_frost_Lo: Almost universally considered the ultimate in frost magic, Ethreain's orb of frozen death strikes fear into those who dare stand against him.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_lich_chain_frost_No: Chain Frost has a movement speed of %projectile_speed%.
Chain Frost doesn't bounce to Zombies.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_lich_growing_cold_Des: When an enemy is killed by Chain Frost or while under the effect of Frost Shield, the duration of these abilities is extended.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_lich_frostbound_Descr: Chain Frost lingers on its last target if it fails to bounce and can bounce again if new targets become available.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_lich_ritualist_Descri: Death Charge becomes an active ability once Chain Frost is leveled, and can be used to kill allied creeps and convert their health into mana for Lich.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_lich_cryophobia_Descr: Sinister Gaze applies a lingering effect to the target, causing it to take extra magic damage from Lich and amplify incoming movement slows.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_lich_chainfrost_fr: Frostbound. Chain Frost will continue its bounces if another target comes into range.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_lich_sinister_gaze: You've gazed at the Evil Eye and may take additional magic damage from Lich and receive more movement slows.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_lich_ice_spire_Desc:
Creates an Ice Spire at the target spot, slowing enemies around it. Can take %max_hero_attacks% hero hits or %max_creep_attacks% creep hits and when destroyed it will create a Frost Blast around it.

Chain Frost can be cast on the Spire and can bounce to the Spire and damage the spire by 1 hero attack if there are no other enemies in range.

Lich can cast Frost Shield on the Spire. Each Frost Shield tick will heal the spire by 1 hero attack.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_lich_ice_spire_Lore: The waters within the Black Pool remain liquid far below the point of freezing and immediately crystallize when removed.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_lich_death_charge_D:
Sacrifice an allied creep to convert its current health into mana for Lich and give Lich its experience bounty.

Begins the game on cooldown and with no charges.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_lich_death_charge_N: Sacrificed creeps count as denies and can give experience to enemy heroes. Lich's experience bounty and enemy heroes' deny experience are independent.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_lich_frostnova_slo: Movement speed slowed by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_MOVESPEED_BONUS_PERCENTAGE%%%, attack speed slowed by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_ATTACKSPEED_BONUS_CONSTANT%
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_lich_chainfrost_sl: Movement speed slowed by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_MOVESPEED_BONUS_PERCENTAGE%%%, attack speed slowed by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_ATTACKSPEED_BONUS_CONSTANT%
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_lich_sinister_gaze: You are helpless against Lich's Sinister Gaze!
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_lich_chain_frost_o: Will release a Chain Frost orb on death
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_tidehunter_gush_Des: Summons a gush of water to damage an enemy unit, reducing their movement speed and armor.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_tidehunter_gush_Lor: During his championship of the Sunken Isles, Leviathan gained mastery over the open sea.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_tidehunter_gush_sce: Gush becomes a ground targeted wave ability that affects enemy units in a line.  Decreases cooldown.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_tidehunter_kraken_s:
Thickens Tidehunter's hide to passively block a portion of any incoming physical attack damage. Reduced block amount versus creeps. The hide also removes negative status effects if the damage taken crosses a threshold.

Can be activated to double the block amount at the cost of %active_move_speed_penalty_pct%%% movement speed. Lasts %active_duration%s.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
Kraken Shell gains permanent Damage Block when an enemy hero dies under the effects of Anchor Smash.
Claddish navymen tell tales of a mighty sea-faring beast that suffered spear and sword but continued to lay waste to the fleet.
Does not stack with items that provide Damage Block.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_tidehunter_anchor_s: Tidehunter swings his mighty anchor to attack and deal bonus damage to nearby enemies and reduce their attack damage. The radius of Anchor Smash is Tidehunter's attack range plus %additional_range% units.
Stolen from one of Admiral Kunkka's flagships, Leviathan's heavy anchor proves useful as a melee weapon.
Anchor Smash works on all Ancient creeps except for Roshan.
Damage done by Anchor Smashes triggered by Kraken Shell Cleanse is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_tidehunter_ravage_D: Slams the ground, causing tentacles to erupt in all directions, damaging and stunning all nearby enemy units.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_tidehunter_ravage_L: Calling to the abyssal god Maelrawn has resulted in entire armadas being lost at sea.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_tidehunter_ravage_N: Ravage waves move outwards at a speed of %speed%.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_tidehunter_blubber_:
Tidehunter's hide removes negative status effects if he takes more than %damage_cleanse% damage. Removes most debuffs, even if they are generally not purgable.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
Only damage from player owned sources is counted towards debuff removal.
The counter will reset if no player owned damage is taken for %damage_reset_interval% seconds.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_tidehunter_dead_in_: Tidehunter attaches a heavy anchor to an enemy hero. The hero is leashed while attached to the anchor. Attempting to move more than %chain_length% units away from the anchor forces the hero to %max_movement_speed% move speed, dragging the anchor behind them. The anchor can be destroyed with %attacks_to_destroy% hero attacks.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_tidehunter_kraken_swe: Kraken Shell gains permanent Damage Block when an enemy hero dies under the effects of Anchor Smash.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_tidehunter_sizescale_: Tidehunter grows larger and gains extra bonuses per level.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_tidehunter_leviatha:
Whenever an enemy hero is killed by Tidehunter or dies under his debuffs, a fish appears in their place; Tidehunter can eat the fish to permanently gain %fish_health_bonus% Health, %fish_attack_range% Attack Range, and %fish_damage_block% Bonus Damage Block.

Tidehunter eats a free fish every time he reaches an even hero level.
Bonus Damage Block only applies if another source of Damage Block will be affecting the incoming physical attack.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_tidehunter_kraken_: Physical damage block increased by an additional %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_TOOLTIP%.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_tidehunter_dead_in: Leashed. Slowed severely while dragging the anchor.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_tidehunter_gush_De: Slowed by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_MOVESPEED_BONUS_PERCENTAGE%%%, and armor reduced by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_PHYSICAL_ARMOR_BONUS%.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_shadow_shaman_ether: Creates a cone of ethereal energy that strikes multiple enemy units.
Originally used to open shows with the travelling con-man, Rhasta's lightning display shocks adversaries in more ways than one.
Can hit secondary targets up to 1000 distance away.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_shadow_shaman_voodo: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless creature, disabling their attacks and abilities.
Rhasta often ended performances by turning himself into a chicken - now, the humiliation is shared.
The target will have a base movement speed of %movespeed%, but buffs granting maximum movement speed won't be disabled.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_shadow_shaman_shack: CHANNELED - Magically binds an enemy unit so that it cannot move or attack, absorbing their life energy over time.

Increase cast range. Every %scepter_shock_interval% seconds, shackled units emit a radial Ether Shock hitting all other units within %scepter_shock_radius% of the target for %scepter_shock_pct%%% of Ether Shock's normal damage. Shackles can now also be cast on allies and Mass Serpent Wards that stay within %ally_break_range% units of Shadow Shaman. Allied units are not disabled by Shackle.
A self-defense incantation, Rhasta developed shackles after his master was slain in the Bleeding Hills.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_shadow_shaman_mass_: Summons %ward_count% Serpent Wards to attack enemy units and structures. The Wards are immune to magic. Creeps deal half damage to the Serpent Ward.
Allows to create a Mega Ward using the Urnaconda ability.

DOTA_Tooltip_ability_wisp_overcharge_Des: Io gains attack speed, spell amplification, and health regeneration based on max health. If Io is Tethered to an ally, that unit also gains any bonuses granted by Overcharge.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_wisp_overcharge_Fac: Overcharge grants attack speed and spell amplification to Io and any Tethered allies.
Overcharge grants armor and magic resistance to Io and any Tethered allies.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_wisp_relocate_Lore: Io is the embodiment of the mystery of the universe.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_wisp_relocate_Descr: Teleports Io and a tethered ally to any location. After the spell expires, Io and the tethered ally will return to their original location. Double-click to teleport to your team's base fountain.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_wisp_relocate_Note0: Enemies receive a visual indicator in the world and on the minimap of the target location during the cast delay.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_wisp_relocate_Note1: If Io is disabled during the cast delay, Relocate is cancelled.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_wisp_relocate_Note2: If an allied hero is Tethered, that hero will teleport along with you. You can break the tether at any time to prevent that hero from teleporting with you.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_wisp_relocate_Note3: Only heroes, creep heroes, and illusions can be relocated.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_wisp_tether_Descri: Movement speed matched to and giving regen to tethered target.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_wisp_tether_haste_: Movement speed increased by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_MOVESPEED_BONUS_PERCENTAGE%%% and getting health and mana regen from Io.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_wisp_tether_slow_d: Taking %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_TOOLTIP% damage per second. Movement speed decreased by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_MOVESPEED_BONUS_PERCENTAGE%%% and attack speed decreased by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_ATTACKSPEED_BONUS_CONSTANT%.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_wisp_overcharge_De: Gaining %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_HEALTH_REGEN_CONSTANT% HP Regen. Attack speed increased by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_ATTACKSPEED_BONUS_CONSTANT%. Spell Amplification increased by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_SPELL_AMPLIFY_PERCENTAGE%%%.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_wisp_relocate_retu: About to return to previous location.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_slark_dark_pact_Des:
After a short delay, Slark sacrifices some of his life blood, purging most negative debuffs and dealing damage to enemy units around him and to himself.  Slark only takes %self_damage_pct%%% of the damage.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_slark_dark_pact_Lor: Slithereen are capable of quickly regrowing appendages, in case of critical injury, to save their own lives.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_slark_dark_pact_Not: %delay% seconds after cast, a series of %total_pulses% pulses separated by %pulse_interval% seconds deal the damage.
Each pulse also removes debuffs from Slark.
You can't kill yourself with this skill.
The pulses stop if Slark dies.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_slark_pounce_Descri: Slark leaps forward, leashing and applying Essence Shift stacks to the first hero he connects. That unit can only move a limited distance away from Slark's landing position.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_slark_pounce_Facet_: Pounce applies stacks of Essence Shift when striking enemy heroes.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_slark_pounce_Lore: Time in the Dark Reef made Slark a dangerous assassin; aggressive and fearless.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_slark_pounce_Note0: On cast, Slark leaps forward at a speed of %pounce_speed%, stopping when he latches onto an enemy hero or has traveled %pounce_distance% distance.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_slark_pounce_Note1: Debuff Immune units cannot be leashed.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_slark_pounce_Note2: Trees will be destroyed around Slark's landing location.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_slark_essence_shift: Slark steals the life essence of enemy heroes with his attacks, draining %stat_loss% of each of their attributes and converting them to bonus %agi_gain% Agility. If Slark kills an affected enemy hero, he permanently steals %stat_loss% Agility.
With each strike at his adversaries, Slark's knowledge of their weaknesses improves.
Essence Shifted stats are returned to normal on death. The stat return for Slark and for the affected hero are separate.
To permanently steal Agility, Slark doesn't need to land the killing blow, as long as the enemy hero is killed within Slark's Steal Radius while having the Essence Shift debuff.
Break disables the gaining of temporary stacks. Does not disable the gaining of permanent stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses of existing stacks.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_slark_leeching_leash_: Pounce applies stacks of Essence Shift when striking enemy heroes.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_slark_dark_reef_reneg: Barracuda lingers after being revealed to the enemy if Slark is not nearby allied heroes. Slark's attacks reduce the target's armor while Slark is under the effects of Barracuda.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_slark_slark_Descripti: This facet doesn't do anything. Slark is still reeling from nightmares about Dark Reef...
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_slark_barracuda_Not: If Slark is damaged by a neutral unit, the passive movement and health regeneration bonuses are lost for %neutral_disable% seconds.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_slark_shadow_dance_:
When not visible to the enemy team, Slark passively gains bonus movement speed and health regeneration. If Slark is damaged by a neutral unit, the passive movement and health regeneration bonuses are lost for %neutral_disable% seconds.

When activated, Slark hides himself in a cloud of shadows, becoming immune to detection. Attacking, casting spells, and using items will not reveal Slark, but enemies can see the cloud itself.
The hidden Thirteenth is a slippery foe.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_slark_saltwater_shi:
Slark slices the target with his salty shiv, stealing a portion of the target's movement speed, Health Regen and Health Restoration.

These effects stack independently.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_slark_saltwater_sh: Health Restoration changed by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_RESTORATION_AMPLIFICATION%%%, Health Regen changed by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_HEALTH_REGEN_CONSTANT%, movement speed changed by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_MOVESPEED_BONUS_CONSTANT%.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_slark_depth_shroud_: Creates a cloud at the target location. All allies inside the radius are hidden and affected by Shadow Dance.
Nothing worse than a job going bad thanks to some clompy-footed friend.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_slark_pounce_leash: Leashed to Slark, can only move a limited distance away.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_slark_shadow_dance: Gaining %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_MOVESPEED_BONUS_PERCENTAGE%%% bonus movement speed and regenerating %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_HEALTH_REGEN_CONSTANT% HP per second.
Invisible within your cloud of smoke.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_medusa_split_shot_D:
Medusa magically splits her shot into several arrows. These arrows deal a lower percent of her normal damage.

The extra targets will not receive other attack effects (such as critical strike).
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_medusa_split_shot_s: Allows on-hit effects to apply to the secondary attacks from Split Shot. Increases arrow count.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_medusa_split_shot_L: All who encounter the cursed Gorgon will feel her rage.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_medusa_split_shot_N: Secondary targets will be the closest enemy units excluding the primary target.
If illusions of Medusa are created while Split Shot is active, they will also have this ability.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_medusa_mystic_snake: A mystic snake made of energy jumps from target to target dealing damage. Damage and speed increases with each jump. After it reaches its last target, it returns to Medusa to replenish her with mana. The snake returns a percentage of the targets' total mana.
Mystic Snakes returning to Medusa empower her next %max_attacks% attacks with +1 additional damage for each %mana_per_damage% mana restored. Lasts up to %attack_buff_duration%s.
The Gorgon's curse is her greatest strength.

Shard: Cold Blooded is hidden in the ability panel when Shard is aquired, but a buff icon will appear.

Stone Gaze must be drafted for Aghanim's Scepter upgrade to work.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_medusa_mana_shield_: Creates a shield that absorbs %absorption_pct%%% of incoming damage in exchange for Medusa's mana. Illusions absorb %illusion_percentage%%% less damage per point of mana.
Absorbs damage before any damage reduction takes place, meaning that armor will not reduce the amount of mana needed to absorb damage.

Mana Shield can be activated, draining %aspd_increase_mana_cost_pct%%% of max mana per second to gain %aspd_increase_rate_pct%%% attack speed bonus per second, up to %aspd_increase_max_tooltip%%%. Maximum effect reached after %aspd_increase_max_aspd_time%s. Buff lasts %aspd_increase_buff_duration%s and Cooldown is %attack_buff_cooldown%s.
While Medusa was not gifted with eternal life upon birth, her curse bestowed her with impressive defensive powers.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_medusa_stone_gaze_D: Any enemy units looking at Medusa will have their movement and attack speed slowed.  If %face_duration% seconds of total time is accumulated looking at Medusa while Stone Gaze is active, that unit will turn to stone.  Petrified units are stunned, and take bonus physical attack damage.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_medusa_stone_gaze_L: The beauty of Medusa is legendary.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_medusa_stone_gaze_N: Regardless of when a unit receives the Stone Gaze buff while the ability is active on Medusa, it will still receive the full debuff duration.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_medusa_cold_blooded: When Medusa is targeted with a spell, a single-target Mystic Snake is sent back towards the enemy that turns them into stone for %stone_form_scepter_base_tooltip%s.
Point your gaze at her if you dare.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_medusa_gorgon_grasp: Medusa fires arrows in a line that land in %volley_count% groups, with each grouping larger than the previous. Enemies struck by a volley of arrows take an initial burst of damage and then are rooted, cannot turn, are revealed to the enemy, and take damage per second.
The best predators don't even need to pounce.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_medusa_venomed_voll: Every %attack_count% attacks, Medusa applies poison to her arrow that briefly reduces movement speed and attack speed.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_medusa_mana_shield: Absorbing %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_TOOLTIP%%% of incoming damage at a rate of %fMODIFIER_PROPERTY_TOOLTIP2% damage per point of mana.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_medusa_stone_gaze_: Movement speed increased by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_MOVESPEED_BONUS_PERCENTAGE%%%. Enemies that look at you will have their attack and movement speed reduced.
Speed reduced by 35%%. Turning to stone while looking at Medusa.
Turned to stone. Stunned and taking %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_INCOMING_PHYSICAL_DAMAGE_PERCENTAGE%%% extra physical damage.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_medusa_cold_bloode: Sending Mystic Snakes toward enemies targeting you with single-target spells.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_medusa_mystic_snak: Returning serpents will cause Medusa's next attack to deal %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_TOOLTIP% additional physical damage.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_medusa_venomed_vol: Embedding arrows with poison every few attacks.
Movement Speed and Attack Speed reduced.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_medusa_gorgon_gras: Grasped by the Gorgon. Rooted and taking damage over time. Unable to turn.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_medusa_engorged_Descr: Mystic Snake grants Medusa attack damage.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_medusa_mana_pact_Desc: Medusa can gain attack speed at the cost of mana over time.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_medusa_undulation_D: Medusa's movement speed is fixed at %fixed_movespeed% (%stone_gaze_ms_tooltip_only% during Stone Gaze). Medusa is unslowable and does not benefit from movement speed increases.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_medusa_undulation_N: Medusa can still benefit from movement speed bonuses from stream currents.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_troll_warlord_berse:
While in melee form, Troll Warlord's attacks have a chance to ensnare, preventing the target from moving or using mobility spells and has additional movement speed.

When in ranged form, Troll Warlord's attacks have a chance to Maim the target, dealing bonus damage, and slowing the target's movement and attack speed.
Like his anger, Troll Warlord's supply of axes is infinite.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_troll_warlord_switc:
Troll Warlord swaps from using ranged to melee attacks. While melee, Troll Warlord's base attack time is improved to %base_attack_time%.

Troll Warlord gains %armor_per_interval% armor per %attack_speed_interval% bonus attack speed.
Jah'rakal has a variety of ways to get under an enemy's skin.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_troll_warlord_whirl: Troll hurls a fistful of five axes in a cone shape over %axe_range% range, slowing and damaging enemy units.

Causes Whirling Axes (Ranged) to dispel enemies. Reduces cooldown and mana cost.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
Only axes fueled by hate whirl with such a deadly spin.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
Troll hurls two axes around him in a close range area of effect, damaging enemy units and causing them to miss some attacks.

Causes Whirling Axes (Melee) to dispel Troll Warlord. Reduces cooldown and mana cost.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_troll_warlord_fervo: With each continuous blow on the same target, Troll gains increased attack speed.  If Troll changes targets, the stacks drop to zero.
Fervor grants armor per stack while in melee form.

Grants Troll %base_chance%%% + %extra_attack_chance_per_stack%%% chance per Fervor stack of firing an additional ranged attack to any unit within its ranged attack range plus %range_buffer% when attacking an enemy unit.
If at first you don't succeed, strike, strike again.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break disables the proc chance granted by Aghanim's Shard.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_troll_warlord_battl:
Troll unleashes a powerful battle trance, that forces you to continuously attack the closest enemy unit within %range% range, prioritizing heroes. Damage does not kill you during this mode. Grants you bonus lifesteal, attack speed, slow resistance and movement speed. Applies a Basic Dispel.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
During Battle Trance, Troll Warlord has increased max Fervor stacks and no attack speed limit. Battle Trance grants allied heroes %attack_speed_share_percent%%% of the attack speed bonus.
An adrenaline rush of pure hatred quickens your blades.
Troll can still use his items and abilities while affected by Battle Trance, but not other commands.
Troll can still be killed with Axe's Culling Blade.
Troll is granted vision over the target.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_troll_warlord_batt: Granting %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_ATTACKSPEED_BONUS_CONSTANT% attack speed, %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_MOVESPEED_BONUS_PERCENTAGE%%% movement speed, and lifesteal. Troll cannot die during Battle Trance.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_troll_warlord_whir: Blinded, have a %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_MISS_PERCENTAGE%%% chance to miss.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_troll_warlord_batt: Troll Warlord has you in his sights!
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_troll_warlord_bers: You're ensnared by an enraged Troll!
You're maimed by an enraged Troll!
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_troll_warlord_bad_inf: During Battle Trance, Troll Warlord has increased max Fervor stacks and no attack speed limit. Battle Trance grants allied heroes {s:bonus_attack_speed_share_percent}% of the attack speed bonus.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_troll_warlord_insensi: Fervor grants armor per stack while in melee form.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_centaur_hoof_stomp_: After a brief windup, Centaur Warrunner slams the ground, stunning and damaging nearby enemy units. During the delay, he is disarmed but can move.
When the mighty hoof of the Warrunner touches soil, the tremors are felt far and wide.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_centaur_double_edge: Centaur strikes a mighty blow at melee range, damaging both himself and a small area around the target. Deals extra damage based on your strength. Centaur cannot die from Double Edge.
Causes Double Edge to slow enemy heroes and increase Centaur's strength per hero hit for a short time. Duration refreshes per stack, up to a max of %shard_max_stacks% stacks.
In the spurs of combat, Bradwarden's vicious strikes sometimes cause self-inflicted collateral damage.
Double Edge deals magic type damage to both the targets and himself.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_centaur_return_Desc: Centaur counters all attacks, dealing damage back to the attacker. Returns a fixed amount plus a percentage of your strength. Deals half damage to towers.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_centaur_return_Lore: Bradwarden has no need to parry his opponent's attacks; his armor-like hide does it for him.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_centaur_return_Note: Retaliate triggers when the attack hits.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_centaur_stampede_De: Centaur leads all allies into a vicious charge causing them to move through units at max speed and slow any enemy units they trample. Trampled enemies take damage based on Centaur Warrunner's strength. Each enemy can be trampled once.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_centaur_stampede_Lo: The great belt of Omexe, which labels Bradwarden as the greatest warrior of his kind, incites his fellow gladiators to follow him into barbarous combat.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_centaur_work_horse_: Centaur hitches a cart behind him. While active, Centaur gains the benefit of Stampede for the current level of Stampede, and can cast Hitch a Ride on a target ally.
It is a great honor to be offered a ride by Centaur Warrunner and a grave mistake to refuse it.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_centaur_mount_Lore: The needs of Bradwarden's ample pride pale greatly in the face of his demand for victory.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_centaur_mount_Descr: Centaur tosses an ally into a cart hitched behind him. While in the cart, the ally is invulnerable and can still cast and attack normally, but cannot move independently or be targeted by opponents. Increases the attack range of melee heroes by %melee_attack_range%.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_centaur_horsepower_:
Centaur Warrunner gains %strength_to_movement_pct%%% of his strength as bonus movement speed.

This Movement speed bonus does not stack with bonuses from boots.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_centaur_counter_strik: Double Edge damage is increased when Centaur is damage by enemies.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_centaur_mounted_De: Invulnerable. Can cast spells and attack, but not move or be targeted by enemies.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_centaur_stampede_D: Moving at max speed and slowing enemy units trampled.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_centaur_stampede_s: Unit is hit by stampede, it has reduced movement speed.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_centaur_double_edg: Next Double Edge damage will be increased by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_TOOLTIP%.
dota_hud_error_currently_carrying_you: Can't be cast on your ride
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_centaur_doubleedge: Increasing Centaur's strength and slowing enemies.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_magnataur_shockwave: Magnus sends out a wave of force, damaging enemy units in a line, pulling them towards him, and slowing them for a brief period.

Increases the max level of Shockwave. Level %max_level% Shockwave causes it to return towards Magnus's current location after reaching max length. The return Shockwave travels %return_shockwave_bonus_distance% distance further and hits enemies a second time for %return_damage_pct_tooltip%%% of the damage.
Mt. Joerlak was a somewhat unstable mass, and Magnus has learned to channel its reverberations.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_magnataur_empower_D:
When cast on an ally, grants them bonus damage and cleave on attack. 

 Empower is always on Magnus with %self_multiplier%%% larger bonus.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_magnataur_empower_L: With a deep bellow, Magnus displays his true power.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_magnataur_empower_N: The bonus damage is based only on base damage and damage from primary attributes.
Cleave damage goes through spell immunity.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_magnataur_skewer_De: Magnus rushes forward, goring enemy units on his massive tusk. Heroes hit on the way will be dragged to the destination, then damaged and affected by slowed movement speed. The damage is increased based on distance traveled.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_magnataur_skewer_sh: Increases range and deals additional damage when skewering enemies into trees or cliffs.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_magnataur_skewer_No: Skewer is interrupted if Magnus is stunned, hexed or banished.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_magnataur_skewer_Lo: Magnoceros horns are valuable in direct proportion to their danger to prospective merchants.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_magnataur_reverse_p: Magnus changes properties of matter, pulling all nearby enemies in front of him and stunning them with a damaging slam.
Magnus fights with the fury of the erupting Mt. Joerlak.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_magnataur_horn_toss: Magnus tosses any enemies in front of him, launching them to his rear. Enemies take damage, spend %air_duration% seconds in the air, and are stunned while in the air and an additional amount of time after landing.
Survivors of Joerlak will never forget the sight of Magnus tossing countless enemies into rivers of fire and clouds of ash.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_magnataur_solid_cor: Magnus has increased slow resistance and suffers less knockback from enemy's abilities and items.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_magnataur_empower_: Base damage increased by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_BASEDAMAGEOUTGOING_PERCENTAGE%%%, gaining %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_TOOLTIP%%% cleave damage.
Each subsequent attack grants increased damage and increased cleave damage.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_magnataur_reverse_pol: Reverse Polarity pulls all nearby enemies in.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_magnataur_reverse_rev: Reverse Polarity pushes enemies away all around Magnus.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_magnataur_eternal_emp: Empower is always on Magnus. Each subsequent attack increases its power.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_magnataur_diminishing: Increases the max level of Shockwave. Level {s:bonus_max_level_tooltip} Shockwave causes it to return towards Magnus's location.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_shredder_whirling_d: Timbersaw whirls extremely sharp edges, damaging enemies and destroying trees around him in an area. If an enemy hero is affected, it loses some of its primary attribute for a short duration. Whirling Death will deal bonus damage per tree destroyed.
In the case that Rizzrack gets surrounded by the vines and plants of his nightmares, he has an immediate chainsaw defense.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_shredder_timber_cha: Timbersaw fires a chain that embeds itself in the first tree it hits, pulling him towards it.  Any enemy in the path takes damage.

When Timbersaw collides with the target tree, it shatters, sending %tree_splinter_count% splinters in all directions, up to %tree_splinter_distance% distance. If a splinter hits an enemy, they take damage and are slowed for a brief duration.
You never know when you might need to escape from malevolent saplings.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_shredder_reactive_a: Reactive Armor can now be activated to get max stacks and %initial_shield% damage barrier. Grants Timbersaw %shield_per_sec% + %shield_per_sec_per_enemy% barrier amount per second for each enemy hero within %radius% radius of Timbersaw up to a maximum of %max_shield%. After %duration% seconds, Timbersaw deals damage to every hero within %explosion_radius% radius equal to %base_explosion% + his remaining barrier amount and loses all of his barrier.
Each time Timbersaw is attacked, he gains increased health regen and armor. Hero attacks are counted as %stacks_per_hero_attack%x the amount.
The saw-suit is equipped to react to the slightest touch with fortified defenses.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_shredder_chakram_De: Fires Timbersaw's main saw blade at the target location where it will spin in place, dealing damage in an area around it.  Enemies caught in the saw blade will move more slowly for every %slow_health_percentage%%% of health missing. The blade deals damage and cuts down trees in its path when fired and retracted.  While active the ability costs mana, and Timbersaw loses the ability to attack.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_shredder_chakram_No: The Chakram will return if Timbersaw runs out of mana or moves over %break_distance% distance away.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_shredder_flamethrow: Releases a flame in the direction Timbersaw is facing. Applies a debuff that deals damage per second and slows enemy movement speed. Affects buildings for reduced damage.
A single saw can only cut so much. A single spark can burn forever.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_shredder_whirling_: Losing a percentage of primary attribute.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_shredder_reactive_: Gaining bonus armor and HP regen per stack.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_shredder_chakram_d: Taking damage over time and being slowed by the Chakram.
You cannot attack while Chakram is in the air.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_shredder_timber_ch: Damaging any enemy in your path.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_shredder_flamethro: Movement speed reduced by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_MOVESPEED_BONUS_PERCENTAGE%%% and ticking for %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_TOOLTIP% damage per second.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_shredder_chakram_d: Taking damage over time and being slowed by the Chakram.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_shredder_reactive_: Absorbing damage. At the end of the duration, will explode and damage nearby enemies.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_shredder_twisted_ch: Launches a second independent Chakram that follows a curved path and returns to Timbersaw, damaging and slowing enemies it passes through. Enemies caught in the saw blade will move more slowly for every %slow_health_percentage%%% of health missing.
A happy little accident in the lab turned wild new weapon in the forest.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_shredder_shredder_Des: Timber Chain splinters the tree into all directions around Timbersaw.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_shredder_exposure_t: Whenever Timbersaw destroys a tree, he gains mana.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_bristleback_viscous: Covers a target in snot, causing it to have reduced armor and movement speed for %goo_duration% seconds.  Multiple casts stack and refresh the duration.
Max stacks and armor reduction per stack increased.
Having caught a cold while stuck in the snow, Bristleback turns it to his advantage.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_bristleback_quill_s:
Shard: Access Hairball by toggling auto-cast on Quill Spray.

Must draft Nasal Goo for it to work with Hairball.
Sprays enemy units with quills dealing damage in an area of effect around Bristleback.  Deals bonus damage for every time a unit was hit by Quill Spray in the last %quill_stack_duration% seconds.
An enforcer's honor can be a prickly thing.  So can his quills.
Quill Spray damage is not reduced by damage block abilities.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_bristleback_bristle: Quill Spray must be drafted also to release when damage threshold reached.
Bristleback takes less damage if hit on the sides or rear. If Bristleback takes enough damage from the rear, he releases a Quill Spray of the current level.
Instead of releasing Quill Spray from taking damage, he instead launches Nasal Goo of the current level at all nearby enemies.
Turning his back to a fight might be just the thing.
Bristleback's rear is considered to be within 70 degrees from the back.
Bristleback's side is considered to be within 110 degrees from the back.
Damage done by Quill Sprays released by this ability passively is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

Adds active ability to Bristleback. Bristleback rotates towards the targeted direction and, after %activation_delay%s, forcefully ejects %activation_num_quill_sprays% sequential Quill Sprays in a tight conical pattern out of his back every %activation_spray_interval%s. Bristleback's facing is locked during this time, he is disarmed, and his speed is reduced by %activation_movement_speed_pct%%%.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_bristleback_warpath: Bristleback works himself up into a fury every time he casts a spell, increasing his movement speed and damage.
