DOTA_Tooltip_ability_hoodwink_scurry_Des: Hoodwink gains bonus movement speed, phased movement, and tree-walking for a brief time. While active, the redirect chance of Mistwoods Wayfarer is multiplied by %evasion_multiplier%.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_hoodwink_scurry_Fac: Scurry also provides bonus attack and cast range.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_hoodwink_scurry_Lor: There's not a nook or cranny in the Wood Tomo'kan out of reach of Hoodwink's paws.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_hoodwink_tomokan_tr: Hoodwink can see footprints of where enemy Heroes have been in the last %trail_history_duration% seconds in a %search_radius% area around her.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_hoodwink_scurry_ac: Gaining %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_MOVESPEED_BONUS_PERCENTAGE%%% bonus movement speed, %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_ATTACK_RANGE_BONUS% bonus attack and cast range, and the ability to walk through units and trees.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_hoodwink_mistwoods_: Hoodwink has a chance to redirect enemy attacks to a nearby tree.
Trees that take a redirected attack are destroyed.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_hoodwink_mistwoods: %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_TOOLTIP%%% chance to redirect enemy attacks to a nearby tree.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_hoodwink_sharpshoot:
Hoodwink charges up and fires a deadly bolt from her crossbow, dealing heavy damage, break and slow to an enemy Hero.  The damage and debuff duration scale up to max after %max_charge_time% seconds, and the bolt is fired automatically after %misfire_time% seconds.
Hoodwink is knocked backwards for a distance of %recoil_distance% from the force of the shot. Creeps hit by the bolt are damaged for half the values.
Increases arrow speed and movement speed slow.

Sharpshooter has a %quick_draw_tooltip_pct_cooldown_reduction%%% reduced cooldown. Damage, debuff duration, and wind-up times are reduced by %quick_draw_tooltip_efficacy_pct%%%. Turn rate is increased by %turn_rate_tooltip%%%.
While her first arbalest was a chance discovery, Hoodwink now takes great care in carving and caring for her own -- of course with some necessary components pilfered or otherwise cleverly procured.
Release the charged up shot, regain ability to move and attack.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_hoodwink_sharpshoo: Winding up Sharpshooter for bonus damage and debuff duration; rooted and disarmed.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_hoodwink_decoy_Desc: Hoodwink turns invisible, increasing her movement speed, and creates a decoy illusion that starts aiming a decreased damage Sharpshooter at the nearest enemy hero. If the illusion is attacked or hit by a targeted ability, it is destroyed and it throws a lesser bushwhack towards the enemy.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_hoodwink_decoy_Lore: The best traps trigger whether you touch them or not.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_hoodwink_decoy_abil: Does not requires Bushwhack to be drafted for full effect.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_hoodwink_hunters_bo: Tosses a boomerang in an arc. Upon contact, it returns to Hoodwink.  The boomerang will deal damage as it passes through or hits enemies, and apply a debuff that causes affected enemies to be slowed and be more vulnerable to spell damage.
A precious last vestige of Hoodwink's childhood, converted into deadly distraction.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_hoodwink_hunters_m: Slowed and taking increased spell damage.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_special_bonus_uniqu: Hoodwink becomes invisible near trees after {s:fade_time} seconds of not moving, attacking, or casting spells.
Also Grants True Sight. Does Not Reveal Wards.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_hoodwink_hunter_Descr: Scurry also provides bonus attack and cast range.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_hoodwink_treebounce_t: Acorn Shot can bounce once on trees.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_hoodwink_hipshot_Desc: Sharpshooter has a greatly reduced cooldown. Damage, debuff duration, turn time, and wind-up times are also reduced.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_dawnbreaker_solar_g: Only in defense of an ally will Valora relent to call upon the last reserves of her old powers that still allow cosmic flight.

CHANNELED - Dawnbreaker creates a pulsing effect at a location within %max_offset_distance% units of an allied hero anywhere on the map and creates daylight for %daytime_duration%s. Each pulse damages enemies and heals allies.

After a short duration, she flies to the target location and deals additional damage and stuns enemies upon landing.

Once channeled, Dawnbreaker cannot stop the ability.
Total flight duration is %abilitychanneltime% seconds of channel time + %airtime_duration% of flight time.
Instantly recalls the Hammer on cast.
Solar Guardian's aura follows Dawnbreaker for %scepter_aura_duration%s after landing.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_dawnbreaker_break_o: Whenever the sun comes out, Dawnbreaker gains bonus base damage and vision that decreases throughout the course of the day. If Dawnbreaker causes the day these bonuses are at full power for the entirety of that daytime.
Break of Dawn provides healing amplification equal to the current damage increase.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_dawnbreaker_solar_: Cannot act while in Solar Guardian
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_dawnbreaker_fire_wr: Across the vast lineage of star progeny, there were multitudes unwilling to align with the aims of the Children of Light. To those who dared organize defiance, the Children would dispatch Valora and her hammer to show a measure of their power--to leave the rebels either shattered or set back to rights.
Dawnbreaker whirls her hammer around 3 times, damaging enemies with her attack plus bonus damage. On the final strike, she smashes her hammer down, stunning and damaging enemies in front of her.
Dawnbreaker travels at a rate of %movement_speed% for the duration of the ability and takes a brief %self_stun_duration%s to recover after the final strike.
Celestial Hammer or Solar Guardian cannot be cast during the combo.
Cleave does not work with this ability.
Can be self-cast to move forward.
The first two strikes will slow enemy movement speed by %swipe_slow%%% for %sweep_stun_duration%s.

Dawnbreaker gains debuff immunity with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance and free movement during Starbreaker. Dawnbreaker is slowed by %shard_movement_penalty%%% down to a minimum of %movement_speed%.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_dawnbreaker_fire_wr: Dawnbreaker and her allies in a %movespeed_bonus_radius% radius gain attack speed for %movespeed_bonus_duration% seconds at the end of Starbreaker for each swipe that hit enemy heroes.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_dawnbreaker_converg: Dawnbreaker recalls her hammer, pulling them together so they meet in the middle.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_dawnbreaker_celesti: The Brightmaul is Valora's oldest companion and sole remaining connection to the glow of her creators.

When Celestial Hammer lands on the ground, it creates the healing and damaging effects of Solar Guardian, reduced by %hammer_solar_guardian_effectiveness_pct%%% in a %hammer_solar_guardian_radius% AoE around it. Increases the duration that the hammer can remain stationary to %pause_duration%s.

Dawnbreaker hurls her weapon at a target, damaging enemies struck along the way. The hammer pauses for %pause_duration% seconds at the destination before flying back to her, leaving a trail of fire that slows enemies. Dawnbreaker can recall the hammer at any time, pulling her towards it so they meet in the middle.
The hammer damages enemies both when thrown and when returning to Dawnbreaker.
Dawnbreaker's Converge movement distance is capped at the ability's cast range.
Starbreaker cannot be cast while the Hammer is out.
Allied heroes walking on Celestial Hammer's fire trail gain bonus movement speed.
Enemies hit by Celestial Hammer will count as Luminosity attacks. Luminosity's crit will apply to Celestial Hammer.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_dawnbreaker_luminos: Diminished in power without access to the Children's replenishing light, Valora can still recharge herself and her allies by creating order from the chaos which resides within each fight.

After a number of attacks, Dawnbreaker powers up, charging her next attack with a critical hit that heals all allied heroes within %heal_radius% units around her for a portion of attack damage dealt. Creeps and neutral enemies provide less healing. Allies are healed for %allied_healing_pct%%% of the amount.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_dawnbreaker_luminos: Dawnbreaker gets 2 Luminosity attacks every time she powers up.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_dawnbreaker_luminos: Whenever Dawnbreaker hits a target with a powered up Luminosity, she decreases the cooldowns of all of her abilities.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_dawnbreaker_luminos: Luminosity Heal is increased by sources of Health Restoration Amplification.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_dawnbreaker_fire_w: Dealing damage to enemies all around
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_dawnbreaker_lumino: Next hit will heal Dawnbreaker and deal a critical strike
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_dawnbreaker_gleaming_: Celestial Hammer heals allies and damages enemies when on the ground.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_dawnbreaker_solar_cha: Whenever Dawnbreaker hits a target with a powered up Luminosity, she decreases the cooldowns of all of her abilities.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_dawnbreaker_blaze_Des: Dawnbreaker and nearby allies gain bonus attack speed at the end of Starbreaker for each swipe that hit enemy heroes.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_dawnbreaker_hearthfir: Walking along Celestial Hammer's fire trail gives bonus movespeed.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_special_bonus_uniqu: Celestial Hammer emits Solar Guardian aura

{s:bonus_hammer_solar_guardian_radius} AoE. Hammer stationary duration increased by {s:bonus_pause_duration}. Damaging and Healing is {s:bonus_hammer_solar_guardian_effectiveness_pct}% of Solar Guardian's.
Celestial Hammer Trail Grants Movement Speed to Allies
Bonus movement speed is equal to the movement slow
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_marci_grapple_Descr: Marci grabs an allied or enemy target and throws it effortlessly behind her, damaging and slowing the unit if it's an enemy. Any enemy units in the landing area will also be damaged and slowed.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_marci_grapple_Lore: Marci excels at removing obstacles from Princess Mirana's path.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_marci_unleash_Descr:
Marci taps a hidden power, gaining Fury charges that allow her to deliver a rapid sequence of strikes that slow movement and attack speed of the target for %pulse_debuff_duration%s. The last strike in every Fury combo creates a damaging pulse around the target. In between Fury combos, Marci is unable to attack for %time_between_flurries%s.

Marci gains %bonus_movespeed%%% movement speed when Unleash is cast.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_marci_unleash_scept:
Reduces Unleash cooldown by %scepter_cooldown_reduction% seconds and causes Unleash to apply a basic dispel on Marci. While Unleash is Active, all of Marci's abilities unleash pulses when cast. All of Marci's unleash pulses will silence units for %pulse_silence_duration% seconds.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_marci_unleash_Note0: Once a Fury combo is started, each attack must be delivered within 1s or the Fury combo expires.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_marci_unleash_Lore: Though some have sought to understand its origins, Marci rebuffs all attempts to divine the source of her power.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_marci_unleash_flur: This unit has greatly increased attack speed.
Waiting for the next Fury strikes.
This unit has slowed movement and attack speed.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_marci_companion_run:
Marci bounds to the targeted allied unit, choosing a direction and distance she will spring away from it. Upon reaching the unit, Marci lunges to her final destination, damaging and stunning enemies where she lands.

When Rebound is set to alt-cast, Marci brings the target ally with her to her final destination.

 The ally receives %ally_movespeed_pct%%% bonus movement speed for %ally_buff_duration%s.
Increases damage. Rebound can be cast on enemies, and causes Marci to also get the speed boost when she casts it.

When Rebound is set to alt-cast, Marci brings the target ally with her to her final destination. The ally deals %ally_impact_damage_pct%%% of the Rebound damage to the enemies around it's destination.

 Will not apply to Rooted or Leashed allies.

If Marci has Unleash leveled, after landing from Rebound, Marci gains a %postjump_flurry_charges% strike Fury combo. If Unleash is already active, its duration is instead extended by %postjump_unleash_duration%s.

 If upgraded by Aghanim's Scepter, the resulting Unleashed pulse will not silence enemies.
With a friendly or brazen boost, Marci can find her way into the midst of any fight.
Marci's initial run to her target unit can be disjointed.
Does not bring allies who are Rooted or Leashed when alt-cast.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_marci_special_deliv:
Marci whistles to instantly summon her courier to her. If the courier started in the fountain, it will take items from Marci's stash. After teleporting it will transfer these items to Marci and head back to the fountain.

Passively grants all allied couriers %bonus_levels% bonus levels and %bonus_hp_tooltip% bonus health.
Professional courtesy, from one courier to another.
Special Delivery whistle has a cast point of %abilitycastpoint% second.
If the courier didn't transfer any items or still has items after casting, it will remain next to Marci.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_marci_companion_ru: This unit has bonus movement speed.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_marci_sidekick_Descri: Marci can protect an ally, granting them shared lifesteal and damage. Effect is stronger if she's close to the ally.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_marci_bodyguard_Descr: Marci can protect an ally, countering attacks directed towards them if she's in range of the enemy.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_marci_bodyguard_Des:
Passively grants Marci lifesteal and bonus attack damage.

When cast on an ally, she provides them with %max_partner_penalty%%% of her passive lifesteal and attack damage bonus. Additionally Marci creates a shared all damage barrier for herself and her partner. As Marci attacks heroes, %shared_barrier_replenish_amount%%% of the damage dealt restores the barrier.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_marci_bodyguard_Lor: Marci learned at a young age that the best asset in a scrap is a steady companion.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_marci_bodyguard_Fac: While bodyguarded, Marci and her partner share %shared_healing_percent%%% of health healed by this ability with each other.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_marci_bodyguard_Not: Marci cannot cast Bodyguard on herself.
Lifesteal effectiveness gets a %creep_lifesteal_reduction_pct%%% penalty against creeps.
The shared barrier is reduced by damage on either Marci or her partner.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_marci_bodyguard_se: Marci has lifesteal and bonus damage.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_marci_bodyguarded_: Protected by Marci. This unit has a shared barrier, bonus lifesteal, and bonus damage.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_marci_buddy_system_De: While bodyguarded, Marci and her partner share a portion of health healed by this ability with each other.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_marci_fleeting_fury_D: Upon landing with Rebound, Marci gains a Fury combo.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_marci_pickmeup_Descri: Rebound can be alt-cast to bring Marci's ally with her after the jump.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_special_bonus_uniqu: Unleash Duration Extended By {s:bonus_extend_duration}s On Kill
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_primal_beast_trampl: Primal Beast stomps over everything. For every %step_distance% units traveled, all enemies around the Beast receive damage. Deals base damage plus a multiplier of Primal Beast's attack damage. Primal Beast is disarmed for the duration of the ability.
Trample grants bonus movement speed to Primal Beast and his allies when activated.

As the only member of his species to arrive on this world, locals can only speculate on the Beast's size relative to his kin. Such observation would prove easier of course if the subject didn't eat everything it sees and destroy most of what it doesn't.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_primal_beast_tramp: Deals damage to everyone around Primal Beast when walking.
Break disables the movement speed aura from Romp n' Stomp.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_primal_beast_pulver: CHANNELED - Primal Beast channels his rage, grabbing the target enemy and slamming them into the ground repeatedly, damaging and mini-stunning any enemies caught in the AoE. Each consecutive hit deals bonus damage. Lasts %channel_time% seconds.

Though none are certain whether his utterances have true meaning, most concede the Beast's powerful grip and tendency to smash his enemies into naught but pulp and pieces communicates his intent well enough.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_primal_beast_onslau:
Primal Beast charges up and then runs in the chosen direction, knocking back enemies and allies alike. Enemy units are damaged and stunned on impact. The longer the charge duration, the farther Primal Beast's momentum will carry him. 

 Can be cancelled at any time with the Stop command.
The Beast's single-minded focus on chosen prey leaves all other considerations scattered in his ruinous wake.
Begins the rush to the specified location.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_primal_beast_rock_t:
Primal Beast throws a rock at the target location that stuns and damages enemies. The rock cannot be thrown within a minimum range of Primal Beast. After landing, the rock splits into 3 additional fragments that land behind the initial target location.

Rock Throw increases stacks of Uproar for each hero hit.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_special_bonus_uniqu: Cannot be slowed or rooted during Trample
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_primal_beast_uproar:
The Beast's temper causes every instance of %damage_limit% hero damage or more to grant a stack of Uproar.  

 When activated, Primal Beast releases a roar that slows surrounding enemies and grants the Beast additional attack damage and armor for %roar_duration% seconds based on his current stacks of Uproar.
Primal Beast cannot gain Uproar stacks from self damage.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Already draped in a broken patchwork of barding and chains upon appearing in the mistwoods, the Beast tolerates no further attempts at subjugation.

When Primal Beast activates Uproar, he releases %projectile_waves% waves of %projectiles_per_stack% projectiles per stack of uproar each in a circle around him. Projectiles deal damage and Break enemies hit. After a short delay, each projectile splinters in two.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_primal_beast_uproa: Primal Beast deals increased damage and slows enemies.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_primal_beast_roare: Gaining bonus attack damage and armor
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_primal_beast_onsla: Charging forward, stunning enemies Beast collides with.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_primal_beast_pulve: Channeling Primal Beast's rage, grabbing and repeated slamming the target.
AoE effects of items and abilities are increased by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_TOOLTIP%%%.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_primal_beast_ferocity: Each Pulverize slam increase Primal Beast's AoE.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_primal_beast_romp_n_s: Trample grants bonus movement speed to Primal Beast and his allies when activated.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_primal_beast_provoke_: Gain {s:bonus_stack_count_increase_on_disable} Uproar stacks upon being disabled by an enemy hero.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_primal_beast_coloss: Primal Beast has %base_slow_resist%%% base Slow Resistance and gains %aoe_per_threshold%%% bonus Area of Effect and %slow_resistance_per_threshold%%% Slow Resistance for every %hp_per_threshold% Max Health.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_special_bonus_uniqu: +{s:bonus_hp_regen_pct}% Max HP Regen while inside The Calling
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_muerta_dead_shot_De:
Muerta fires a ghostly trickshot at an enemy unit or tree. When the bullet strikes, it damages and briefly slows, then ricochets in the targeted direction.

The ricochet damages all units that it passes through, stopping when it hits a hero. Heroes hit by the ricochet are feared away from the impact.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_muerta_dead_shot_Fa: Dead Shot fears increase Gunslinger chance to %gunslinger_buffed_chance_multiplier%x for %gunslinger_buffed_chance_duration%s.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_muerta_dead_shot_sc: Dead Shot damage is increased. Dead Shot expands after it ricochets and pierces through enemy heroes as it fears them.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_muerta_dead_shot_No: Feared enemies are phased and unslowable.
The ricochet will travel %ricochet_distance_multiplier%x Dead Shot's cast range.
Can ricochet off of magic immune targets.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_muerta_dead_shot_Lo: A steady gunhand and an eternity of practice produce trickshots that defy the mortal mind.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_muerta_the_calling_: Muerta's family are forever beyond the spirit veil, but her deal with Death allows her to briefly call on them in times of want or need.
Summons a group of %num_revenants% revenants that slowly circle the targeted location. Enemies within the area are slowed. Revenants deal damage and silence enemies as they pass through them.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_muerta_the_calling_: Heroes killed inside The Calling refresh its duration, create another Revenant, and expand the radius of The Calling by %kill_radius_expansion%.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_muerta_pierce_the_v:
Muerta transforms, becoming ethereal, gaining bonus base damage and phased movement.

Passively allows Muerta to always attack ethereal targets and attack when she is ethereal. When either she or her target is ethereal, all of her attack damage is dealt as magical damage and her physical lifesteal is treated as spell lifesteal.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
Muerta sheds her corporeal form, crossing the spirit veil and striking her enemies with the fury of the damned.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_muerta_pierce_the_v:
Muerta gains %spell_lifesteal%%% Spell Lifesteal during Pierce the Veil.
While Pierce the Veil is active Muerta permanently gains %spell_amp_steal%%% spell amplification each time she kills an enemy Hero or they die in her vicinity. Bonus applies retroactively.
Muerta will dodge projectiles upon transformation.
Muerta cannot attack buildings while transformed.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_muerta_gunslinger_D: Toggleable. When toggled on, Muerta's attacks have a chance to fire a second shot at another target.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_muerta_gunslinger_F: Gunslinger procs reduce Dead Shot cooldown by %dead_shot_cooldown_reduction_on_proc%s.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_muerta_gunslinger_N: If no other units are in range, she fires both guns at the original target.
Secondary shots can hit units within Muerta's attack range plus %target_search_bonus_range%.
The secondary shot can trigger attack modifiers.
Prioritizes heroes, then non-hero units, then buildings.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_muerta_gunslinger_L: Muerta offers all of her victims Mercy. Some are fortunate enough to also earn Grace.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_muerta_pierce_the_: Ethereal. Attacks deal magical damage instead of physical. Can attack ethereal targets.
Gaining spell amp from kills acquired during Pierce the Veil.
Spell amp percentage gained from kills during Pierce the Veil.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_muerta_dance_of_the_d: The Calling becomes stronger when heroes die inside it.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_muerta_ofrenda_Descri: Muerta can place a beneficial Ofrenda on the map to respawn there instead of the fountain.
DOTA_Tooltip_Facet_muerta_slingshot_Desc:
Dead Shot fears increase Gunslinger chance.

Gunslinger procs reduce Dead Shot cooldown.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_muerta_ofrenda_Desc:
Muerta places a sacred altar at the targeted location that increases her attack speed when she is near it.

When respawning, Muerta will gain the benefits of Pierce The Veil's corporeal form for %pierce_the_veil_duration_pct%%% of the duration and respawn at the Ofrenda.

Muerta can select the Ofrenda and force it to destroy itself. Only one Ofrenda can exist at a time.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_muerta_ofrenda_dam: The nearby Ofrenda is increasing attack speed by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_ATTACKSPEED_BONUS_CONSTANT%.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_muerta_gunslinger_: Quickdraw from a Dead Shot fear. Increased Gunslinger proc chance.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_muerta_ofrenda_dest: Destroy this Ofrenda, ensuring that Muerta will respawn in the fountain.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_muerta_supernatural: Whenever an enemy hero dies within %stack_collection_range% units of Muerta, she gains a stack of %spell_amp_per_stack%%% spell amplification. When Muerta dies she loses half the stacks, rounded down.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_muerta_supernatura: Increased Spell Amplification. Half of the stacks are lost on death.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_muerta_spectral_slu: Muerta shoots a spectral bullet at an enemy, dealing damage, knocking them back, and turning them ethereal for %duration%s - rendering them immune to physical damage and unable to attack. The target is slowed and %bonus_spell_damage_pct%%% more vulnerable to magic damage. Enemies will not be knocked out of Muerta's attack range.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_muerta_spectral_sl: Ethereal. Immune to physical damage. Slowed and taking increased magic damage.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_ringmaster_spotligh: Ringmaster shines %spotlight_count% spotlights that sweep over an area. Enemies in the light have a chance to miss their attacks and are revealed if invisible. Illusions hit by the beam fade away, losing a percentage of their maximum health each second. These effects linger for %linger_duration% seconds after leaving the light.
Are you ready for your fifteen seconds? The limelight draws no distinction between infamy and fame.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_ringmaster_tame_the: CHANNELED - Ringmaster twirls his whip for up to %abilitychanneltime% second then cracks it. Whipped enemies are damaged and flee in fear from Ringmaster. Channel time exponentially increases damage and extends the fear duration, but reduces the radius.
From unhappy crowds to unruly acts, nothing persuades a pack of animals quite like the crack of the Ringmaster's whip.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_ringmaster_the_box_: Ringmaster packs himself or an allied hero into a mobile, extradimensional box. Boxed units gain phased movement, slow resistance, bonus magic resistance, and bonus movement speed. They are also untargetable, muted, silenced, and disarmed. The box will pop open after the effect expires or it moves out of the initial area.
Escape Act has %max_charges% charges. When the box pops open, Impalement Art daggers are thrown in all directions, and all enemies around it take damage.
An adept assistant has nothing to fear within the confines of The Box. An amateur has...much darker prospects indeed.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_ringmaster_wheel_De:
Ringmaster rolls the Wheel of Wonder to the targeted location, knocking aside enemies along the way. After it reaches its target, enemies in range of the wheel take damage over time and are slowed by %aura_slow%%%.

Enemy heroes who face the wheel for more than %face_duration% seconds are mesmerized and drawn towards it. The first enemy to be mesmerized triggers a timer for the wheel to explode. If the timer is not triggered, it will automatically explode after %trap_duration% seconds.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_ringmaster_wheel_Lo: No, brave friends, illusions are for charlatans and card sharks. What you witness today is the power of true magic. But only if you dare set your gaze upon...the mesmerizing wheel.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_ringmaster_impaleme: Ringmaster throws one of his daggers to a precise point of his choosing. If he strikes an enemy, the dagger deals impact damage, briefly slows the unit hit, and causes them to bleed. The bleeding deals a percentage of the victim's maximum health in damage every second to heroes and flat damage per second to creeps.
Passed down through generations, it simply wouldn't be a Kettle Circus without the Great Cogliostro's signature trick.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_ringmaster_empty_so: Gather souvenirs from kills and assists.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_ringmaster_dark_car:
Ringmaster receives a random single-use Dark Carnival Souvenir whenever an enemy hero dies within %souvenir_collection_range% units of him. Additional Souvenirs are held as charges.

If Ringmaster does not have a Souvenir when he dies he will be granted one.
Ringmaster's Souvenirs are Funhouse Mirror, Strongman Tonic, and Whoopee Cushion.
Ringmaster's Souvenirs are Crystal Ball, Unicycle, and Weighted Pie.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_ringmaster_funhouse:
Use: Proportion Distortion

Creates %images_count% imperfect image of your hero that lasts %illusion_duration% seconds. Your illusion deals %tooltip_damage_outgoing_ranged%%% and takes %tooltip_damage_incoming_total_pct%%% damage.
Has a %invuln_duration% second cast time during which you are invulnerable.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_ringmaster_whoopee_:
Use: Whoopsie

Propels your hero forward %leap_distance% units. Leaves a %fart_cloud_radius% radius stink cloud behind for %fart_cloud_duration% seconds that slows enemies by %fart_cloud_slow%%%.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_ringmaster_strongma:
Use: Forcefully Imbibe

DOTA_Tooltip_ability_kez_switch_weapons_: As former followers of the Shodo, the leaders of the Kazurai Order can switch effortlessly between twin disciplines of martial mastery over sai and blade.

Kez switches between his Kazurai Katana and Shodo Sai.

He gains different attack capabilities and abilities based on the weapon equipped. The abilities level up together, and when an ability is used, the associated alternate weapon ability also goes on cooldown.

Kez deals extra damage on the first Katana hit or ability after switching to Katana, and gains bonus speed after switching to Sai.

Casting a weapon ability that would set its alternate weapon ability on cooldown does not do so if it's the first one used within %scepter_cooldown_timer% seconds after casting Switch Discipline or if it was already on cooldown.

Casting any weapon ability refreshes the cooldown of Switch Discipline.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_kez_switch_weapons: Gaining %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_TOOLTIP%%% bonus katana damage on the next attack.
Gaining %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_TOOLTIP%%% bonus movement speed with Sai
The next ability Kez casts will not set its alternate weapon ability on cooldown.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_kez_echo_slash_Desc: Kez slashes forward in a %katana_distance% distance line with his Katana, attacking enemies in an area and applying a brief %tag_slow%%% impact slow. After a short delay, the area is attacked again. Heroes take bonus damage.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_kez_echo_slash_Lore: Kez and his master Kraw have worked tirelessly to train the Kazurai new ways to keep the flyers off balance by improving upon ancient techniques.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_kez_grappling_claw_: Kez swings on a grappling hook towards the target unit or tree.  When the grappling hook collides with the target, that unit has slowed movement speed. Upon reaching the enemy target, Kez lands an attack on them.
The Kazurai have the speed and reach to drag even the highest flyers from the skies.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_kez_kazurai_katana_: To fight back against the reach of Imperia and her Queensguard, the Kazurai had to become skilled in the ways of attrition.

Katana attacks and abilities apply a stacking damage over time to enemies that deals a percentage of the original attack's damage as additional damage over time.

Kez may activate the ability to impale the target with his attack, preventing them from moving or turning. The target's Katana debuff bursts, causing some of the stacks to deal damage instantly.
Kez lifesteals %lifesteal_pct%%% from the impale. If the impale comes from behind the target, the target is stunned. Increases max burst stacks.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_kez_raptor_dance_Lo: Unleash the inner fury of the Flightless to feast on the essence of your foes.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_kez_raptor_dance_De:
Kez enters into an uncontrollable state for %AbilityCastPoint% second, becoming invulnerable for %invuln_period%s and receiving a basic dispel.

If the cast completes successfully, Kez performs a series of deadly radial slashes around him that deal damage based on the max health of the target and heal Kez for a percentage of all damage dealt.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_kez_raptor_dance_No: Slash Lifesteal is reduced to %illusion_lifesteal_pct%%% when slashing a creep or an illusion.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_kez_falcon_rush_Lor: An ancient Shodo technique used to hunt faster aerial foes, stealing the advantage and delivering multiple attacks within a single flap of their prey's panicking wings.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_kez_falcon_rush_Des: Kez gains the ability to rush towards enemy targets to deliver echoing secondary attacks.  While in this state, Kez has phased collision and slow resistance.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_kez_falcon_rush_De: Gaining the ability to rush towards enemies and deliver an echoing attack.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_kez_talon_toss_Lore: The Shodo learned to rely upon distance and disorientation to survive against much stronger opposition.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_kez_talon_toss_Desc: Kez throws a Sai at the target unit, applying a fixed damage attack and silence.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_kez_talon_toss_Note: The fixed damage attack has True Strike.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_kez_shodo_sai_Lore: The Shodo may have lost their way, but Kez and the Kazurai can still use Shodo knowledge for the good of the people.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_kez_shodo_sai_Descr:
Kez has a chance to critically strike the target when attacking with Sais.

Kez may activate the ability to disarm himself, lock his facing, and parry attacks and attack effects from the targeted direction for %parry_duration% seconds. If an attack is parried from an enemy Hero in this way, that Hero is stunned for %parry_stun_duration%s and gains a Mark. When a Marked target is attacked by Kez, it will guarantee a critical strike and stun the target.

The sub-ability may be used to cancel the blocking early.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_kez_shodo_sai_shard: Parrying creates a stronger Mark that deals additional stun and critical damage.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_kez_shodo_sai_parr: Blocking physical attacks from the front. If any attack is blocked or evaded, the enemy is Marked with additional critical strike and stun.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_kez_shodo_sai_mark: Kez's next attack or ability damage will trigger a critical strike and a stun.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_kez_ravens_veil_Lor: Eying either threat or opportunity, Shodo masters slip instantly into shadow to reset the terms of any engagement in their own favor.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_kez_ravens_veil_Des: Kez releases a wave of smoke that applies his Mark to nearby enemy heroes, briefly reducing their vision. Kez receives a basic dispel and gains bonus movement speed and invisibility until he attacks or casts a spell.

DOTA_Tooltip_ability_largo_amphibian_rha: The very first Bard Monk played a song that summoned a living island and saved the Murkroot exiles from a salt-worn death.

Largo gets ready to groove. He is disarmed and his ability bar switches to 3 song abilities, each with different effects. Songs are only effective if strummed on the beat.

Every time he strums successfully, he gains a stack of Groovin'. Each stack gives him bonus armor and reduces the mana cost of every song, but he loses a stack if he misses a beat. Stacks linger for a short duration when Largo's song ends.
Largo can play two songs per beat by strumming both at the same time.
Items can be used while in this mode.

DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_boots_Descript: Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_boots_of_elves: A tensile fabric often used for its light weight and ease of movement.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_bottle_Descrip:
Active: Regenerate

Consumes a charge to restore %health_restore% health and %mana_restore% mana over %restore_time% seconds. If the hero is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.

The Bottle automatically refills at the fountain.

Hold Control to use on an allied hero.

Passive: Store Rune

Runes can be stored in the Bottle for later use by right-clicking them. Unused runes will automatically activate after 90 seconds.

Using a stored rune fully refills the Bottle.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_bottle_Lore: An old bottle that survived the ages, the contents placed inside become enchanted.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_bottle_Note0: Bottle is shareable. Stored runes cannot be shared.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_bottle_Note1: Using a stored Bounty or Water rune fully refills the bottle if the bottle was full when the rune was stored; otherwise, it refills two charges.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_bottle_regeneratio: Regenerating %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_HEALTH_REGEN_CONSTANT% HP and %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_MANA_REGEN_CONSTANT% mana per second.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_bracer_Lore: The bracer is a common choice to toughen up defenses and increase longevity.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_branches_Descr:
Use: Plant Tree

Targets the ground to plant a happy little tree that lasts for %tree_duration% seconds.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_branches_Lore: A seemingly ordinary branch, its ironlike qualities are bestowed upon the bearer.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_broadsword_Lor: The classic weapon of choice for knights, this blade is sturdy and reliable for slaying enemies.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_buckler_Descri:
Passive: Buckler Aura

Grants %bonus_aoe_armor% armor to allied player units.

Radius: %bonus_aoe_radius%
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_buckler_Lore: A powerful shield that imbues the bearer with the strength of heroes past, it is capable of protecting entire armies in battle.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_butterfly_Note: Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_butterfly_Lore: Only the mightiest and most experienced of warriors can wield the Butterfly, but it provides incredible dexterity in combat.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_chainmail_Lore: A medium weave of metal chains.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_cheese_Descrip:
Use: Fondue

Instantly restores %health_restore% health and %mana_restore% mana.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_cheese_Lore: Made from the milk of a long lost Furbolg vendor, it restores the vitality of those who taste it.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_item_refresher_shar:
Use: Reset Cooldowns

Resets the cooldowns of all your abilities. Shares a cooldown with Refresher Orb. This item's cooldown only progresses in your hero's main inventory.
Across an epoch of endless battle, the Immortal's will to triumph never faltered.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_circlet_Lore: An elegant circlet designed for human princesses.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_fluffy_hat_Lor: Fine and functional foppery for the fashion-forward fighter.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_falcon_blade_L: An enchanted blade that long ago raised a hopeless urchin from pauper to king.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_mage_slayer_De:
Passive: Mage Slayer

Places a debuff when you attack enemies, dealing %dps% physical damage per second and causing them to do %spell_amp_debuff%%% less spell damage for %duration% seconds.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_mage_slayer_Lo: Forged by a secret order in The Third Age of Praxa'cia to fell the False King.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_item_mage_slayer_d: Dealing %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_TOOLTIP%%% less spell damage and taking physical damage over time.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_crown_Lore: A stately crown created to ensure a well-meaning but ungifted heir could fend off usurpers and govern with a strong hand.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_diadem_Lore: A crown that can never be removed.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_clarity_Descri:
Use: Replenish

Grants %mana_regen% mana regeneration to the target for %buff_duration% seconds.

If the unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_clarity_Lore: Clear water that enhances the ability to meditate.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_faerie_fire_Lo: The ethereal flames from the ever-burning ruins of Kindertree ignite across realities.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_infused_raindr:
Passive: Magical Damage Block

Consumes a charge to block %magic_damage_block% magic damage from damage instances over %min_damage% damage.

Comes with %initial_charges% charges. When the charges are gone, the item disappears.
Uses at most one charge per damage instance.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_bloodthorn_Des:
Active: Soul Rend

Silences a target for %silence_duration% seconds. At the end of the silence, an additional %silence_damage_percent%%% of all damage taken during the silence will be dealt to the target as magical damage.

All attacks on the silenced target will deal additional damage equal to %proc_damage_heroes% if the attacker is a hero, and %proc_damage_creeps%, if the attacker is a creep. Provides True Strike for your attacks and attacks from your controlled units against the silenced target.

Passive: Pierce

Grants each attack a %proc_chance%%% chance to pierce through evasion and deal %passive_proc_damage% bonus magical damage.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_bloodthorn_Lor: A reviled blade that bites deeper with each wriggle of its victim's final throes.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_bloodthorn_debuff_:
Silenced and taking 60%% increased damage, dealt at the end of the duration of the debuff as magic damage.
Causes all incoming attacks to deal extra damage and have True Strike.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_item_echo_sabre_Des:
Passive: Echo Strike

Causes melee attacks to attack twice in quick succession. The double attacks apply a %movement_slow%%% movement slow for %slow_duration% seconds on the first strike.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_item_echo_sabre_Lor: A deceptively swift blade imbued with resonant magic.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_item_blight_stone_D:
Passive: Lesser Corruption

Your attacks reduce the target's armor by %corruption_armor% for %corruption_duration% seconds.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_item_blight_stone_L: An unnerving stone unearthed beneath the Fields of Endless Carnage.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_item_blight_stone_N: Does not stack with its upgrades, Desolator, or Stygian Desolator.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_item_wind_lace_Desc: Bonuses from multiple Wind Laces do not stack.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_item_wind_lace_Lore: Hasten to battle on wind-touched heels.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_item_tome_of_knowle:
Use: Enlighten

Grants you %xp_bonus% experience plus %xp_per_use% per tome consumed by your team after the first two.

Tomes Used By Team: %customval_team_tomes_used%
That which raises beast to man and man to god.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_item_tome_of_knowl: Immediately grants 700 experience plus 135 per tome previously consumed by your team.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_dragon_lance_N: Attack Range bonuses from Monkey King Bar and Dragon Lance and its upgrades do not stack.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_dragon_lance_L: The forward charge of the wyvern host grants no quarter.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_item_hurricane_pike:
Active: Hurricane Thrust

Pushes you and target enemy %enemy_length% units away from each other, and for %range_duration% seconds, allows you to make %max_attacks% attacks against the target without range restrictions and with +%bonus_attack_speed% attack speed.

Can be cast on self or allies to push the target %push_length% units in the direction it is facing.
Enemy Range: %cast_range_enemy%
A legendary pike once held as royal sigil of the ancient wyvern riders.
Self-cast will use Hurricane Pike on yourself.
Hurricane Pike doesn't interrupt the target's actions.
Will not work on a unit inside Chronosphere, Duel, or Black Hole.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_hurricane_pike: Attack Range bonuses from Monkey King Bar and Dragon Lance and its upgrades do not stack.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_item_hurricane_pik: Can attack the target without range restrictions.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_aether_lens_No: Cast Range bonuses from Aether Lens and Dagon do not stack.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_aether_lens_Lo: Polished with the incantation of his final breath, the gift of a dying mage to his sickly son.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_claymore_Lore: A sword that can cut through armor, it's a commonly chosen first weapon for budding swordsmen.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_cloak_Lore: A cloak made of a magical material that works to dispel any magic cast on it.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_cloak_Note0: Stacks multiplicatively with other sources of magic resistance.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_shawl_Note0: Stacks multiplicatively with other sources of magic resistance.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_cyclone_Descri:
Active: Cyclone

Sweeps a target unit up into a cyclone, making them invulnerable for %cyclone_duration% seconds. Cyclone can only be cast on enemy units or yourself.

Enemy units take %tooltip_drop_damage% magical damage upon landing.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_cyclone_Lore: A mysterious scepter passed down through the ages, its disruptive winds can be used for good or evil.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_cyclone_Note1: Cyclones cast on yourself go through spell immunity.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_cyclone_Note2: Cyclone can dispel some buffs and debuffs.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_cyclone_Note3: Cyclone duration is unaffected by status resistance.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_wind_waker_Des:
Active: Cyclone

Sweeps a target unit up into a cyclone, making them invulnerable for %cyclone_duration% seconds. Cyclone can be cast on yourself, enemy units or allied units. When cast on yourself, you can move the tornado at a speed of %tornado_speed%.

Enemy units take %tooltip_drop_damage% magical damage upon landing.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_wind_waker_Lor: Proof enough to some that unseen forces manipulate the happenings of the material plane.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_wind_waker_Not: Cyclone can dispel some buffs and debuffs.
When cast on yourself, the cyclone can be moved anywhere at a speed of 360.
Cyclone duration is unaffected by status resistance.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_wind_waker_Descrip: Swept up in a cyclone, you are invulnerable and unable to act.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_eul_cyclone_Descri: Swept up in a cyclone, you are invulnerable and unable to act.

DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_desolator_Desc:
Passive: Corruption

Your attacks reduce the target's armor by %corruption_armor% for %corruption_duration% seconds.

Passive: Soul Stealer

Desolator gains +%bonus_damage_per_kill% damage every time an enemy hero dies while affected by Corruption, to a maximum of %max_damage%.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_desolator_Lore: A wicked weapon, used in torturing political criminals.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_desolator_buff_Des: Desolator attacks reduced your armor by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_PHYSICAL_ARMOR_BONUS%.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_diffusal_blade:
Active: Inhibit

Targets an enemy, slowing it for %purge_slow_duration% seconds.

Passive: Manabreak

Each attack burns %feedback_mana_burn% mana from the target, and deals %damage_per_burn% physical damage per burned mana.

Illusions do not burn mana.
Does not stack with other diffusal blades.
An enchanted blade that allows the user to cut straight into the enemy's soul.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_disperser_Desc:
Active: Suppress

Dispels both the wearer and the target. Enemy targets are slowed for %enemy_effect_duration% seconds. Allied targets gain bonus movespeed and %slow_resist%%% slow resistance for %ally_effect_duration% seconds. Caster is always granted the ally benefit on cast.

Both movement speed reduction and increase start at %phase_movement_speed%%% and gradually decrease to 0% over the course of the buff duration.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

Passive: Manabreak

Each attack burns %feedback_mana_burn% mana from the target, and deals %damage_per_burn% physical damage per burned mana.

Illusions do not burn mana.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_disperser_Lore: Once entrusted to an Apostle General of the Rumusque Faithful's expeditionary force.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_item_harpoon_Descri:
Active: Draw Forth

When targeting an enemy, fire a harpoon at them, that pulls you and the target closer together, up to %pull_distance_pct%%% of the distance between you and your target. If the caster is melee, the hero and target are always pulled to within melee distance of each other. Targeting a tree always pulls you all the way to that tree.

Passive: Echo Strike

Causes melee attacks to attack twice in quick succession. The double attacks apply a %movement_slow%%% movement slow for %slow_duration% seconds on the first strike. Echo Strike cooldown: %passive_cooldown%s
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_item_harpoon_Lore: A perfect solution for the flight of foes.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_item_phylactery_Des:
Passive: Empower Spell

The next Unit Target spell you cast on an enemy deals a separate %bonus_spell_damage% bonus damage to the target and slows them by %slow%%% for %slow_duration%s.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_item_phylactery_Lor: An amulet overflowing with powerful magics.
DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_item_angels_demise_:
Passive: Empower Spell

The next Unit Target spell you cast on an enemy deals a separate %bonus_spell_damage% additional damage, disables their passives, and slows their movement speed by %slow%%% for %slow_duration%s.
A blade sharp enough to slice through magic itself.
The break debuff is not dispellable.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_dust_Descripti:
Use: Reveal

For %duration% seconds, creates an area that reveals and slows invisible heroes by %movespeed%%% in a %radius% radius where the caster was standing. Invisible units revealed by dust take %damage% damage.

The debuff effect on enemies lingers for %linger_duration%s after leaving the area of effect.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_dust_Note0: Places a debuff on enemy units in the area that reveals them when they are invisible.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_dust_Lore: One may hide visage, but never volume.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_item_dustofappeara: Can be seen by enemies and slowed when invisible. Slowed by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_MOVESPEED_BONUS_PERCENTAGE%%%.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_eagle_Lore: Capturing the majestic call of an eagle, this mystical horn brings limitless dexterity to those who hear it.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_energy_booster: This lapis gemstone is commonly added to the collection of wizards seeking to improve their presence in combat.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_ethereal_blade:
Active: Ether Blast

Converts the target unit to ethereal form, rendering them immune to physical damage, but unable to attack and %ethereal_damage_bonus%%% more vulnerable to magic damage.

Enemy targets are also slowed by %blast_movement_slow%%%, and take %blast_stat_multiplier%x the sum of all your attributes + %blast_damage_base% as magical damage.
Duration: %duration% seconds
Shares cooldown with Ghost Scepter and its upgrades.
Ethereal units take %ethereal_damage_bonus%%% bonus magic damage.
A flickering blade of a ghastly nature, it is capable of dealing damage in both magical and physical planes.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_item_ethereal_blad: Ethereal Form. Taking %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_MAGICAL_RESISTANCE_DECREPIFY_UNIQUE%%% increased magic damage and cannot attack or be attacked.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_flask_Descript:
Use: Salve

Grants %health_regen% health regeneration to the target for %buff_duration% seconds.

If the unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.

Heals for half the amount per second when cast on an ally.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_flask_Lore: A magical salve that can quickly mend even the deepest of wounds.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_force_staff_De:
Active: Force

Pushes any target unit %push_length% units in the direction it is facing.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_force_staff_Lo: Allows you to manipulate others, for good or evil.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_force_staff_No: Self-cast will cause you to use Force on yourself.
Force Staff doesn't interrupt the target's actions.
Will not work on a unit inside Chronosphere, Duel, or Black Hole.
Force Staff has %enemy_cast_range% cast range when cast on enemies.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_gauntlets_Lore: Studded leather gloves that add brute strength.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_gem_Descriptio:
Active: Reveal

Gives True Sight over a %active_radius% radius revealing wards and units even in Fog of War.

Passive: True Sight

Grants the ability to see invisible units and wards to any allied vision within %radius% range of its carrier.

Passive: Everlasting

Dropped on death, and cannot be destroyed.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_gem_Lore:
Not one thrall creature of the depths,
Nor spirit bound in drowning's keep,
Nor Maelrawn the Tentacular,
Shall rest till seas, gem comes to sleep.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_ghost_Descript:
Active: Ghost Form

You enter ghost form for %duration% seconds, becoming immune to physical damage, but are unable to attack and %extra_spell_damage_percent%%% more vulnerable to magic damage.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_ghost_Note0: Ends if you become Debuff Immune, and will have no effect if you are already Debuff Immune.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_ghost_Note1: Shares cooldown with all Ghost Scepter upgrades.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_ghost_Lore: Imbues the wielder with a ghostly presence, allowing them to evade physical damage.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_ghost_state_Descri: Ethereal Form. Taking %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_MAGICAL_RESISTANCE_DECREPIFY_UNIQUE%%% increased magic damage and cannot attack or be attacked.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_crellas_crozie:

You enter ghost form for %duration% seconds, becoming immune to physical damage, but are unable to attack and %extra_spell_damage_percent%%% more vulnerable to magic damage.

Steal %movespeed_steal_pct%%% movement speed from enemy heroes in %active_radius% range every second. Movement speed steal lasts %stack_duration%s.

Putrefaction Aura's effect is increased to %active_health_steal%%%. All of the lost Health Restoration is redirected to you every second.

Passive: Putrefaction Aura

Reduces nearby enemy heroes' Health Restoration by %health_steal%%%.

DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_item_crellas_crozi: Stealing movement speed from nearby enemy heroes. Nearby enemy heroes' Health Restoration is partially redirected to the wielder.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_gloves_Lore: A pair of magical gloves that seems to render weapons weightless.

DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_greater_crit_N: Critical Strike does not work against buildings.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_greater_crit_L: A weapon of incredible power that is difficult for even the strongest of warriors to control.

Active: Transmute

Kills a non-hero target for %bonus_gold% gold. Killing a neutral creep additionally grants a madstone bundle.

Cannot be used on Ancient creeps.
Preserved through unknown magical means, the Hand of Midas is a weapon of greed, sacrificing animals to line the owner's pockets.

DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_headdress_Lore: Creates a soothing aura that restores allies in battle.

Your health regeneration is increased by %missing_health_regen%%% of your missing health.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_heart_Note0: Multiple instances of Behemoth's Blood do not stack.
DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_heart_Lore: Preserved heart of an extinct monster, it bolsters the bearer's fortitude.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_item_heart_active_: Health Regeneration increased by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_HEALTH_REGEN_PERCENTAGE%%% of max health.

Takes control of one neutral, non-ancient target unit and sets its movement speed to %speed_base% and max health to a minimum of %health_min%. Also provides the unit with +%creep_bonus_damage% base attack damage, +%creep_bonus_hp_regen% health regen, +%creep_bonus_mp_regen% mana regen and +%creep_bonus_armor% armor.

DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_consecrated_wr:
Passive: Hallowed

Gain a charge every %AbilityChargeRestoreTime%s, up to a maximum of %AbilityCharges% charges. Upon gaining a charge, your movement speed is increased by %movement_speed_pct_on_stack_gain%%% for %duration%s.

Charges cannot be gained for %AbilityChargeRestoreTime%s after you take damage from a player-controlled source or Roshan.
Self-damage and HP Loss damage cannot remove charges.
Movement speed buff does not stack.
DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_item_consecrated_w: After taking damage, remove all Charges to gain an all damage barrier.

DOTA_ReactiveHintBody_TowerDamage: Towers do A LOT of damage - if you take even a few hits from them you might need to return to the fountain and heal. It's better to fight near the tower only when your creeps are already attacking it.
DOTA_ReactiveHintBody_Death: When you die you will respawn at your fountain. The time to respawn gets higher as you level so it's imperative that you try to NEVER DIE. If you are low on health then return to the fountain to heal.

DOTA_Tutorial_Minimap_Side_Subtitle: You can change this at any time in the Settings menu
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_IntroRazor: I bring the spark of death!
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_Move: Hey, you! Dragon Knight, over here!
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_MoveHow: Right Click to move where you want to go. Move to the highlighted location.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_MoveCam: We need your help!  Across the bridge! Head north, and follow the path.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_MoveCamHow: You can move the camera in several ways: - Move your mouse to the edge of the screen. - By holding down your Middle Mouse button and dragging.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_MoveCamHowNoEdge: You can move the camera in several ways: - With the %+forward% %+moveleft% %back% %+moveright% keys. - By holding down your Middle Mouse button and dragging.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_Warning: Dragon Knight! Our old enemy Razor is attacking our outposts. Keeper of the Light already went after him. He said to send you along when you showed up.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_Attack: Attack this Dire creep by right clicking on him. Kill him! Kill him!
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_AttackWave: More creeps! Lend your sword, Dragon Knight!
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_Camp: Dragon Knight, follow us to the watchtower. Protect us! There may be more enemy creeps on the way.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_CampLevel: Hey, you gained a level! You're getting even stronger.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_CampLevelHint: Click the LEVEL UP button above your portrait and select your first ability, Breathe Fire.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_CampInvade: More creeps!  Quick, cast Breathe Fire on them!  Burn them!  Burn them!
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_CampUseBreath: Hit your %dota_ability_execute 0% key to starting casting Breathe Fire, and then Left Click on an enemy to target it!
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_CampFinish: You saved us! That's why you're a hero and we're just creeps. We'll hold this watchtower. Press on and find Keeper of the Light, so you can team up to fight Razor.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_ShopAttract: Ah, Dragon Knight! A true hero!
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_ShopOpen: Greetings, my friend, and welcome to my shop. Hit %toggleshoppanel% to open and close the shop menu. Allow me to make a few recommendations. For you, I suggest a Healing Salve and perhaps, hmm, yes...a Stout Shield. I believe you have just enough gold.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_BuyShield: Right click on the Stout Shield to purchase it. The Stout Shield can be found under the Armaments tab.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_InspectShield: The Stout Shield is a passive item, so you need not activate it to gain its benefit. Mouse over the shield in your inventory to view its bonuses. Purchase the Healing Salve when you're ready to proceed. It can be found under the Consumables tab.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_UsePotion: Healing Salves are Active Items, meaning they must be activated in order to use them. Left-click on the Salve in your inventory to get a targeting cursor, then left-click on yourself to apply it. Try it now to see how it works.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_PostPotion: Be careful. If you take damage while that salve works its magic, the healing will come to an end.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_BuyClarity: Buy a Clarity potion too which will allow you to regenerate mana quickly for a period of time. Like with the Healing Salve, the regeneration will stop if you take damage before its work is done.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_UseClarity: Now use the Clarity and regain your mana. Instead of clicking on it, try hitting %!item_clarity% to use it - each inventory slot has a key assigned to it. Hitting %!item_clarity% twice will immediately use it on yourself. After using it, you'll see the regeneration buff icon above your healthbar. You can mouse over a buff icon to see a description of the effects.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_GoCreepingFollow: Since you ask, I spotted several neutral creep camps in the woods to the south. There's a fair bounty on their heads.  I'll show you where to start looking.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_GoCreeping: Well done, Sir Knight. Now I have another item in mind for the battle ahead, but you'll need to earn a bit more gold first. Roquelaire, where might our knightly friend find some lucrative work for his sword?
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_CreepLevel: You've earned another level! Click the LEVEL UP button and select Dragon Blood. This ability increases your armor, which reduces damage done by enemy attacks, and improves your health regeneration.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_CreepLevelForce: Don't forget to level up! Click the LEVEL UP button and select Dragon Blood. This skill improves health regeneration and armor reducing damage done by the enemy.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_GoldEarned: That's gold aplenty, Dragon Knight!  Return to the merchant and let's put it to good use.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_CreepingAllDead: Well done!  You've earned gold aplenty and destroyed the threat.  Let's return to the merchant and see about that new item.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_BuyGauntlets: You're back! And with fresh coin from clearing those dens. It is my pleasure to offer you the repeat-customer price on these Gauntlets of Strength. Remember you can open the store by pressing %toggleshoppanel%.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_BoughtGauntlets: I have more fine items for you, Sir knight. But as before, you will need more gold.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_KeeperIntro: Ah, now if it isn't my old friend Dragon Knight! We've had ourselves a bit of a dust-up with invading creeps, so if you'll lend us your sword arm, I'll keep you supplied in mana.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_LastHitIntro: There's a Circlet in the shop to further boost your attributes. I spotted a battle to the west where we can earn enough gold to purchase that Circlet.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_LastHitHowTo: In battle, you need to strike the Last Hit on a creep to earn gold. Too early or too late, and you get nothing!
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_LastHitReminder: Remember it's the killing blow that matters. You only earn gold by striking the Last Hit on a creep.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_LastHitGold185: Well done, you've earned enough gold for the Circlet. Let's return to the merchant, shall we?
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_LastHitCirclet: Welcome back! Buy the Circlet to further boost your attributes. Why don't you slip into it? Move your mouse over the attributes next to your portrait to see the benefits of your purchase.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_LastHitBracer: Surely you'll need more before you face Razor though. I'd recommend some Bracers. Bracers are an Upgraded Item, which requires one or more items and a Recipe. Return when you've earned 210 gold and I'll show you what you need to do.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_LastHitAgain: Once more to battle, Dragon Knight!
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_LastHitAttack: Last hit! Remember to time your swings! Moving in midswing to cancel an attack is a good way of timing a Last Hit.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_LastHitGold190: You've earned enough gold to buy the Bracers! Let us seek out the merchant and make use of your coin.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_LastHitRecipe: Ah, the knight returns! Keep in mind that some items are crafted in combination. In this case, you own the Circlet and Gauntlets which can be crafted into Bracers. Open the shop and click Upgrades. Left-click on the Bracers to display all the required items to craft the bracer.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_LastHitRecipeBuy: The items required for the Bracers show up near the bottom of the shop window. You already have two of them so all you need is the Recipe which can be purchased automatically by right-clicking the Bracer. You can also buy the recipe directly.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_LastHitComplete: Beautiful! Your Circlet and Gauntlets have been combined to create the upgraded Bracer, which will provide greater attributes, and free up space in your inventory.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_UltBegin: One more thing, you should reach level six to access your Ultimate ability, Elder Dragon Form to take on Razor. Let's find some creeps and level up!
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_DragonTail: Ah, you're level five! Choose your Dragon Tail skill, and try it out on some creeps. It's a short ranged Stun that'll make it easy for you to smite enemy Heroes.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_UseDragonTail: Hit your %dota_ability_execute 1% key to start casting Dragon Tail, and then Left Click on an enemy to stun them!
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_UltLevel: That'll do it! Level up and choose your Ultimate ability, Elder Dragon Form.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_RazorBegin: I smell a spark in the air...Razor is coming! Use your Elder Dragon Form to prepare for the fight!
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_RazorDead: Well, done, noble Knight.  You've defeated Razor!
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_LaneTip_1: You earn experience by being near an enemy that falls in battle. Only the last hit is required to earn gold.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_LaneTip_2: Stay behind your creeps and let them engage the enemy first.  This is a good way to avoid damage.
DOTA_Tutorial_M1_LaneTip_3: Let your creeps lower the enemy creep's health and then move in to strike the last hit.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_Intro: Sniper! I found you! The base is in danger, and we need your help. Tidehunter was spotted with some creeps trying to wear down our defenses.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_TangoIntro: Oh, you're a bit low on health. Here, take these Tangoes. I've got extras.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_TangoUse: You can use tangoes to heal. Hit %!item_tango% and then left click on a tree.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_TangoRestore:
Using a tango will increase the rate at which your health is restored for a short period.

Let's go!
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_RangedCreep: Remember, your ranged weapon allows you to take cover behind your creeps and do damage from a safe distance.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_RangedLevelTwo: There's probably more where he came from. Explore a bit and see what turns up. The more you fight, the more experience you'll earn to reach level two.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_AreaAssign: You showed them! Go ahead and level up Shrapnel when you have a chance.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_AreaLearn: Shrapnel is an Area of Effect ability. It will do damage to enemies caught within its radius.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_AreaUse: Sniper! Use Shrapnel by hitting %dota_ability_execute 0% and left-click to cast it on these guys!
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_AreaFriendly: Don't worry, Shrapnel won't hurt allies.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_TowerHelp: Over here! Our tower is in danger! Tidehunter is coming and we can't hold him off. Help us! Help us!
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_MapIntro: Here's a map with the tower location!
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_MapExplain: The mini map contains a lot of useful information. You'll be able to see your position, as well as the location of towers and creeps. It'll even show where your enemies are, provided allied forces have vision of them.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_TowerLevel: During the fray you earned another level. Level up your Headshot to give yourself a chance to stop your enemy in their tracks.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_TowerRetreat: If you find yourself under attack, try moving behind your creeps, and let them protect you.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_TowerThanks: Wow, that was close. Thanks, Sniper. Tidehunter was giving us a tough time, but it looks like he was low on health, and you scared him off.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_TowerLevelAny: You've gained another level.  Go ahead and level up and choose a skill.  Read the tool tips to learn what each one does and pick one.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_TowerExplain: Good thing we had this tower helping to defend against the enemy. Towers are important to defense. If today's been any indication, there's likely more creeps sneaking around.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_StashBuyBoots: We earned a bit of gold off of those creeps. Did you know you can buy items when not at a shop? When purchased, they'll be held for you in your stash so you can pick them up later. Open the shop with %toggleshoppanel% and buy the Boots of Speed.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_StashViewStash: Notice that the Boots of Speed have been placed in your stash. The stash shows you items you have stored back at the base. Mouse over the Boots of Speed in your Stash to see what they'll do once you retrieve them.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_StashBuyRing: While we're at it, a little armor would be nice, so why not buy a Ring of Protection. Armor reduces damage from attacks.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_StashGo: The base isn't far from here, let's retrieve your items!
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_StashRetrieve: Ahh, welcome back Sniper. I've a couple items set aside for you here in your stash. Whenever you're inside the base you can pick up your items. Hit the Grab All button on the stash to transfer any items in your stash to your inventory.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_CourierBuy: While you're here, pick up a Courier as well. Couriers are great for bringing items to you while in the field, but more on that later. Purchase a Courier to continue.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_CourierDeploy: The Courier, like a Salve, is an active item and must be deployed before you can use it. Deploy the Courier by hitting %!item_courier%.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_CourierComplete: It looked like Tidehunter was low on health.  Perhaps there's a way you can fend him off once and for all.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_LevelUp: Low health? Your ultimate ability, Assassinate, is perfect as it does a lot of damage! Heroes learn their ultimate ability at level six. We'll need more experience though. Lead the way northeast. Better leave the courier here, we don't need the little guy just yet.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_BridgeSmoke: Hey Sniper, I spotted something at the bridge nearby.  Let's check it out.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_BridgeOut: Tidehunter got away. He was out of range of your normal attacks but your ultimate ability has much longer range. We'll need more experience... Oh! This way!
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_SecretGo: There's a Secret Shop over there! Let's check it out.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_SecretExplain: Oh! A customer! The Secret Shop stocks items you can't buy at the base. Why not try upgrading your Boots of Speed to Arcane Boots? To do so you'll need an Energy Booster.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_UpgradeBoots: Just like that, you've crafted yourself Arcane Boots by combining two items! While not the perfect item for every hero, right now, these look good on you. Arcane Boots are an active item, try it out now by pressing %!item_arcane_boots%.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_UpgradeComplete: We should press on and find more places to earn experience.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_PullBegin: Spotted more here! Try shooting them once to get their attention and pull them towards your creeps by running back here. Allow your creeps to help take them out!
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_CourierBuyItem1: All that gold. Time for upgrades! Let's upgrade your ring to a Ring of Basilius! Open the shop with %toggleshoppanel% and purchase the Sage's Mask.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_CourierRetrieve: Remember our courier? We can use him to retrieve items from the stash and bring them to us here. That way we don't need to return to base every time we buy something! Click the Deliver Items button near the bottom corner to continue.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_CourierTravel: The courier is off!  The mask was automatically transferred from your stash onto the courier and is on its way.  You can check on the status of the courier by looking at the mini map.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_RingUpgraded: Nice! The Sage's Mask combined with your Ring of Protection to create Ring of Basilius. This item can boost the armor of allied creeps. For now, let's turn it off. Hit %!item_ring_of_basilius% to toggle the aura off.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_LevelExperience: The ring's aura no longer affects friendly creeps but it still provides a bonus to you. Time to find a few more creeps and earn that experience to reach level six.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_LevelUlt: Well done! Level up and learn Assassinate when you have a chance.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_TeleportBlock: A rock slide blocked our way back. Suspicious. We're not completely stranded though. We can teleport our way out of here! To do that we'll need to upgrade the courier to a Flying Courier. Upgrade the courier through the shop.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_TeleportBuy: Now you need a Town Portal Scroll from the shop.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_TeleportCourier: Now have the courier bring it to you using the Deliver Items button.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_TeleportChannel: With the courier on its way, there's something you need to know about teleporting. Town Portal Scroll is a channeled spell, meaning you need to stand still while using it. If you move, it will cancel the cast.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_TeleportUse: You can teleport to any building, but we should head to the tower outside the base where we last saw Tidehunter. Use the Town Portal Scroll by hitting %!item_tpscroll% and then left-click the tower on the minimap.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_TeleportCenter: Center the view on yourself by double tapping %+dota_camera_follow% or by left-clicking the minimap. I better get a move on!
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_TeleportCancel: Woops!  Moving cancelled the channeled teleport.  This also consumes the Town Portal Scroll, so we'll need a new one.  Buy a new Town Portal Scroll from the shop and have the courier bring it to you.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_TeleportWrongLoc: The tower is represented by a green square. Try using the Town Portal Scroll again and left-click near the green square. You can usually teleport to any building but right now we should get close to where we last saw Tidehunter.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_KillTide: Hopefully, Tidehunter is still lurking.  Follow me to where we last spotted him, and maybe we can get the jump on him!
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_KillTideHow: Time to get to work. Use Assassinate by pressing %dota_ability_execute 5% and then clicking on Tidehunter.
DOTA_Tutorial_M2_KillTideComplete: Pow!  You did it! He won't be bothering us anymore.  Our base is now safe!
