DOTA_Item_Desc_Global_Amateur_tournament: 32 amateur teams will compete for a prize fund of 35,000 rubles. Unique group stage, teams worthy, worthy of the prize fund. Let there be war!
DOTA_Item_Desc_Global_Grand_Masters_by_P: 12 total teams will fight in this event to claim the $50.000 total prize pool. 8 team will be invited to the closed qualifier 4 will survive and face against the 4 directly invited team.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Global_eSports_Cup_LAN_Fi: Game Show Global eSports Cup is the first of three seasons with a prizepool of 1.000.000 USD. All regions battle in various stages until 8 teams meet eachother in the Game Show Studio LAN Vilnius. The best 4 will move on to fight on Dreamhack Moscow to enter the Grand Final for 250.000 USD
DOTA_Item_Desc_Gloom_Dota_Season_3: 16 semi-pro teams will participate in the third season of Gloom Dota for a total prize pool of 3000 Rubles!
DOTA_Item_Desc_Gloomblade: Beware the gloom, for it is ever the friend an assassin's ally.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Gloombob: "Ok. Listen up, new guy. Jex says you can pull your weight while he's away. He better not be wrong. For your sake. And, no, I don't care what your real name is. I'm not gonna learn how to say it anyway."
DOTA_Item_Desc_Gloried_Horn_of_Druud: Encorselled by Elder Greyhoofs at the Clanfounding, a single note from this horn can call forth the great hordes of Druud to do battle at the end of all times. Bradwarden the Warrunner and vanguard of the Druud clans protects the horn and will, at the appointed hour, summon his brothers and sisters to make a final apocalyptic war.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Gloves_of_Retribution: Those who stand against the Skywrath can expect no mercy when Dragonus has them in his grip.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Gloves_of_the_Admirable_A: Fine white gloves of silk. Noble clothing like this serves to set the Captain above his crew and to also motivate them with the promise of hard-earned wealth.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Gloves_of_the_Crested_Can:
A gauntlet for the sword hand, a mitt to grip the rum!

These Player Items are created in partnership with your favorite player, who receives a portion of every purchase.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Glowbat: Deep in the jungles of Jidi, evolution has taken a strange turn. The bioluminescent bats of the rainforest lure their prey with a comforting glow, only to incinerate their unsuspecting victims with a caustic venom.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Go2Olymp:
Go2Olymp is excited to announce our new tournament for experienced teams showing off their skills in real battles.
	
	ATTENTION: The number of teams is limited. Only the first 32 teams to sign up will play in this tournament.
	
	Tournament format: Single Elimination. A match is won when a team gets its first victory (best of 1). Final match will be played to 2 victories (best of 3).
	
	Winning team will get $250. Other participants who reach finals and semifinals will also get money prizes.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Go2Olymp_Season_2:
Go2Olymp is excited to announce our new tournament for experienced teams showing off their skills in real battles.
	
	Tournament format: Single Elimination. A match is won when a team gets its first victory (best of 1).
	
	Winning team will get $250. Other participants who reach finals and semifinals will also get money prizes.
DOTA_Item_Desc_GoDOTA_BALI_Season_1: Tournament of Bali Dota 2 Community, with a total prize pool of Rp12.000.000 ++ for 6 winners, held and sponsored by Go-Kool.Net eSports Arena on December 19 and 20, 2015.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Godhorse: The Redhooves of the Western Wails were long thought a thing of myth.  The last survivors of an ancient army, their riders lost to sword and arrow, these hardy steeds returned to the wilds where they bred and grew more feral with each passing generation.   Caught young, this fiery Redhoof shows all the courage of its warsteed ancestors.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Godlike_Dota_2_Online_Tou: Indonesian Dota 2 Online Tournament Season 1. Presented by Godlike Dota. Supported by Unjedoto.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Gods_Mercy: Trust not in the mercy of gods, for many find it more fearsome than mortal spite.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Gold_2014_Compendium_Gem: Awarded for raising The International 2014 Compendium beyond level 50.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Gold_Rush: Gold Rush is a series of tournaments with a monthly prize of 350 Euros for the winner!
DOTA_Item_Desc_Gold_Spectator_Gem: Adding this gem to an item will enable that item to track games viewed for a league or team.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Atomic_Ray_Thruste: Seldom do the blacksmiths and wizards of Ultimyr University cooperate, and yet far more seldom do those who test the result of such a cooperation survive to tell the tale.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Awalebs_Trundlewee: As Awaleb's destructive powers grew, so too did the influence of his healing touch. Indeed, one only need look for flourishing lands and overgrown fauna to follow the path of his great atrocities.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Baby_Roshan: A rare and glittering trophy awarded to the fastest slayers of Sugar Rush Roshan.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Barb_of_Skadi: Deep in Dark Reef Prison, a sorcerer and a blacksmith combined their trades to create a unique weapon. Fashioned from found materials,  the blade can open prison walls as easily as it opens bellies.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Basher_Blades: The fabled blades that shattered the Anvil Magus Hroth. Its terrible weight dented and shattered his iron shell, just as its blades tore into the enchanted hide beneath.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Basher_of_Mage_Sku: The fabled blades that shattered the Anvil Magus Hroth. Its terrible weight dented and shattered his iron shell, just as its blades tore into the enchanted hide beneath.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Beetlejaws_the_Box: Call for Beetlejaws as often as you'd like. Once, twice, three thousand times, Beetlejaws'll come snicking faithfully along
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Bracers_of_Forlorn: Though he uses his powers in battle unflinchingly and without pause, Ish'Kafel silently yearns to do more than just grasp and manipulate the tendrils of his home. But he must balance his desire to explore the boundaries of his growing influence with the knowledge that such experiments have the potential to destroy his current world, or worse, unleash new terrors upon the land of his own kind.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Chaos_Fulcrum: Bound to purpose on the hunt for the pale rider, the Chaos Fulcrum strains even against the order of its own existence as it bends reality to devour rays from the first Light.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Cyrridae: The skill of a master Weaver is plainly seen in the spread of its antennae, each tendril allowing added complexity to the Weaver's astral loom.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Devourling: While very few tales of astral experience have earned a place in the Academy Library, each trusted account includes mention of a strange reflection of the self, an oddly-distorted quintessence, never far from hand...
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Draca_Mane: When exposed to the low pressures of the surface realms, the secretions of a draca eel produce fierce flame without end. Through the lingering distortions of Nothl, however, Huskar commutes a fatal conflagration to a blazing transformation instead.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Draca_Maw: When he first heard rumors of the "unkillable" draca eels that swim the magma rivers of Krulcsar, Huskar paid no mind. It was only in the midst of a firelodge vision quest that the eels' true potential became clear.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Edge_of_the_Lost_O: Long before Yurnero's time, just before the apex of the Isle of Masks, a new school of Mastery emerged--one whose practitioners had learned to use their blades to pierce the very fabric of reality itself. But soon these blade masters found the repercussions of such actions could spread far beyond the field of battle. Fearing dire outcomes--the nature of which we know little about--the elders of the school burned every scrap of parchment in their libraries before turning their blades upon all of the school's adherents...and eventually themselves.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Edict_of_Shadows: In the midst of Riki's cloud, enemy spellcasters are beset by the whispers of Tahlin.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Effigy_Block_of_Th:
Use this item to carve your favorite hero into a Golden Heroic Effigy of The International! Choose your effigy's pose, give it an inscription, then equip it to have your customized monument appear in your team's base for all to see.

Available exclusively to purchasers of The International Compendium 2015.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Empyrean: 'Tis told among Skywrath kind the legend of Shaldera, a being of black wing who in hubris flew into the darker skies hoping to meet the heavenly lords above. She who returned did so upon golden feathers, bearing the divine spear Empyrean, a symbol of her flight. It is said her kingdom endured for a thousand years and one.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Esports_League_Sea: The first season of the Golden Esports League puts the best Swedish teams against each other over three months for 30.000SEK!
The top Swedish teams compete over 3 months for 30,000 SEK!
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Fin_of_the_First_S: For centuries, attempting to don this helm was a rite of passage to all who became First Spear of the Flood. In most cases, it was a short lesson in humility. In others, however, it meant a trip to the healer or even the grave. For one to wear the helm in battle like legends of old signals to Slithereen everywhere that a new age of strength is now upon them.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Flight_of_Epiphany: Only tentatively could Dragonus send tendrils of mystic thought out in search of the boundaries of his power's connection to the Skywrath scion, for a single false step would expose him and doom his efforts forever. It was with a careful, quiet joy that Dragonus discovered there are grey areas in his oath to the Nest of Thorns, and much like the emotions behind the creation of Scree'Auk's Talon, loyalty to the progenitors is powerful haven for certain actions of ambiguous intent.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Floodmask: The unimaginable pressure of the ocean's deepest chasms is pent up in this sturdy bit of salvage. Open the hatch and stand aside!
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Flopjaw: Splish-splash! Plip-plop! There's nothing like the splattery patter of finny feet to let you know your treasure is secure inside a Boxhound, and safely on its way.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Fortunes_Tout: Few can resist the call of this purry peddler.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_FullBore_Bonanza: Of all the memories from his homeland that Kardel Sharpeye revels in during rare quiet nights, tales from the midsummer carnivals and their requisite target galleries are first to pass his lips. At least, they would be, were any of his folk around with which he might share the tale.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Grasping_Bludgeon: An immortal weapon may know many masters through the ages, but it is rare that both attempt to wield it at the same time, with neither willing to relinquish his grasp. Woe betide he who finds himself a third party to this indelible struggle.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Greevil: A reward for slaying a rare loot greevil.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Huntling: Even the smallest shadow of the tiniest baby leaf is sufficient to hide the Huntling from spying eyes, as he slips through the wilds with your valuables.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Hydrakan_Latch: Many of Slark's old stashes and boltholes were plundered or fallen into ruin by the time of his exodus from Dark Reef. Yet, in the most secret places, a few dark trinkets do remain.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Infernal_Chieftain: Bradwarden's thunderous stomps reverberate into the pits of hell.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Latticean_Shards: The zealot assassin burrowed deeper than any of his predecessors had ever dared. Striking a rich seam of dense crystalline formation, he soon found the armored plates of his exoskeleton coated in the shimmering substance.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Mandate_of_the_Sto: There are some who believe the surge of power that comes to Raijin Thunderkeg's hands is a natural result of any expenditure of his power. But no power comes without struggle, even for a Celestial. Though his skill allows for an effortless appearance, it is through sheer will alone that Raijin is able to harness the excess forces that flow from each jolt of his abilities.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Mantle_of_Grim_Fac: When first reforming himself in the wake of Doom and Nevermore's umbral intervention, Shadow Demon gathered new parts to himself with little regard to form, so long as they were strong in function. Now, as his plans come ever closer to fruition and his strength nears its zenith, he chooses more deliberately a face fit to mete out the tragedies to come.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Mask_of_Metira: The enchanters of Metira could never abide human hands in possession of their artifacts. The few thieves who "succeeded" in liberating small baubles from their trove were hunted down and swiftly executed. For a Metiran master to gift a bespoke golden mask to Axia's ward Mirana -- an honor no other outsider had earned -- was a sign of gravest respect indeed.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Minnow_Ward_Upgrad: This International 2017 reward enables an upgraded color style to be unlocked for the Shifty Minnow ward in the style menu.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Moonfall: When Nightsilver Wood was yet but a thicket, a shard of stellar origin fell. Around this holy landing was built the Shrine of Selemene, and the shard itself fashioned into the most sacred of arms possessed of the order of the Dark Moon.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Nothlic_Burden: That which encumbers in the Nothl Realm emboldens on the earthly plane.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Offhand_Basher_of_: The fabled blades that shattered the Anvil Magus Hroth. Its terrible weight dented and shattered his iron shell, just as its blades tore into the enchanted hide beneath.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Pale_Mausoleum: The dirge howls from the deep. Its call is irresistible, its song a melody of dark and cold. All will fall under the spell, be they tyrant or peasant, soldier or thief. The dirge shall claim.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Profane_Union:
Already an unnatural mingling of two separate minds inhabiting a single form, N'aix finds nothing distasteful in augmenting that form ever further to suit their twisted needs.

Immortal items cannot be traded or marketed through The International 2018, but can still be gifted once.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Rabid_Watchcog: As the full scale of his opposition's strength became clear, Clockwerk set about procuring whatever meagre enchantment help was available in order to augment the effectiveness of his arms and armor. Hopefully the second attempt turns out a bit more...stable.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Reel_Guardian_Set: This bundle contains all of the items in the 'Golden Reel Guardian' set for Earthshaker.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Rippers_Reel:
The simple barbs of the ripper's hook find difficult purchase in the scales of the slippery folk who glide beneath the waves. To catch certain prey, a bit of ingenuity and engineering are required. Or, in Pudge's case, gold to pay the tinkerer

The animations for this item should take priority over most other animations or kinetic gems.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Riptide: Let this blade guard you from harm.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Golden_Seekling: Even the Hound of the Flayed Twins entered his calling as a mere pup, tending to his predecessor's needs. Now a new pup has arrived seeking to take on the mantle, ready to aid warriors in their time of need.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Headdress_of_the_Father_S: Fashioned from the feathers of the violet shryll, a bird that flies with its wingtips trailing through the Nothl realm, while the rest of its body sails in the light of this world.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Headdress_of_the_Seeker: Adorned in tusks of great beasts slain in the high peaks of Xhacatocatl, the priests of the Flayed Twins seek blood to keep their greedy gods appeased.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Headdress_of_the_Slithere: It has been long since this apparel has been seen in the great halls of the Slithereen, but few have forgotten it.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Headdress_of_the_Wildwing: Enchantress passes unchallenged through Wildwing territories when she wears this headdress.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Headgear_of_the_: Never coordinated well enough to swim with any stealth or grace, Ogre Magi relied on pilfered shipwright's tools and a bit of luck to survive a failed raid on Deshom Bay.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Headhunter: This weapon once adorned a nobleman's mantel collecting dust, which is exactly the fate Axe made for the nobleman's head.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Headpiece_of_the_Deadly_N: Although barely visible beneath the rim of this headpiece, Belladonna grants the wearer the enormous dilated eyes that so befit a seeker of mysterious truths.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Headress_of_the_Crescent_: Adorned with the wings of the sacred Lunar Moth, Luna rides into battle with strength and agility. Able to sense an attack before it happens, she can deftly avoid blows that would otherwise seek to harm her.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Headwraps_of_the_Acolyte_: No acolyte of Clasz needs eyes of flesh to observe the rites. Those who have them to begin with must soon part ways.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Healing_Fount_of_the_Lost: The healing arts of bygone lands have lost none of their potency.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Healing_Ward_of_the_KuurI: The gargoyles and spirit-watchers of the Kuur-Ishiminari craft-clan bear witness to deeds both glorious and profane with never closing eyes of jade.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Heart_of_the_Inauspicious: Those who patrol the edge of the void must gird themselves in armor impregnable to evil's piercing rays.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Heart_of_the_North_Set: Ready for the cold?  This bundle contains all of the items in the 'Heart of the North' set for Crystal Maiden:
DOTA_Item_Desc_Hearts_of_Misrule: Though less verdant than her family's gardens in Roseleaf once were, Mireska soon found much to adore about the arid lands far to the southeast.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Heat: Clinkz is not the only member of his clan to be preserved in a form of immortal bone. This bow, all that remains of his grandsire, is full of spirit fire and unwanted advice.
DOTA_Item_Desc_HeavenPiercing_Pauldrons: While purely decorative in nature, these ornate shoulder pieces serve as a reminder that even the depthless celestial realm is vulnerable to being punctured by Invoker's power.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Heaven_League_Season_1: More than 64 teams from CIS countries compete for the $350 prize pool!
DOTA_Item_Desc_Heaven_Sent: When the innocent gaze upon Heaven Sent's internal glow, their souls are awash with tranquility and respite from pain. The wicked cannot bear its light. This is a weapon for Keeper of Light.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Heavenly_General: Contains all of the items in the 'Heavenly General' set for Storm Spirit plus a loading screen. These items were created in partnership with ZSMJ, who receives a portion of every purchase.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Heavy_Armor_of_the_World_: This bundle contains all of the items in the 'Heavy Armor of the World Runner' set:
DOTA_Item_Desc_Heavy_Barbed_Armor_Set: This bundle contains all of the items in the 'Heavy Barbed Armor'' set for Bristleback.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Heavy_Belt_of_the_World_R: If our world is but a shadow of Barathrum's real world, then this belt may be but a shadow of Spirit Breaker's real belt. But oh what a shadow!
DOTA_Item_Desc_Heavy_Gauntlets_of_the_Wo: When prying wide the rifts between the planes, Spirit Breaker draws power from these mighty gauntlets.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Heavy_Helm_of_the_World_R: Barathrum's mighty head is his battering ram. Protect it well with this heavy helm!
DOTA_Item_Desc_Heavy_Pauldrons_of_the_Wo: A strange friction is generated on the physical forms of those who slide between the worlds, deeply scarring and cutting into their form. These pauldrons guard Spirit Breaker from the worst of the damage.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Heavy_Steel_Armor_Set: Includes all of the items in the 'Heavy Steel Armor' set for Axe:
DOTA_Item_Desc_Heavy_Steel_Axe: Forged for a brutal warlord who sought to challenge Axe in single combat.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Heavy_Steel_Belt: A deep scratch shows at its center, a remnant of the only attack the original owner was able to deflect.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Heavy_Steel_Shoulder: The warlord thought his forged armor would win the day.  Axe showed him otherwise.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Heavy_Tenderizer: A few quick turns under Pudge's Tenderizer, and even the toughest foe goes down like butter.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Heavyarm_Amateur_Cup: Heavyarm Amateur Cup is an amateur tournament in Malaysia sponsored by Heavyarm U-Garage Store. There will be 6 series of amateur cups with a total prizes up to 85 USD
DOTA_Item_Desc_Hecates_Belts: In the dim nether are shreds and shards of material, spectral matter lost in the ether.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Hecates_Dress: Remnant fashion of a culture long lost to the ages.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Heir_of_Menace_Shoulder: Equipping this item requires the "Acolyte of the Lost Arts" Invoker Persona.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Heiress_of_the_Coastal_Ki: Contains the Heiress of the Coastal Kingdom set for Mirana, including the Loading Screen
DOTA_Item_Desc_Heirloom_of_the_Charred_B: An heirloom of a once-noble house, now one with the ashes of history.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Heirloom_of_the_Temple_Pr: A gilded keepsake from her first assassination, this heirloom once graced the flowing locks of Queens.  Now Templar Assassin wears it as reminder that no one is beyond her reach.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Heirlooms_of_Aeol_Drias: Contains all of the items in the 'Heirlooms of Aeol Drias' set for Silencer plus loading screen.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helios_Esports__Logitech_: An amateur tournament to showcase the top North American and European teams competing for prizes worth over $1500!
DOTA_Item_Desc_HellSpar_Anathema: Forced to his knees before the altar of his own temple, Prelate Vidmar, head of the Order of the Crystal Echelon, knew vile hatred. His flock--acolytes and supplicants alike--lay in pieces around him. As the creature--it could not be called a man--raised its demonic hand once more, the Prelate focused on the fire of his own rage. With final breath, as Lion's dreadful power crashed into his body, Vidmar cursed the Demon Witch. Strengthened by the arcane conduit of the Demon Witch's spell, the Prelate's curse surged into Lion's hand, corrupting it with Crystal Rot. Only by fusing the Prelate's modified headpiece to the afflicted flesh was Lion able to slow the creep of crystalline blight...and a time will come when a more permanent solution must be found.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Hell_League_: Register your team and fight your way throught the groupstage towards the grand final
DOTA_Item_Desc_Hellfire_Edge: Seared, hacked, and trampled. No indignity is too small to be meted out by Chaos Knight and his steed.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Hellgazer: While Warlock is deep in study, his sentry keeps an eye out for Infernal interruptions--as well as more mundane intrusions.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Hellish_Gemstaff: Each facet of the gem reflects the captured soul of a bound demon.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Hells_Ambassador_Set: Includes all of the items in the 'Hell's Ambassador' set for Lion:
DOTA_Item_Desc_Hells_Glare: Only he that burns and is not consumed can wield a sword whose radiance cannot be quenched.  Forged at the same time and from the same ingot of steel as the great bell of Vashundol, the great-sword known as Hell'Âs Glare devours the darkness just as Doom devours the souls of the damned.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Hells_Usher: A mysterious blade long rumored to exist.  Its razor sharp edge ushers enemies straight into hell.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Hellthorn_Scepter: What evil beauty blossoms in the infernal pit, that Lion risked pricking his finger to pluck this lurid thorn?
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helm_of_Burning_Turmoil: From realms beyond mortal knowledge rides forth a heaving darkness.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helm_of_Claszureme: The runes upon the brow give vision beyond the flow of time.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helm_of_Divine_Ascension: A helm befitting one who can ascend and raze his foes with divine arcana.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helm_of_Endless_Havoc: Forged in the tumult of the rift, the helm burns eternal.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helm_of_Impasse: A helm featuring horns touched by enchantment.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helm_of_Infernal_Despair: Hope fails as lives shatter, and the dark form of chaos rides forth.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helm_of_Retribution: The Skywrath Mage pierces his enemies with his gaze, shortly before he pierces them with his talons.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helm_of_Thunderwraths_Cal: A stylish and dramatic helm truly fitting a knight of the Omniscient.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helm_of_Unfettered_Malevo: Cursed chains forged by the Order of Ra'hul to bind the Night Stalker and bring his ancient power to heel. And bind Balanar they did, until darkness fell.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helm_of__the_Dark_Wraith: A helm as dark as her soul.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helm_of_the_Abyssal_Scour: When the Abyssal Horde comes, it will be Vrogros at the vanguard of the charge, eager to bend yet another new land to his vile will.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helm_of_the_Ardalan_Inter: While nothing can get Kardel to divulge his means of transit to the Ardalan Nebula, he's more than happy to swap hogwhompers of his adventures there. Keep him in his cups long enough and he might even tell you about the mishap with the princess and the plasma gun.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helm_of_the_Dark_Moon_Sta: The Dark Moon faithful consist of former scholars, laborers, orphans, and thieves. One may have served as magistrate of a city, another spilled blood as a warlord in the wilds. They have walked all imaginable paths to find Selemene. In her service, the trials and tragedies of the past matter not. They worship the Goddess together, guardians of the Nightsilver Woods.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helm_of_the_First_Dawn: All who see him shall know.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helm_of_the_Flameguard: The Flameguard sect of the Vigil Knights are sworn to protect the ever-burning Holy Flame. While few in number, they are unmatched in swordsmanship.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helm_of_the_Guardian_Cons:
Though depictions of his body and form differ in the telling, the crackle of the Lightning Revenant's whip is known to all of the blessed few who have returned to life from the Narrow Maze.

This item can be upgraded with the 'Compact of the Guardian Construct Style Unlock' granted to players who complete at least 40 stars on the Path of the Dominator.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helm_of_the_Hidden_Talent: Silence is golden, as is the point on this mighty helm.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helm_of_the_Hunters_Glory: Even the most skilled trackers may only hope to earn in a lifetime what Gondar claims on a single hunt.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helm_of_the_Lost_Vigil: Were there any Vigil Knights still alive to tell the tale, they might share a favorite yarn of the "Lost" Vigil patrol, a mystery with endless variations. Though most believed the missing knights lost at sea, some insisted there had been sightings recorded by the elders of Ashkavor--that the knights had been seen in the mountains that guard the unforgiving jungle lands of Fellstrath--a region already feared long before the destruction of Ashkavor made any journey into those lands impossible.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helm_of_the_Nimble_Edge: A well-trained mind is sharper than any blade.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helm_of_the_Penitent_Scho: Only by candlelight does Dragonus dare investigate the means to restore his lost love.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helm_of_the_Radiant_Crusa: The inside is reinforced and padded to protect against heavy blows.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helm_of_the_Red_Conqueror: When Axe wears this helm, Axe sees red. Which is perfectly fine with Axe.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helm_of_the_Reef_Kyte_Rid: Astride a fintail reef kyte and protected against the crush by an enchanted helm, the moon rider serves as Selemene's champion and emissary in forging undersea alliances and keeping creatures of the deep at bay.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helm_of_the_Revenant: A new storm is blowing across the battlefield.  Where there is thunder, there is sure to be lighting.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helm_of_the_Silent_Guardi: A quiet, protected mind leads to a quick blade.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helm_of_the_Slain_Dragon: A cage of gold for your knight's gilded head.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helm_of_the_Slithereen_Ex: Stripped of her rank and station, the exile Slithice has been instructed to cover her headfin while among her people.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helm_of_the_Slithereen_Kn: This helm and golden headpiece has long been a symbol of command among the Knights of the Slithereen.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helm_of_the_Umizar_Crawle: For those with a taste for gambling and excess treasure to spend, the hidden grottos of Crey host all manner of speculative bloodsports.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helm_of_the_Warriors_Retr: Beneath his helm, Sven's thoughts are hidden. But the image he presents to the world may change like the weather.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helm_of_the_Wyrmforge_Sha: The demasted figurehead of the Wyrmforge is just one of many lost relics gathered by the One for safe keeping and occasional good use.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helmet_of_Omexe: When is a helmet both weapon and armor?  When it rests on the mighty head of Bradwarden.  Also, when it has spikes.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helmet_of_the_Burning_Dec: The unsleeping huntsman patrols all reaches of The Hoven, one anguished step after another.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helmet_of_the_Chosen_Larv: Beneath this ornate helmet of hardened chitin rages a mind unlike any other in the insect world--a cold intelligence bent on the destruction of the chosen target.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helmet_of_the_Cryogenic_E: As Ulfsaar lay ravaged by battle and cold, the shaman bound parts of his life force to the nearby icicles until he recovered. The warrior now proudly wears this fur armor embedded with shards of that spellbound ice as a reminder of his spirit's victory over death itself.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helmet_of_the_Drake: Said to be forged from the iron that once chained the last of the great Drakinds, this helm is most coveted among dragon slayers.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Helmet_of_the_Fractured_O: 'Hey your plumage looks nicer than mine. Wanna trade?'
DOTA_Item_Desc_Herald_of_Measureless_Rui: Includes all of the items in the 'Herald of Measureless Ruin' set for Outworld Devourer plus a loading screen. These items were created in partnership with Mushi, who receives a portion of every purchase.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Hermes_the_Hermit_Crab: Hermes' arrival always delivers a smile to even the crabbiest of faces.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Hermid: Well-meaning if a bit clumsy, Hermid is on the hunt for his oldest friend, who vanished one day after discovering the most curious red shell.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Hexgill_the_Lane_Shark: Hexgill was just like any other ordinary lane shark, stalking the well-worn paths and hiding in the trees, waiting to pounce.  But a lane shark's life is a simple thing, lacking in higher meaning.  Hexgill knew there was must be more.  When caught in a net and offered a chance to serve as courier, he knew he'd found his calling in life.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Hidden_Vector: Of all Korumite scholars, those deserving of greatest respect were the Spirit Wardens. At times, Inai will abandon austerity to don their garb -- though none alive know why.

DOTA_Item_Desc_HlotlFeather_Necklace: Among the shrouded reaches of Xhacatocatl hunt terrible beasts, fanged and feathered. It is after the fashion of these stalkers that the Bloodseeker has been molded.
DOTA_Item_Desc_HobblyBob: The fashionable way to keep bugs out of your sights.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Hollow_Jack:
Tired of hauling a Diretide sack?
Just hand it off to Hollow Jack!
DOTA_Item_Desc_Holy_Spear_of_Images: In each blade is reflected an army.  In each strike is reflected an ideal.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Holy_Words_of_the_Hieroph: A Hierophant of the Omniscience must always heed the words of his order.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Honey_Heist_Baby_Roshan: This little guy will go to any length necessary to feed his honey habit.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Hood_of_Endless_Intellect: The Invoker has little need for this hood's magical intellect boosting enchantments. He is already far more intelligent than you could possibly ever comprehend.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Hood_of_Lucid_Torment:
The dreamer's eyes are opened to a world of anguish.

This item can be upgraded with the 'Lucid Torment Style Unlock' granted to players who complete at least 40 stars on the Path of the Protector.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Hood_of_Resonant_Vibrance: There is little that cannot be understood by one trained to know the powers beyond.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Hood_of_the_Cruel_Magicia:
What mind muses within the shadows? Sometimes mystery itself can be cruelty.

These Player Items are created in partnership with your favorite player, who receives a portion of every purchase.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Hood_of_the_Demonic_Vesse: These items were created in partnership with Alliance, who receives a portion of every purchase.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Hood_of_the_Frozen_Feathe: A day before the wizard descended into the glacier to begin his hibernation, he offered Crystal Maiden these last, precious gifts: armor and a staff, strong as ice but light as a feather, believed to have once belonged to a winter deity.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Hood_of_the_Hierophant: A Hierophant of the Omniscience must always approach with head bowed.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Hood_of_the_Infernal_Maw: While some amongst the Ultimyr faculty share concerns regarding the peculiar nature of Chief Curator Lannik's studies, none can deny that under his watch the Academy's archives of arcane knowledge have grown incomparably.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Hood_of_the_Mothbinder: Dim though it has become, the spark of life that holds fast within the heart of the Death Prophet blazes like a signal beacon in the endless darkness of death's abyss, beckoning all manner of feasting shades that long to taste the essence of the animate world.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Hood_of_the_Northlight: Ezalor is known throughout the realms as Keeper of the radiance of day, but legends from the remote, snowbound villages of the Wailing Mountains tell of him appearing in another guise: that of a champion of the lost, a bearer of the guiding light of the North Star.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Hood_of_the_Rowdy_Firebra: "I'm all for a good riot. But never got on much with looters. They don't like my style. They complain about it, but their screams stop eventually."
DOTA_Item_Desc_Hood_of_the_Scarlet_Raven: Fed on quivering heart-meat, the raven's inhuman eyes hum with scarlet hunger.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Hood_of_the_Wandering_Fla: Seeking to restore the mantras of the Guardian Flame far beyond the embers of his ignition pyre in the Wailing Mountains, Xin loosed his remnants into the fury of a passing storm, casting them out in search of all who might still carry his spark.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Hook_of_the_Atniw: Nature chose her guardian well, as any true warrior chooses a weapon.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Hook_of_the_Mad_Harvester: You want your meat tender, right?  Gotta bring it in close for that.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Hook_of_the_Royal_Butcher: Though the carnage may go on without end, there are those alive still who can recall when it began. Ah, to be young and in the employ of the bloody King Brandalon once more.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Hookblade_of_Skadi: In the depths of Dark Reef Prison, Slark dug up this Skadi Blade, buried by some long-forgotten inmate. This mysterious weapon encouraged him in his escape from Dark Reef, and silenced at least one guardian's cry of alarm along the way.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Horn_Mask: The bleached satyr horn mounted atop this mask is said to allow the wearer to channel an ancestor's power.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Horn_of_Luminous_Crystal: An enchantment passed down through the generations since the cold, dark heart of the last ice age, the Horn of the Luminous Crystal is a mark of distinction worthy of only the greatest warriors.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Horn_of_the_Hidden_Hive: Each Nyx Assassin's third kill is marked with the bestowing of this great horn--a ceremonial piece that must be blooded repeatedly if it is to be retained.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Horns_of_Blight: The beautiful horns of the succubus. Worn proudly by the queen herself.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Horns_of_Deep_Magma: These Player Items are created in partnership with Evil Geniuses, who receives a portion of every purchase.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Horns_of_Noblesse: A set of horns worthy of a king.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Horns_of_The_Malicious_Ef: Into the mortal universe pierce the horns of purest strife.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Horns_of_Twisted_Wisdom: Twisted is the mind that broods beneath these twisted horns. Twisted are the intentions that issue from that mind. Twisted is the fate of those who encounter Leshrac.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Horns_of_Wild_Reprisal: Includes particles and an ability icon.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Horns_of_the_Betrayer: Though his mind remains very much his own, Lion has found that each life he takes with his grafted limb further feeds the transfiguration of his flesh, even infusing some of his other magics with aspects of the demon.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Horns_of_the_Bone_Scryer: "I scry with my little eye...a fabulous piece of headgear!"

DOTA_Item_Desc_Horns_of_the_Death_Charge:

These Player Items are created in partnership with your favorite player, who receives a portion of every purchase.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Horns_of_the_Ephemeral_Ha: Chaotic emanations from a plane of violent power are conducted through these focal-horns and imbue Spectre with energy.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Horns_of_the_Iron_Will: Upon otherworldly horns are fiend and foe gored.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Horns_of_the_Malignant_Co: Far away beneath the Sunken Cities and through the Infernal Hollow, Buki'vak the Corrupted dwells in the depths forever expanding his corruption throughout the sea. Hearing of his power, Lion seeked to harvest his parts for a fresh demonoplasty. After a strenuous battle he defeated Buki'vak and gained the hand he desired as a reward, but it was not without cost. Just as his previous hand transformed him, so did this one. He became afflicted with the Malignant Corruption, causing unseemly shards of Obsidian to grow from his body and further disfigure him into something even more unrecognizeable from his original form.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Horns_of_the_PeaceBringer: Horns curved into a sigil of peace.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Horns_of_the_Wicked_Succu: From deepest twilight come temptations dark and terrifying.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Housemark_of_the_Great_Gr: Lycan long ago gave up the crest of his acestral lands.  That crest died the day he was reborn a wolf, and now a new housemark is worn upon his shoulder.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Howling_Wind_Bow: In the endless chill of the far north, it is said that the cold of death comes on a howling wind brought by a great white wolf.  Many a hunter has attempted to slay this grave spirit.  Yet in all the known histories, the stories record only one bow that has ever fired strong enough, and true enough, to pierce its side.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Hungarian_Dota_2_League_S:
Welcome to the Hungarian DOTA 2 League Tournament site!  HD2L is a start up hosted by the Hungarian DOTA 2 community. 
	
	The placement rounds have passed and the 26 teams that qualified have been assigned to divisions accordingly.
	
	In order to help with the organization of this tournament, we have started this website.  Here you will find information about the league, your upcoming fixtures and help facilitate communication with other teams.
	
	We kindly ask all participants to read the game regulations linked below.
	
	You can find information, rules and regulations on the website: https://www.facebook.com/hd2lpage/
	
	We are extremely grateful for the huge amount of interest in this tournament and would like to thank all league participants.
	
	We hope You are as excited as we are!  
	
	See you at the competition!
	
	Admins of -HD2L-

DOTA_Item_Desc_Loading_Screen_of_Deep_Ma: These Player Items are created in partnership with Evil Geniuses, who receives a portion of every purchase.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Loading_Screen_of_Lucid_T: The dreamer's eyes are opened to a world of anguish.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Loading_Screen_of_the_Aby: When the Abyssal Horde comes, it will be Vrogros at the vanguard of the charge, eager to bend yet another new land to his vile will.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Loading_Screen_of_the_Age: As the lone Protector's path takes him ever further from his home soil, the fresh growth of bark keeps record of the wonders he has seen.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Loading_Screen_of_the_Ark: There is power yet in these old bones.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Loading_Screen_of_the_Bla: In the early days following his escape from academia, long before he assumed the title of Invoker, the young magus sought to test his growing skill by any means attainable. Like many other young talents burning for a taste of adventure, it was not long before he answered the call to war.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Loading_Screen_of_the_Blo: Banehallow often takes solace in the company of any fellow afflicted he might encounter in his wanderings. Not all, however, find the company of their own kind so agreeable.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Loading_Screen_of_the_Cha: The cruelties devised by the nobles of Devarque and their progeny remained novel long after N'aix's mind could no longer fathom the meaning of punishment.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Loading_Screen_of_the_Dar: The Dark Moon faithful consist of former scholars, laborers, orphans, and thieves. One may have served as magistrate of a city, another spilled blood as a warlord in the wilds. They have walked all imaginable paths to find Selemene. In her service, the trials and tragedies of the past matter not. They worship the Goddess together, guardians of the Nightsilver Woods.
'You gonna do what the little guy says, or we collectin' with interest?'
DOTA_Item_Desc_Loading_Screen_of_the_Dem: These items were created in partnership with Alliance, who receives a portion of every purchase.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Loading_Screen_of_the_Dre: In the eyes of King Ostarion, the lives of his champions lost fighting to fuel the Wraith-Night rituals were merely his due tribute.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Loading_Screen_of_the_Fer: As the young orphan outgrew adolescence and his mastery of the Turstarkuri scrolls improved, he became eager to test his blades and begin his longed-for crusade to rid the world of magic, ultimately finding first opportunity as a volunteer in the failed defense of Bakhwarren.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Loading_Screen_of_the_Fir: All who see him shall know.
A kit's first tools must come from the remains of its prey.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Loading_Screen_of_the_Fra: 'Hey your plumage looks nicer than mine. Wanna trade?'
DOTA_Item_Desc_Loading_Screen_of_the_Glu: Though the endless march of adventuring fools certainly disturbed the safety of her spiderlings, the constant supply of fresh treasure hunters did wonders for Arachnia's figure.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Loading_Screen_of_the_Gua: Though depictions of his body and form differ in the telling, the crackle of the Lightning Revenant's whip is known to all of the blessed few who have returned to life from the Narrow Maze.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Loading_Screen_of_the_Hun: Even the most skilled trackers may only hope to earn in a lifetime what Gondar claims on a single hunt.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Loading_Screen_of_the_Imp: Given enough gold and exposure to civilization, a troll's haughty nature lends itself well to indulging in a bit of finery.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Loading_Screen_of_the_Jia: Should the mob ever come for him a second time, Ethreain will be ready.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Loading_Screen_of_the_Kin: "Do you mind if I slip into something from my 'Classics' period?"
DOTA_Item_Desc_Loading_Screen_of_the_Mec: Created in partnership with June, who receives a portion of every purchase.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Loading_Screen_of_the_Mot: Dim though it has become, the spark of life that holds fast within the heart of the Death Prophet blazes like a signal beacon in the endless darkness of death's abyss, beckoning all manner of feasting shades that long to taste the essence of the animate world.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Loading_Screen_of_the_Occ: Mundane prey attracts the uninspired predator. A distinguished huntsman, on the other hand, seeks a prize not bound by earthly coils.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Loading_Screen_of_the_Row: "I'm all for a good riot. But never got on much with looters. They don't like my style. They complain about it, but their screams stop eventually."
DOTA_Item_Desc_Loading_Screen_of_the_Roy: Though the carnage may go on without end, there are those alive still who can recall when it began. Ah, to be young and in the employ of the bloody King Brandalon once more.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Loading_Screen_of_the_Smo: In life, the warrior-poet's later-day accomplishments were even more impressive than those of his youth, as the wisdom of his years finally grew to match the purity of his martial arts.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Loading_Screen_of_the_Sou: There are those who view the servitude of Necro'lic as worse than any fate faced by those that fall under its ruthless gaze.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Loading_Screen_of_the_Tru: When Virga Truebark defied the Iron Princeling and sounded the Oakfall Horn, let it be known that Verodicia's favored son stood with her, fighting loyally by her side.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Loading_Screen_of_the_Ver:
'Neath vermillion plates
The shifting form
Of the star
Reborn.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Loading_Screen_of_the_Wyr: The demasted figurehead of the Wyrmforge is just one of many lost relics gathered by the One for safe keeping and occasional good use.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Lockjaw_the_Boxhound: Most boxhounds you're likely to come across would sooner eat you just for touching them, but all this little guy ever wants to do is play fetch.  His master never came home from battle, so if Lockjaw follows you home you should probably keep him.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Lockless_Luckbox: Don't bother looking for your keys, because this chest doesn't need one! Our Lucky Lockless Chest contains one of a number of prized possessions that may be found only inside of it. So save your keys for a chest that needs them. You already got lucky!
DOTA_Item_Desc_Lockless_Luckvase: No seal or key is needed to open this treasure, as it is already unlocked. This treasure contains individual items.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Majesty_Of_The_Colossus__: In ages past, long before the settlements in the Azuran region were abandoned to ruin, the Odobenus forebearers harnessed the powers of rock, root, and iron to create fearsome guardians to watch over the tombs of their fallen legions even after the memories of their deeds had passed from the world. Little did they know the raw stone materials they'd utilized in one such creation also contained a powerful life force of its own, one not content to sit idly waiting for the threats of the outlands to arrive--one who would venture forth to stand watch over all lands in need of protection.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Malu_Dota_Series_Finale: In 2013 we have hosted a total of four open Dota 2 tournaments. Now it's time to do the next step. While short cups are great for a lot of people, it was still our goal to make joinDOTA an even more stable place to compete for teams of any skill level.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mammoth_Lure: Once believed extinct, a small population of dwarf Mammoths can still be found on the isolated, northernmost peninsula of Icewrack.  They are shy creatures, not easily baited, but an offered stockpile of nuzzle-fruit will often entice them to approach.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mana_Pool: From a darkness unknown spills infinite power.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Mancatcher_of_the_Crimson: The Crimson Cut-throat kept a wide assortment of ornate blades to do his work.  Once the contract was complete, Gondar helped himself.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mandate_of_the_Stormborn: There are some who believe the surge of power that comes to Raijin Thunderkeg's hands is a natural result of any expenditure of his power. But no power comes without struggle, even for a Celestial. Though his skill allows for an effortless appearance, it is through sheer will alone that Raijin is able to harness the excess forces that flow from each jolt of his abilities.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Mango_League: Mango League is joint effort to create sustainable league system in South Korea by AquaTV, EDICH, BeginTV, and Minus9. Aimed at Korean amateur teams and Korean audience, Mango League brings the finest of Korean amateur teams, production, and casting.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Manias_Mask: To wander the woods knowing you are alone, an orphan of those who birthed you, rejected by those who raised you, hidden from those who might give warmth and comfort... this is a path to madness.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Manifold_Paradox:
Weapon evolves by earning points. Any match won using Phantom Assassin will earn you 1 point. Earning 40 points will upgrade the weapon to Level 2, and earning 100 points causes the weapon to reach its maximum evolution.

With a raspy cackle, the elder smith Craler swung the sword that his family had spent eleven generations to fold and forge. So sharp it was that, with a sound like tearing fabric, a rip in reality tore open. Through this rip, Craler recognized himself from moments before, holding aloft the very same coveted blade. Then, in a fit of greed and madness, he cut this earlier self down to seize the twin sword as his own. Too late, however, Craler felt a familiar wound, and was suddenly filled with the memory of being cut down himself...
DOTA_Item_Desc_Manifold_Paradox_Bundle: Contains the Manifold Paradox arcana for Phantom Assassin and the Gravestone emoticon.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Manifold_Spear: A spear with three edges. It seems to reflect the light strangely.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Mantle_of_Ancestral_Luck: The ogres of the elder days were said to be great builders and skilled artisans... by ogre standards.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mantle_of_Divine_Ascensio: Dashing and bold, this mantle helps Dragonus bear the great weight of Ascension's power.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mantle_of_Eldritch_Ice: The ice mage's robes became the Lich's tattered shroud. Superstitious subjects hammered spikes of sacred metal as a warning into the dead mage's skull, none suspecting that upon his resurrection he would wear the device as a cursed crown of domination.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mantle_of_Endless_Havoc: Heavy is the burden of unending war, yet many are its vicious pleasures.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mantle_of_Grim_Facade: When first reforming himself in the wake of Doom and Nevermore's umbral intervention, Shadow Demon gathered new parts to himself with little regard to form, so long as they were strong in function. Now, as his plans come ever closer to fruition and his strength nears its zenith, he chooses more deliberately a face fit to mete out the tragedies to come.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mantle_of_Hells_Ambassado: Suggestive of the robes of office of some infernal dignitary, the cape was an honorific bestowed on Lion by a grateful demon populace.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mantle_of_Mysteries: None know whose bones line mantle's fringe.  Every teller must ask unanswerable questions.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mantle_of_Ultoria: This is not the first battle of import on this plane to necessitate the intervention of Barathrum at his master's behest.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mantle_of_the_Acolyte_of_: Travelling between dimensions, followers of Clasz require protection from the chill interstitial spaces.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mantle_of_the_Blackguard_: In the early days following his escape from academia, long before he assumed the title of Invoker, the young magus sought to test his growing skill by any means attainable. Like many other young talents burning for a taste of adventure, it was not long before he answered the call to war.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mantle_of_the_Blood_Coven: By the mantle of the Flayed Ones shall your enemies know you.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mantle_of_the_Blood_Moon: Banehallow often takes solace in the company of any fellow afflicted he might encounter in his wanderings. Not all, however, find the company of their own kind so agreeable.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mantle_of_the_Cinder_Baro: The Sorcerer King of Valhessi is but one title among many that the doppelganger Niyish has worn. Impersonating the Cinder Baron, the imposter led his forces on a disastrous military campaign, finally gaining an audience with the powerful Valhessian King during their surrender. Now, as the Inferno Keep melts into its volcanic foundations, this mantle is all that remains of the Cinder Baron's reign.
This item enables the upgraded texture to be unlocked on Axe's 'Mantle of the Cinder Barono' through the style menu.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mantle_of_the_Crescent_Mo: Plaid with moth wings and dressed with armour made from pure Moonsilver. A vestment like this is both rare and magical as it grants its wearer with the boon of increased agility.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Mantle_of_the_Iron_Will: Against his shoulders does the world shatter.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mantle_of_the_Reef_Kyte_R: Astride a fintail reef kyte and protected against the crush by an enchanted helm, the moon rider serves as Selemene's champion and emissary in forging undersea alliances and keeping creatures of the deep at bay.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mantle_of_the_Sangstrath_: Rich in oral history, Ulfsaar's kin still celebrate the legends of the Sangstrath--ancient guardians of a fabled civilization and the first ancestors to settle the current lands of the ursine tribe after disaster befell their own.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mantle_of_the_Smoldering_: In life, the warrior-poet's later-day accomplishments were even more impressive than those of his youth, as the wisdom of his years finally grew to match the purity of his martial arts.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mantle_of_the_Stormcharge: Astride the focused storm, Disruptor stalks the boundaries of battle, ready to strike down his enemies and lead his tribe's return to a place of distinction and honor.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mantle_of_the_Truebark_Ad: When Virga Truebark defied the Iron Princeling and sounded the Oakfall Horn, let it be known that Verodicia's favored son stood with her, fighting loyally by her side.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mantle_of_the_Whispered_B: Not even Lanaya understands the true motives of the Hidden Ones, but the secrets they've revealed have more than earned her trust and loyalty. And if the whispers amongst her fellow temple adherents can be believed, soon a day will come when the hidden masters step forward to make the grand picture clear.

DOTA_Item_Desc_MarsTV_Dota_2_League_2016: The 2016 MDL Autumn International Invitational tournament officially launches in September, boasting a prize pool of up to $250,000. The beautiful coastal city of Xiamen, China will host the top eight teams from China, Europe and the United States, starting off an exciting season!
DOTA_Item_Desc_MarsTV_Dota_Elite_Invitat: The first and second places from CN Qualifer for the International will face up four invited Chinese top teams in Huaxi, the top village in China.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mask_of_Dark_Ferocity: In the bounty hunting business, a little intimidation can go a long way.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mask_of_Distant_Sands: The heat of the eastern wastes is said to be extraordinary.  One must cover themselves appropriately.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mask_of_Fury: Your face is masked but your fury won't be.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mask_of_Inscrutable_Zeal: While not as sturdy as a proper dueling mask, this covering is better tuned to project words of power.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mask_of_Metira: The enchanters of Metira could never abide human hands in possession of their artifacts. The few thieves who "succeeded" in liberating small baubles from their trove were hunted down and swiftly executed. For a Metiran master to gift a bespoke mask to Axia's ward Mirana -- an honor no other outsider had earned -- was a sign of gravest respect indeed.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mask_of_Mortis: Each time Krobelus traversed beyond the veil revealed ever more complexities of the entities that call such a place home. While most seem unconcerned with the land of the living, some watch--and influence--the events of the material plane with deep interest.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mask_of_Petaluna: Though the priests of Dezun believe they alone possess the secrets of the ethereal shade, Dazzle's discovery of a race of insects in the lost jungles of Fellstrath capable of suckling energy directly from the Nothl Realm puts that claim to rest. But these creatures are inefficient with their feeding, and each puncture they create allows a bit of influence from the Nothl Realm to bleed into our own.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mask_of_a_Thousand_Faces: A ceremonial mask worn on special occasions. This must be a special occasion.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mask_of_the_Chainbreaker: The cruelties devised by the nobles of Devarque and their progeny remained novel long after N'aix's mind could no longer fathom the meaning of punishment.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mask_of_the_Confidant: Though the Gallants act for the most part in the open -- and indeed enjoy the renown that follows in their wake -- sometimes a cause must be taken up in which secrecy serves not only to safeguard the interests of the Gallants, but also to lessen the dangers facing those who need their protection.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mask_of_the_Crimson_Cutth: The contract for the head of the Crimson Cut-throat was one of the most difficult that Gondar had ever accepted.  It was only natural that he'd keep a few souvenirs.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mask_of_the_Divine_Sorrow: Has the Mask, Hood and Crown styles.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mask_of_the_Freelancer: This old gladiatorial helm serves Sven well as he travels the land in search of honor and gold.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mask_of_the_Hazhadal_Mage: After besting the young mages of his order, Nortrom put his newfound skills to use suppressing the godless outlaws of the Hazhadall Barrens, routinely making short work of their vaunted enthrallers.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Mask_of_the_Soul_Keeper: There are those who view the servitude of Necro'lic as worse than any fate faced by those that fall under its ruthless gaze.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mask_of_the_Soul_Serpent: Unearthed from a Dead Reckoning Chest in recognition of The Revenant Muerta's arrival.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mask_of_the_Tahlin_Watch: The crest of the Tahlin Watch sits upon the brow.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mask_of_the_ThiefScholar: Just as what is known must be learned, what is spoken must be thought.

Noble by nature, Masked Fey overcame centuries of solitude to become guardian of the skies.

Includes alternate color styles.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Masked_Fey_Courier_and_Sc: Includes Masked Fey courier and loading screen.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Masks_of_Ancestral_Luck: The names of the twin leaders who once owned these masks have been lost to ignorance.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Masque_of_Awaleb: Though the origins of Zharvakko's brand of arcanism are somewhat murky, and largely apocryphal, the exploits of the influential healer Awaleb are known far and wide. In an age of famine, disease, and unending violence, Awaleb concluded that the ailments of his people amounted to mere symptoms of a much greater sickness. So he began to turn his legendary cauldron towards the dark arts of harm. His people could always trust his word and prescriptions, but his greater act of service to them was a willing corruption of sacred vows in the name of protection, and the twisted legacy he would leave behind.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Masque_of_Awaleb_Bundle: Though the origins of Zharvakko's brand of arcanism are somewhat murky, and largely apocryphal, the exploits of the influential healer Awaleb are known far and wide. In an age of famine, disease, and unending violence, Awaleb concluded that the ailments of his people amounted to mere symptoms of a much greater sickness. So he began to turn his legendary cauldron towards the dark arts of harm. His people could always trust his word and prescriptions, but his greater act of service to them was a willing corruption of sacred vows in the name of protection, and the twisted legacy he would leave behind.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Master_Artificers_Hammer:
A powerful hammer used to extract Prismatic and Ethereal gems. Using a Master Artificer's Hammer will destroy the item it is used on.
	
	This tool can be used from the Item Details page, which can be accessed from the Armory by double-clicking on an item, or by right-clicking on an item and selecting Item Details.
	
	This tool is consumed on use.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Master_Assassins_Grim_Cut: The forked tip allows the wielder to pry back any armor the target may be wearing.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Master_Assassins_Mancatch: Designed to catch and hold the target, no matter which point is used.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Master_Assassins_Mask: The cloth is treated with oils and wax to stave off enemy poisons.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Master_Assassins_Shoulder: Built to deflect enemy weapons, the shoulder plates are carefully tailored to the wearer.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Master_Assassins_Shuriken: The blade end and grip are carefully balanced to sail through the air accurately, and with ease.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Master_Assassins_Tails: The trailing cloth obscures the assassin's form and, in a pinch, can be used to thwart enemy blades.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Master_Chocobo: Chocobos are no strangers to war. Though often recruited to carry soldiers into battle, their quick feet and strong backs also make them well-suited for carrying supplies to the front lines.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Master_Gaming_Series_2015: Presented by QEON and CIPIKA PLAY, where amateur & professional teams fight for glory in the most anticipated & prestigious Dota 2 event in Indonesia.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Master_Gaming_Series_Dota: This two-series tournament has the largest prize pool in Indonesia. The top teams from the region compete for the 100,000,000 IDR prize pool.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Master_League: Master League tournament teams Peru where beginners start looking for new challenges.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Master_Necromancer: Contains the Master Necromancer set for Necrophos, including the Loading Screen
DOTA_Item_Desc_Master_Weaver_Set: Includes all the items in the "Master Weaver" set for Weaver.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Masters_Manila_2017:
We present to you The Masters, a Dota 2 tournament that will gather some of the best in the world.
	
	Organized by the Mineski-Events Team and supported by ESL, featuring a scale fitting for gladiators of the world stage, The Masters will surely change the competitive Dota 2 landscape as we know it.
	
	The first chapter of The Masters opens this May in the Philippines. Who will rise from the rest and be crowned the Manila Masters?
DOTA_Item_Desc_Matt_Lange_Abstraction_Mu: Cinematic, glitchy atmospheres and hard-hitting rhythms by Matt Lange.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mattock_of_Distortion: One blow of this mighty mallet, and waves of time-warping distortion spread to erase his enemies from existence.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Maul_of_the_Dying_Light: Unearthed from a Dead Reckoning Chest in recognition of The Revenant Muerta's arrival.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Maw_of_Eztzhok: The thirst of Eztzhok became insatiable, and with each feast the demon's share of the Twins' tributes grew larger. As Eztzhok's gaping maw began to twist the visage of their loyal Hound, the Flayed Ones realized nearly too late that the reclamation of their Bloodseeker would not come without sacrifice.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Maw_of_the_Devourer: From the World at the Rim, this staff is a weighty reminder of the howling void that waits for us all.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Maze_of_Anguish: To be wrapped in her wings is to be trapped in her web.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mazoku_League: Some of the best teams in South America face off to prove themselves as the best amateur team in the region.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Meadows_Mercy: Though the forest itself may be neutral, this spear will bring a swift end to those who dare disturb the creatures who call it home.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Meat_Dragger: Sometimes the meat won't go nowhere unless you drag it.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mecha_Boots_of_Travel_Mk_: Why rely on uncertain sorcery when an unstable machine can be just as dangerous? Painstakingly reconstructed from half-remembered schematics, the transdimensional technologies built into these boots is theorized to have caused the Violet Plateau Incident. Of course, that couldn't possibly happen again. Er, could it?
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mechalodon_Interdictor: Contains the Mechalodon Interdictor set for Gyrocopter, including the Loading Screen
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mechanised_Pilgrim:
Includes all of the items in the 'Mechanised Pilgrim' set for Clockwerk plus loading screen and power cogs.

Created in partnership with June, who receives a portion of every purchase.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mechjaw_the_Boxhound: Between their experiments in transdimensional science, a pair of engineers in the facility atop the Violet Plateau designed a device to store and protect their most valuable valuables. Had those engineers not been eaten by indescribable horrors, they surely would have become rich!
DOTA_Item_Desc_Medium_Majesty_Of_The_Col: In ages past, long before the settlements in the Azuran region were abandoned to ruin, the Odobenus forebearers harnessed the powers of rock, root, and iron to create fearsome guardians to watch over the tombs of their fallen legions even after the memories of their deeds had passed from the world. Little did they know the raw stone materials they'd utilized in one such creation also contained a powerful life force of its own, one not content to sit idly waiting for the threats of the outlands to arrive--one who would venture forth to stand watch over all lands in need of protection.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Meepo_Announcer_Pack:
Unearth some blue-collar wisdom and get multiple perspectives on every game in one convenient place with the Meepo Announcer Pack.
	
	Contains the Meepo Announcer and Mega-Kills Voices.

On the eve of The International 2018, Kaci and SirActionSlacks hatched their most inspired idea yet--the Gabe Newell Mega-Kills Announcer. Determined to elicit the most bloodthirsty performance ever recorded, they lured Gabe into the studio... The rest is history.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Mega_Greevil_Courier: Not all greevils are created equal. Once in a while, an egg will lay dormant through season after season, eventually hatching a greevil more hardy than its peers.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Merciless_Spear: Built to strike into the core of an adversary, and tear it apart when withdrawn.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mercurials_Call:
Across time and space, the Spectre known as Mercurial has struggled to be understood. Now the full nature of her violent wrath can be heard.
	Granted exclusively to owners of the 2014 Compendium for The International.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Merry_Wanderers_Brush: Beneath the magic moonless night sprout sights rare-seen by mortal man: the swaying sweep of faerie flight unfurls to gorgeous shimmering span. And from this beauteous wonder light of shifting hue there might be spied, yet those who seek such perilous views may oft then find their lives denied.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Metal_Horns: In a time long forgotten, a grateful king once gifted the Prophet these horns as thanks for aid of the forest.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mexican_Cup: The top teams from Meixco are invited to prove they are the top team from the region.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Midas_Club_Elite: Midas Club Elite is a in-house developed for Brazilian community that have expanded over America. Featuring players with 5.5k+ MMR playing CM mode to fight for the 1st play on the ladder.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Midas_Club_Elite_Season_2: Midas Club Elite is a in-house developed for Brazilian community that have expanded over America. Featuring players with 5.5k+ MMR playing CM mode to fight for the 1st place on the ladder.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Midas_Club_Open: Midas Club Open is the entry league for Midas Club Elite. All players welcome to start to learn more about captains mode and leagues.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Midas_Knuckles: Midas has long been considered Alchemy's most successful practitioner. Seeking to address the incredible costs of war, he developed a series of gauntlet prototypes to be worn by revered knights of the kingdom, which were capable of minting coin with every strike.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Might_of_the_Galloping_Av: Contains the Might of the Galloping Avenger set for Magnus, including the Loading Scren
DOTA_Item_Desc_Might_of_the_Old_World: A helm forged of enchanted alloys deep in the Astral plane, so that Elder Titan might better channel his Sprit and control both aspects of his broken soul.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Might_of_the_Slithereen_K: With this sword, truly, no Slithereen may fail.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mighty_Boar: This boar has a crazed look in his eye. Is it distrust? Madness? Or does he just want to eat your tangos.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Milan_Dota_2_League: The first season of the Milan Dota 2 league.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Militant_Cup_Season_1: The first season of Militant Cup series. 32 teams from CIS will compete each other. The winner will receive prize money upon victory!
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mind_Piercer_of_the_Preda: Nyx's words enter the mind with great subtlety.  His horn enters the mind with considerably less subtlety.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mineski_ProGaming_League_: Mineski-Events Team proudly presents the 7th season of the Mineski Pro-Gaming League. Witness intense Dota 2 action as teams from all over the Philippines battle for the right to be named as the best in the country and a share from the initial prize pool of PHP 840,000.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mineski_Pro_Gaming_League: MPGL returns for the eighth season to gather the best teams in Philippines. Who will Rise from the Rest?
DOTA_Item_Desc_Miracle_Tournament_Season: 32 Indonesian amateur teams will compete each other for 3.200.000 IDR Prize pool!!
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mirana_of_Nightsilver: Bound by oath and honor to serve the needs of something larger than herself, Mirana of Nightsilver ranges far from home to defend the secrets of the temple she loves. In a world of twisted enemies and complex friends, she trusts in her bond with the fearless Sagan, and in the aim of her ever-ready bow.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mischief_of_the_Fae_Forag: Contains the Mischief of the Fae Forager set for Dark Willow, including the Loading Screen
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mischievous_Dragon: Contains all of the items in the 'Mischievous Dragon' set for Puck plus a loading screen.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mistblade: Forged in the Font of Avernus, and filled with a dark thirst.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mistbreaker: Second of the three house blades of Avernus.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mistral_Braid: The wind that gently tousles her locks, gives unmatched flight to Windranger's arrows.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mistress_of_the_Long_Nigh: Contains the Mistress of the Long Night set for Death Prophet
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mistress_of_the_Slitheree: "My Mistress, your Master," sings Naga as her enemies bow, never to rise.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Modestly_Braided_Beard: Even for the Avatars of Immortals modesty is sometimes called for.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mohawk_of_the_Spectral_Hu: Unearthed from a Dead Reckoning Chest in recognition of The Revenant Muerta's arrival.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mok: One of the wildest beasts of the escaped menagerie that ran amok during the fall of Slom, this wily mandrill took Mok for his name, thinking the citizenry's cries of warning were a herald of his arrival.  Now he puts his mischievous nature to good use, wading into any chaotic situation in order to bring you what you need.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Moldering_Mask_of_Ka: Includes custom particle and custom ability icon.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Molokau_Stalker: Contains the Molokau Stalker item set for Venomancer
DOTA_Item_Desc_Molotov_Cocktail_of_the_D: 'You gonna do what the little guy says, or we collectin' with interest?'
DOTA_Item_Desc_Molten_Claw: In a rush to lay his enemies down, Axe burst into a forge to scrounge for suitable armor. What he found was still fresh from the fire, which suited Axe just fine. Includes ambient particle.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Molten_Fracture: Doom's power has shattered this blade.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Molten_Genesis: It takes a truly special bow to be wielded by fingers of flame.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Monarch_Bow: A relic from a hegemony long since passed, the Monarch rewards those who value lethal precision and skill over blunt force. As graceful in action as at rest, it complements perfectly the coolest of heads under the deadliest of circumstances.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Monarch_of_the_Sapphire_G: Long ago, before Nature's Prophet's seed was made to sprout, Verodicia imbued a sapphire gem with a spark of her essence, meant to be left behind in the wastes of a war-torn land so that the cycle of life might sooner return to a place bereft of it.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Monkey_King_Announcer_Pac:
This pack replaces the Default announcer and Mega-Kills announcer with the legendary musings of the Monkey King.
	
	Available in English and Chinese.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Monster_Hunter_Music_Pack: Transform the soundscape of your battles with the official Monster Hunter music pack.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Monster_Hunter_Sticker_Ca: A sticker capsule containing a random Monster Hunter sticker from the Monster Hunter Event. Base quality stickers can only be obtained from the Hero Atlas.
A Bundle of 100 Monster Hunter Sticker Capsules.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Monstrous_Reprisal: Contains all of the items in the 'Monstrous Reprisal' set for Riki plus loading screen, ability icons and an autograph. These items were created in partnership with VeRsuta, who receives a portion of every purchase.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Montenegrin_National_Leag: The third edition of Montenegrin National League will once again host the 24 best teams from our country who will compete for national trophy and prize pool that is going over 2500 euros. From November to April we will be witnessing clashes of the best teams in Montenegro so don't miss your opportunity to support your kings of Montenegro.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Montenegro_National_Leagu: Montenegro National League is the first professional Dota 2 league in Montenegro organized by Montenegro E-Sports Association. The best teams from country will compete for the championship and prizes!
Another season of Montenegro National League is coming with bigger and better prize pool. Who will become new masters of Montenegrin Dota 2 scene?
DOTA_Item_Desc_Monty: A sophisticate vagabond of the highest order, Monty would look down his nose at you if he had one.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Moon_Griffon:
On a night of a crescent moon, Mirana found a griffin cub in the maze of Nightsilver woods. Now the strange little beast is eager to serve his mistress.

This item includes custom Leap sound, idle and loadout animations.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Moon_Rift: Contains all of the items in the 'Moon Rift' item set for Mirana plus loading screen.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Moon_Rift_Style: Has two styles, Mask and No Mask
DOTA_Item_Desc_Moonfall: When Nightsilver Wood was yet but a thicket, a shard of stellar origin fell. Around this holy landing was built the Shrine of Selemene, and the shard itself fashioned into the most sacred of arms possessed of the order of the Dark Moon.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Morbific_Provision: Contains the Morbific Provision item set for Witch Doctor
DOTA_Item_Desc_Morcant: This pale creature found its way down the starlight path as if it heard its future mistress calling.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Morokai_Emoticon: Unlocks the Mo'rokai emoticon, awarded to players who have won 50 Wrath of the Mo'rokai matches.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Moroks_Mechanical_Mediary: Don't let its metal form deceive you: this contraption is more magic than machine. Fashioned by the Mad Mage Morok who was far too lazy to carry his own spell books and far too cheap to retain hirlings.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mortar_Forge: Contains all of the items in the 'Mortar Forge' set for Clockwerk plus a loading screen.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Most_Wanted_Tournament:
64 teams of Indonesia will fight for IDR 3.000.000. 
	Presented by Want3D
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mountain_Splitter: Usually used only by the Sagesmiths of Vuur, the stone antlers of the Murex elk are one of few tools capable of grasping the burning heartflint of the Vuurcrag mountains.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mountain_Trail_Challenge: The MTC is a proffesional tournament in which some of the best teams known will be invited to compete against each other.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mournful_Reverie: For one who has lost so much, a trickle of memory soon becomes a torrent of anguish.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mousesports_Pennant:
Show your support with a Team Pennant!
	
	Having a Team Pennant in your Armory will increase that team's Pennant Score which is shown during matches in Valve-supported tournaments, and it will make you eligible to receive item drops while spectating their live tournament matches. Pennants for the same team can be combined to increase their contribution to that team's Pennant Score.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Muh_Keen_Gun: Not content to kill things one bullet at a time, Sniper commissioned the best gunsmith in the land to construct him a firearm worthy of his talented trigger finger.  Lovingly designed and crafted with all the skill and attention to detail befitting a master smithy of the keen, the weapon that resulted is truly one for the ages.  It's a bit on the heavy side, true, but not when balanced against the weight of corpses it will produce.  Hernia not included.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mulan_girls_team_league: A series of various events held in the Mulan girl’s team league.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mulctant_Pall: In the eyes of the Demon Witch, those blessed with arcane power are but mere subjects, called upon to tithe their life's force in service of the hell-bent king.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mulctant_Pall_of_the_Crim: In the eyes of the Demon Witch, those blessed with arcane power are but mere subjects, called upon to tithe their life's force in service of the hell-bent king.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Murder_of_Crows:
Shoulda' kept your beak out of this.

These items commemorate the release of Valve's documentary, Free to Play, and were created in partnership with Dendi, who receives a portion of every purchase.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Murrissey_the_Smeevil: It is rare to find a smeevil far from the warmth of the forge to which it's bound, for they thrive on the affectionate cuffings and curses of their sworn smith. But the lure of a free tortoiceros ride compelled the smeevil Murrissey to break every oath...
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mysterious_Egg: A hard, scaled egg that seems to be alive and almost ready to hatch. It hungers for the magical energies contained in Diretide essences. What comes out will be determined by the type and amount of magic the egg consumes.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mysterious_Vagabonds_Conc: Although some travelling shaman have been rightly accused of selling colored water as if it were a certain cure for all ills, Rhasta makes no such claims and has never charged so much as a pence for a swig from this bottle. In fact, no one but Rhasta may drink from it. The Shadow Shaman's brew is certain death to anyone but its maker.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Mysterious_Vagabonds_Hat: "A shaman must take good care of his skin!" Rhasta's master instructed.
