DOTA_Item_Desc_Oculopus: Long-thwarted in their astrological studies, Octopi have since time immemorial sought to better understand the world around them and their place in the larger universe.  The breakthrough came when a powerful piece of divine technology drifted down from the gods above, an anointed gift, that the secrets of the world be unlocked.  Thus did Oculopus rise to prominence, the greatest underwater astronomer that the world had ever known.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Oem_Dota_Camp: The top four teams from the region compete for the R$1,000 prize pool.
DOTA_Item_Desc_OffHand_Blade_of_the_Ferv: As the young orphan outgrew adolescence and his mastery of the Turstarkuri scrolls improved, he became eager to test his blades and begin his longed-for crusade to rid the world of magic, ultimately finding first opportunity as a volunteer in the failed defense of Bakhwarren.
DOTA_Item_Desc_OffHand_Blade_of_the_Wand: Seeking to restore the mantras of the Guardian Flame far beyond the embers of his ignition pyre in the Wailing Mountains, Xin loosed his remnants into the fury of a passing storm, casting them out in search of all who might still carry his spark.
DOTA_Item_Desc_OffHand_Sword_of_the_Smol: In life, the warrior-poet's later-day accomplishments were even more impressive than those of his youth, as the wisdom of his years finally grew to match the purity of his martial arts.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Offhand_Basher_of_Mage_Sk: The fabled blades that shattered the Anvil Magus Hroth. Its terrible weight dented and shattered his iron shell, just as its blades tore into the enchanted hide beneath.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Offhand_Blade_of_the_Surv: As even the faces of favored kin fade from recollection, the unholy forms of the Turstarkuri faithful rise perversely in the mind's eye.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Offhand_of_the_Spectral_H: Unearthed from a Dead Reckoning Chest in recognition of The Revenant Muerta's arrival.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Ogre_Magi_Set_Weapon: Never coordinated well enough to swim with any stealth or grace, Ogre Magi relied on pilfered shipwright's tools and a bit of luck to survive a failed raid on Deshom Bay.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Ogre_Seal_Totem:
A totem carved from an ogre seal's tooth.

Required Level: 5

Active: Ogre Seal Flop
Flop like an ogre seal, dealing 250 damage and stunning for 1 second on each bounce.

+5 Strength
BONUS HP: 200
DOTA_Item_Desc_Ogres_Caustic_Steel_Blind: What it may lack for vision it makes up for in protection.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Ogres_Caustic_Steel_Brace: If you're gonna work with unstable materials, make sure you can survive a mistake!
DOTA_Item_Desc_Ogres_Caustic_Steel_Chopp: Good for stirring mixtures, great for chopping dinner!
DOTA_Item_Desc_Oil_Vial:
Auctioned from the estate of a brilliant but failed alchemist, these mystical vials have the power to transform liquid water into nearly any substance. However, a steady hand is required. The next item on the auction block was the greasy corpse of the sneezing thaumaturge himself. Vial art, indeed.

Stand in the river to reveal the vial interface. Pour the contents into the river to transform it for 3 minutes. Each vial can be used once per game.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Ol_Snaggletooth: Witch Doctor found this stylish croc jaw discarded in the bush.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Old_Ironsides_Gauntlet: With rough seas ahead, these lightweight gauntlets of blued steel will help you survive the stormiest of battles.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Old_Ironsides_Pauldrons: Step lively now, your Admiral has come aboard sporting these lightweight storming pauldrons.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Ollin_League_Season_1: The top teams in Mexico compete for a prize of 2,000 MXN!
DOTA_Item_Desc_Ollin_League_Season_2: Mexico's best teams compete for the $5,000 MXN prize pool.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Omnishred_the_Defiant: An artistic weapon, curved and elegant. When held within a powerfully gloved hand it burns with a desire to bring metal to mortal men!
DOTA_Item_Desc_OnArt_Cup: The first OnArt Cup will have 64 teams divided into 16 groups fighting for a prize pool of R$ 4.000,00!

DOTA_Item_Desc_Opus_of_the_Vizier_Exile:
While his talents may no longer directly serve Damathryx's cause, Ish'Kafel commits his legacy to the bindings of a massive tome with the hope it may one day be recovered by some planesfaring kin.

Contains the Opus of the Vizier Exile set for Dark Seer, including the Loading Screen.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Orb_of_Deliverance: His search led deep into the earth, down into ruins undisturbed by surface dwellers for millennia. Every scrap of evidence he'd found told him a greater, far older civilization had preceded those whose technologies he had already pilfered. But there were reasons no surface dwellers had come this far in ages, and Disruptor would need to modify his equipment with secrets found along the way just to ensure he might continue a bit further.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Orbuculum_Equinox:
There once was an Ancient supreme
Whose head was a snowglobe that gleamed.
What the warden recalled
Was glaring to all
So it’s good that he kept the view clean.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Order_of_the_Wandering_Fl:
Seeking to restore the mantras of the Guardian Flame far beyond the embers of his ignition pyre in the Wailing Mountains, Xin loosed his remnants into the fury of a passing storm, casting them out in search of all who might still carry his spark.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Orena_Dota_2_Cup: 32 South African teams compete for a total prize pool of R12,700 and gaming equipment from SteelSeries!
DOTA_Item_Desc_Origin_of_the_Unmaking: What challenge is offered by the mortal mind to one who toys with gods?
DOTA_Item_Desc_Origins_of_Faith: At all times the Anti-Mage feels the flames of defining loss burning against his back, pushing him ever forward in pursuit of his blood-sworn oath.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Ormr_the_Lunar_Dragon: From a race of dragons that normally patrols the dark side of the moon, Ormr wanted to see the world.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Ornaments_of_the_Arkturan: There is power yet in these old bones.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Ornaments_of_the_Gleaming:
Though they shine by moonlight, in truth the blades serve to draw the eye away from death's true instrument.

These Player Items are created in partnership with your favorite player, who receives a portion of every purchase.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Ornaments_of_the_Wyrmforg: The demasted figurehead of the Wyrmforge is just one of many lost relics gathered by the One for safe keeping and occasional good use.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Ornate_Mantle_of_Renewed_: The massive shoulders of Omniknight bear this armor well.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Osky_the_Ottragon: "Osky! Osky! What a good boy!" He capers and sports, but underneath the playful exterior is an abiding sadness. He misses his siblings.

Equippable by all heroes, the Overgrown Emblem imbues its chosen bearers with an exclusive emblem featuring the Aegis of Champions and custom ambient effect.

This cosmically rare prize was awarded as a random drop while opening Immortal Treasures during The International 2019 Battle Pass season.

Only one Emblem can be active on a team, so in matches with multiple players with Emblems, the active Emblems are determined by players' Battle Pass levels. Expires prior to The International 2020.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Overgrown_Empire: A jungle known as Fellstrath to outsiders brave enough to test its borders, this exclusive terrain must be unlocked before The International 2019 Battle Pass ends. This item will never be tradeable or purchasable on the marketplace.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Pack_of_the_Occultists_Pu: Mundane prey attracts the uninspired predator. A distinguished huntsman, on the other hand, seeks a prize not bound by earthly coils.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pack_of_the_Verdant_Outca: Never to plant his roots, always to wander the wilds.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Paddapon_of_Ribbitar:
Includes a Rare Prismatic Socket and custom colored particles. Socketing a Prismatic Gem will allow some of these colors to be replaced with the gem's color.

Padda'pon drums the song of death until the lives of Witch Doctor's enemies are extinguished.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pads_of_the_Blood_Stained: Relentless sun, scouring winds and the enemy's desperate slashes--these pads are proof against all.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pads_of_the_Crimson_Cutth: By the time Gondar was finished, little else remained of the Crimson Cut-throat's armor.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Paean_of_the_Ink_Dragon: Contains the Paean of the Ink Dragon set for Grimstroke, including the Loading Screen
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pale_Augur: To hear the baleful dirge is to feel its compelling hunger. It calls the sleepless dead to stir beneath the battlefield, grasping upwards to hasten the world's decay.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pale_Mausoleum: The dirge howls from the deep. Its call is irresistible, its song a melody of dark and cold. All will fall under the spell, be they tyrant or peasant, soldier or thief. The dirge shall claim.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Palladium_Amateur_Battle: Semi-pro and amateur teams gather to play for the prize pool of $60.
DOTA_Item_Desc_PandaFx_Tournament_1Vs1: PandaFx  200 Players in a 1Vs1 Tournament where they need to prove their skills to use only Pandas (Earth Spirit, Ember Spirit, Storm Spirit, Brewmaster) and a Prize Pool of 150$ or more!!
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pangolin_Carapace: This shelled carapace armor is meant to offer both protection and camouflage.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pangolin_Scarf: A bright scarf marked with the sigil of the Pangolin hunters' guild.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pangolin_Shoulder_Armor: Mastercrafted pauldrons of the Pangolin guild. They offer the strength of platemail at a fraction of the weight.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pantaloons_of_the_Freelan: These fine pantaloons show that Sven's travels have led him into gold as much as glory.
DOTA_Item_Desc_PantheonES_Cup: The top Dota 2 teams in Australia compete for the PantheonES CUP. Starting on the 21st and concluding on the 23rd, the tournament will put eight of the best Oceanic teams against each other to battle for a PantheonES Cup Title.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Paraflare_Cannon: Drifting in low-Clock orbit, this loyal satellite might not warrant designation as a moon, but it is no less honored a companion for all that. Its slow-falling flares are thorough spoilers of every enemy's shadowy plans.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Paragons_Poise: Some equipment hidden in the vault of Emauracus remains there for good reason -- certain pieces that deem a bearer unworthy will kill presumptuous wielders long before they encounter signs of an enemy.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Paragons_Pride: Some equipment hidden in the vault of Emauracus remains there for good reason -- certain pieces that deem a bearer unworthy will kill presumptuous wielders long before they encounter signs of an enemy.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Paragons_Pride_Bundle: Some equipment hidden in the vault of Emauracus remains there for good reason -- certain pieces that deem a bearer unworthy will kill presumptuous wielders long before they encounter signs of an enemy.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Paragons_Rebuke: The forgemaster of Emauracus boasts he's the finest smith alive. Some allow he may be right. Yet even he can only marvel at the enchanted works of the old ones--those long-dead knights who were amongst the first mortals to receive the blessings of the Omniscience.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Patch_Stash_and_Hobb: Patch charges in, and the others must follow. Stash bears the load, but utters no foul oaths. Hobb is just stuck here, consoled some by fresh oats.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pattern_of_the_Silken_Que: Contains Pattern of the Silken Queen set for Broodmother, including the Loading Screen
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pauldron_of_AlFusha: Al-Fusha was a great satyr general in service to Verodicia. It is said that he fell in battle and much of his wargear lost. Of it, this spiked and goddess-blessed pauldron remains.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pauldron_of_Sir_Davion: A dragon knight is protected not by armor, but his faith.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pauldron_of_Teardrop_Ice: Of the twelve legendary teardrop gems, eight were shattered, creating a vast tundra where once stood a burning waste.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pauldron_of_the_Blood_Moo: Banehallow often takes solace in the company of any fellow afflicted he might encounter in his wanderings. Not all, however, find the company of their own kind so agreeable.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pauldron_of_the_Chiseled_: A heavy counterweight to a heavy blade.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pauldron_of_the_Dreadborn: In the eyes of King Ostarion, the lives of his champions lost fighting to fuel the Wraith-Night rituals were merely his due tribute.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pauldron_of_the_Nimble_Ed: Give your foe no angle from which to strike.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pauldron_of_the_Red_Conqu: It seems a shame to cover Axe's mighty thews with pauldrons, but at least these are suitably red.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pauldron_of_the_Silent_Gu: Crafted by ancient artisans, these pauldrons protect Silencer from those who would do him harm.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pauldron_of_the_Warriors_: The rogue shoulders more than his share of grief and retribution.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pauldrons_of_Eternal_Harv: Long past time evil takes its fill, the feast goes on forevermore.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pauldrons_of_Fury: Upon your broad shoulders, the weight of the war rests.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pauldrons_of_Impending_Tr: In the fires of the pit, these Pauldrons were forged of rancid steel and demon hide.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pauldrons_of_Polymorphia: Water, they say, has a memory--but Morphling's dissolves with every form he takes. These pauldrons serve as a reminder of his original being, rooted in Polymorphia.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pauldrons_of_Retribution: With shoulders high, Dragonus gazes far across the world to search those who have incurred the anger of the Skywrath.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pauldrons_of_Sacred_Light: Some brethren proselytize without speaking a word; their sermons may be heard only in the ringing blows of the hammer.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pauldrons_of_the_Battle_C: Once a field filled with swords and storms, Lina left little but a smoking crater and handful of grateful allies.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pauldrons_of_the_Battlera:
To some authorities, the line between ranger and ruffian is nearly nonexistent.

Includes pauldrons, bracer, waistcoat, and boots, and can be upgraded with the 'Bindings of the Battleranger Style Unlock' granted to players who complete all fifteen Three-Star objectives on the Path of the Spellbinder.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pauldrons_of_the_Boreal_W: Forged by the Northern Drow from the ore of the chasm, these pauldrons bear the mark of the Boreal Watch.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pauldrons_of_the_Crypt_Gu: These razor-sharp pauldrons bring new meaning to the term shoulder blade.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pauldrons_of_the_Frozen_F: A day before the wizard descended into the glacier to begin his hibernation, he offered Crystal Maiden these last, precious gifts: armor and a staff, strong as ice but light as a feather, believed to have once belonged to a winter deity.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pauldrons_of_the_Gwimyeon: To truly conquer a foe, one must best both stem and root.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pauldrons_of_the_Infernal: While some amongst the Ultimyr faculty share concerns regarding the peculiar nature of Chief Curator Lannik's studies, none can deny that under his watch the Academy's archives of arcane knowledge have grown incomparably.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pauldrons_of_the_Northern: Generations from now, the denizens of Njord's Hearth shall know Windranger by these pauldrons should she ever return to their demesne.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Prize_of_the_Saltworn_Mar:
When he was just a lowly midshipman, and a young boy first at sea, the stories were meant to frighten. Whole fleets lost to a razortooth pointer--measuring longer than a frigate and twice as fast--hunting for sailors in their ships like a wolf seeks marrow in the bone. But Kunkka paid the tales no mind. He thought them mere rum-fueled scuttle, swapped to scare the cabin boys, and he had ranks to climb. It was only many years later, after he earned his gold-laced buttons and half his legend hunting and killing such a beast, that he truly understood...there are always bigger fish in the sea.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Pyrexaec_Floe: The Mer still tell tales of the dreadful night, when a raiding party of the finest Slithereen warriors returned with only two survivors. As each found the words, they warned of a two-headed demon that protected the bluffs of Grosche. At first the sea itself had saved the marauders from the lancing flames of one vile head. But the other, with the breath of frost and eyes of red, turned their own waters against them. The two survivors could only watch as their fellows were frozen in place atop icy waves, helpless to escape the renewed assault of cleansing fire.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Pyrexaec_Flux: For the children who live in the underground caverns of the Riverwarren, the Day of Pyres is filled with stories and celebrations of a noble dragon protector who long ago descended from the surface world to help the Riverwarren's people in a time of great need. As the children get older, dreams of the dragon's return will assuredly fade, and attentions turn to fine spirits and foolhardy flame play, but for a time their young minds will grasp the truth.

DOTA_Item_Desc_River_Vial_Blood:
Initially comes with 50 charges

Auctioned from the estate of a brilliant but failed alchemist, these mystical vials have the power to transform liquid water into nearly any substance. However, a steady hand is required. The next item on the auction block was the seeping corpse of the sneezing thaumaturge himself. Vial art, indeed.

Claim your River Vial at the in-game shop. Pour the contents into the river to transform it for 10 minutes. Transforming the river will consume one charge from your Armory supply, however no charges will be used if the item is sold, dropped, or destroyed during a game. Only one Vial can affect the river at a time.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Shards_of_the_Malignant_C: Far away beneath the Sunken Cities and through the Infernal Hollow, Buki'vak the Corrupted dwells in the depths forever expanding his corruption throughout the sea. Hearing of his power, Lion seeked to harvest his parts for a fresh demonoplasty. After a strenuous battle he defeated Buki'vak and gained the hand he desired as a reward, but it was not without cost. Just as his previous hand transformed him, so did this one. He became afflicted with the Malignant Corruption, causing unseemly shards of Obsidian to grow from his body and further disfigure him into something even more unrecognizeable from his original form.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Shield_of_the_Dark_Moon_S: The Dark Moon faithful consist of former scholars, laborers, orphans, and thieves. One may have served as magistrate of a city, another spilled blood as a warlord in the wilds. They have walked all imaginable paths to find Selemene. In her service, the trials and tragedies of the past matter not. They worship the Goddess together, guardians of the Nightsilver Woods.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Shield_of_the_Drake: Although forged from silver and jeweled with crimsonstone, this enchanted Shield of the Drake is no ornamental bauble to hefted at tourneys.  It is the deepest kind of magic, and its bearer could find no better protection.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Shield_of_the_Fractured_O: 'Hey your plumage looks nicer than mine. Wanna trade?'
DOTA_Item_Desc_Shield_of_the_Hazhadal_Ma: After besting the young mages of his order, Nortrom put his newfound skills to use suppressing the godless outlaws of the Hazhadall Barrens, routinely making short work of their vaunted enthrallers.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Shield_of_the_Hidden_Tale: Whatever magic his enemies use, whatever spells his foes may cast in his direction, bounce soundlessly off this shield of silence.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Shield_of_the_Reef_Kyte_R: Astride a fintail reef kyte and protected against the crush by an enchanted helm, the moon rider serves as Selemene's champion and emissary in forging undersea alliances and keeping creatures of the deep at bay.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Shield_of_the_Silent_Guar: Sometimes a lack of magic is the greatest magic of all.  But for those times when it isn't, this shield might help.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Shift_of_the_Silent_Guard: Cloaked in Silence, and also in this stylish shift.

Each battered and shaped upon the iron, and each imparting some vital essence, until at last the anvil crackled with piezoelectric power. When Magnus saw the hammer the blacksmith intended for him, he scoffed, choosing instead to make a weapon of the anvil itself.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Shooting_Star: Contains the Shooting Star set for Sniper, including the Loading Screen.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Shoulders_of_Petaluna: Though the priests of Dezun believe they alone possess the secrets of the ethereal shade, Dazzle's discovery of a race of insects in the lost jungles of Fellstrath capable of suckling energy directly from the Nothl Realm puts that claim to rest. But these creatures are inefficient with their feeding, and each puncture they create allows a bit of influence from the Nothl Realm to bleed into our own.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Silent_Wake: The midwinter drifts scatter in a silent gust from the passing ranger before settling gently back to earth, as if they were never disturbed at all.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Silent_Wake_of_the_Crimso: The midwinter drifts scatter in a silent gust from the passing ranger before settling gently back to earth, as if they were never disturbed at all.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Sina_Cup_Supernova_Season: Supernova tradition continues on with rising teams qualifying for chance to compete against top teams across China for prize pool of 90,000RMB.

Use this item to increase the rate at which you earn Battle Points to 150% for a single match. Additionally, you will grant other players a stacking 5% bonus to their Battle Points rate.

Battle Point Boosters are only consumed whenever Battle Points are earned and features like spectating games or coaching do not deplete them.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Sinorian_Sphere_Staff: A Sinorian gemstone caps this staff, providing a magical focus for nature's incantations.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sithils_Stash: That disreputable scoundrel Sithil has lost a chest of plundered loot! You will need <font color='#9da1a9'>Sithil's Summer Key</font> to open the chest. You can pick one up at the DOTA 2 Store. Beware! At the end of <font color='#9da1a9'>July 31, 2012</font> this chest will crumble into useless dust. This chest contains one of several mysterious new items.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sixense_eSport_Online_Tou: More than 64 teams will compete in Sixense eSport Online Tournament Season 1 that held on February 5 - 7, 2016 to win over IDR 2.800.000 prize pool.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Skarsnik_and_Gobbla: Contains the Skarsnik and Globbla set for Disruptor, including the Loading Screen
DOTA_Item_Desc_Skeletal_Catch: There might still be a little meat on it.  But probably not.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Skeletal_Claw_of_the_Vand: Lacking flesh, Clinkz adorns his skeletal hand with the claw of the Vandal.  Forged by smeevils in ages long past, this iron claw is for many hapless victims the iron grip of death itself.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Skins_of_the_Incubus: Few facets of the utter foul wander the land unbidden. To claim such a skin is to declare primacy over the inferno.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Skip_the_Delivery_Frog: What he lacks in size he makes up for in character.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Skirt_of_Petaluna: Though the priests of Dezun believe they alone possess the secrets of the ethereal shade, Dazzle's discovery of a race of insects in the lost jungles of Fellstrath capable of suckling energy directly from the Nothl Realm puts that claim to rest. But these creatures are inefficient with their feeding, and each puncture they create allows a bit of influence from the Nothl Realm to bleed into our own.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Skirt_of_the_Flameguard: Beyond reproach and unwavering in their devotion, the Flameguard stand as living avatars of Knightly Duty.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Skirt_of_the_Guardian_Con:
Though depictions of his body and form differ in the telling, the crackle of the Lightning Revenant's whip is known to all of the blessed few who have returned to life from the Narrow Maze.

This item can be upgraded with the 'Compact of the Guardian Construct Style Unlock' granted to players who complete at least 40 stars on the Path of the Dominator.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Skirt_of_the_Mage_Slayer: Time and practice would persuade the Anti-Mage against such a heavy garment, yet its use in combat has not diminished.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Skirt_of_the_Mothbinder: Dim though it has become, the spark of life that holds fast within the heart of the Death Prophet blazes like a signal beacon in the endless darkness of death's abyss, beckoning all manner of feasting shades that long to taste the essence of the animate world.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Skirt_of_the_Revenant: A new storm is blowing across the battlefield.  Where there is thunder, there is sure to be lighting.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Skittering_Desolation: When Weaver slipped through time, he found something impossible just beyond the rift.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Skull_Mask_o_Wicked_Badne: A mask crafted from the polished bones of a cruel Prefecturan noble. The Witch Doctor wears this mask when he wants influential spirits to take notice of his work.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Skull_Staff_of_Grim_Rites: The life essence of a sacrificial totem beast imbues this ritual staff.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Skull_of_the_First_Hunt:
A kit's first tools must come from the remains of its prey.

This item can be upgraded with the 'Kit of the First Hunt Style Unlock' granted to players who complete at least 40 stars on the Path of the Saboteur.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Skull_of_the_Ravager: Only the fiercest hunter may lay claim to the skull of a spiked ravager.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Skull_of_the_Razorwyrm:
Fierce opponent turned staunch protector.

This item can be upgraded with the 'Scale of the Razorwyrm Style Unlock' granted to players who complete all fifteen Three-Star objectives on the Path of the Warrior.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Skullsplitter_Axe: Axe never had the heart to wipe the original owner's blood from the edge.
DOTA_Item_Desc_SkyHigh_Warship: This bundle contains all of the items in the 'Sky-High Warship' set for Gyrocopter plus loading screen. These items were created in partnership with Alliance, who receive a portion of every purchase.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Skyfire_Apostate: Contains the Skyfire Apostate set for Keeper of the Light, including the loading screen
DOTA_Item_Desc_Skywarriors_Countenance: A holy relic passed down from the emperors of the ancient clouded city of Aesthera, this spellbound helm bestows the golden visage of the vulture goddess upon only the most elite warriors of the realm.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Skywrath_Mage_Arcana_Seco: Unlocks the secondary style for the Skyrath Mage Arcana.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Skywrath_Mages_ti8_back: Only by candlelight does Dragonus dare investigate the means to restore his lost love.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Skywrath_Mages_ti8_belt: Only by candlelight does Dragonus dare investigate the means to restore his lost love.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Skywrath_Mages_ti8_weapon: Only by candlelight does Dragonus dare investigate the means to restore his lost love.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Skywrath_Sentinel: Although she may never reach the lofty hights of the Ghastly Eyrie again, Shendelzare still has allies that will grant her assistance when she requires it.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Slab_of_Erupting_Wrath: Ambient particle effects can be unlocked on this item using the Tribute Upgrade Infuser - Fall Season 2015.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Slardar_Set_Back: During his long-ago tenure as a Dark Reef Enforcer, Slardar sharpened his spines breaking up escape attempts and quelling constant insurrections.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Slasher_of_the_Umizar_Cra: For those with a taste for gambling and excess treasure to spend, the hidden grottos of Crey host all manner of speculative bloodsports.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Slashing_Quickslicer: If cross words lead to crossed swords, then it's best to be polite to the Naga Siren.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Slashing_Quickslicer_Pack: This bundle contains both the main and off-hand Slashing Quickslicer.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Slashing_Quickslicer__Off: If cross words lead to crossed swords, then it's best to be polite to the Naga Siren.
DOTA_Item_Desc_SlayerSword_of_Sir_Davion: When facing a dragon the edge of one's blade means less than the sharpness of one's mind.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Slayers_Glare: Why light a fire if you can't watch it burn?
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sleeves_of_Lucid_Torment:
The dreamer's eyes are opened to a world of anguish.

This item can be upgraded with the 'Lucid Torment Style Unlock' granted to players who complete at least 40 stars on the Path of the Protector.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sleeves_of_the_Blackguard: In the early days following his escape from academia, long before he assumed the title of Invoker, the young magus sought to test his growing skill by any means attainable. Like many other young talents burning for a taste of adventure, it was not long before he answered the call to war.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sleeves_of_the_Charred_Bl: The rubies sewn into the sleeves are prized among the Misrule nobility.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sleeves_of_the_Ephemeral_: A billowing sleeve for Spectre, charged with the excess energy that overflows from Spectre's present form.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sleeves_of_the_Jiang_Shis: Should the mob ever come for him a second time, Ethreain will be ready.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sleeves_of_the_Royal_Butc: Though the carnage may go on without end, there are those alive still who can recall when it began. Ah, to be young and in the employ of the bloody King Brandalon once more.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sleeves_of_the_Scorching_: The sleeves flare out like the fiery soul who wears them.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sleeves_of_the_Solar_Divi: During her training in the flame arts, Lina chose to travel east to study with the followers of the Solar Goddess.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Slicer_of_the_Depths: A shiv assembled from contraband gems. Better not ask how Slark kept it concealed in Dark Reef Prison.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Slim_Blade_of_the_Tahlin_: When death is the price, one can never swing too many blades.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Slime_Vial:
Auctioned from the estate of a brilliant but failed alchemist, these mystical vials have the power to transform liquid water into nearly any substance. However, a steady hand is required. The next item on the auction block was the slimy corpse of the sneezing thaumaturge himself. Vial art, indeed.

Stand in the river to reveal the vial interface. Pour the contents into the river to transform it for 3 minutes. Each vial can be used once per game.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Slippers_of_the_Abyss:
In the voluminous depths, those who cannot move swiftly will be the first to die.

+15 Strength
+15 Agility

Required Level: 19

Active: Aqueous Rush
Increase movement speed by 200 for 4 seconds.

BONUS MOVEMENT SPEED: 90
BONUS ATTACK SPEED: 100
DOTA_Item_Desc_Slumbering_Terror: In the presence of Bane Elemental, to wake from the nightmare brings only the start of one's troubles. The dark tidings of evil travel not alone.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Small_Majesty_Of_The_Colo: In ages past, long before the settlements in the Azuran region were abandoned to ruin, the Odobenus forebearers harnessed the powers of rock, root, and iron to create fearsome guardians to watch over the tombs of their fallen legions even after the memories of their deeds had passed from the world. Little did they know the raw stone materials they'd utilized in one such creation also contained a powerful life force of its own, one not content to sit idly waiting for the threats of the outlands to arrive--one who would venture forth to stand watch over all lands in need of protection.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Smeevil: Tis said among artisan and warrior alike that there is no finer servant than a trusty smeevil.  However, a hero who chooses a smeevil as their courier may soon find these clever critters taking new forms in order to gain assistants of their own. Inspired by the great battles they bear witness to, a smeevil may become emboldened to press ever more exotic beasts to their cause.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Smeevil_Treat: A tasty snack used to unlock new Smeevil styles.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Smeevils_Penance:
Most smeevils find contentment in the endless tasks of a servant's duty, rarely creatures of idle thought. Banished to his post from a role in the lanes, Ar'zurm the Smeevil sees things differently.

This ward for The International 2016 can be upgraded with 4 different Smeevil's Penance Upgrade Style items. Upgrades unlock different colors.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Snaggletooth: From the forests beneath the Wailing Mountains, a new friend and companion appears, small in stature but enormous in spirit.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Snelfret_the_Snail: The original rebel snail, Snelfret refused to conform to a social order that enforced lethargy, a world that told him he must not move too fast. So he loaded up his shell and headed for more dynamic climes, determined to redefine the meaning of snail's pace.
DOTA_Item_Desc_SngLadder_Season_One: Hundreds of players fight for the top spot and valuable prizes in the SngLadder Season One League.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Snowdrop_Hood: Able to withstand the toughest onslaughts with nary a hair out of place, the Maiden of the North gives truth to the old adage that looks can kill.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Snowdrop_Mantle: For those times when giving someone the cold shoulder is only the beginning.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Snowdrop_Mittens: Crystal Maiden hardly needs to keep her hands warm in freezing weather. We suspect these are strictly a fashion statement.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Snowdrop_Staff: Not one for outward displays of force, Crystal Maiden understands the necessity of putting on a show. This brilliant staff is but a symbol of her inner power, and for all its luster, barely hints at the depths of her mastery.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Snowdrop_Tassels: No Wolf of Icewrack tail was harmed in the making of these tassels. They are formed entirely of soft, fluffy ice.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Snowl: The Goddess of the Moon presses many forest creatures into her service.  Always crafty, ever vigilant, little Snowl would give his all to aid the guardians of the Nightsilver.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Snowman_Noses: He'll stay friends as long as he can.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Snowstorm_Huntress: Contains all of the items in the 'Snowstorm Huntress' item set for Mirana plus loading screen.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Soaring_Cache: This treasure is only available to Fall 2015 Compendium owners.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Solar_Forge: An ancient relic pulled from the massive, dune-swept crater at the edge of the Scintillant Waste.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Solar_Gyre: Long separated from the matching headpiece, these relics were unearthed by a playful dragon toad in some corner of one desert or another--the dragon toad in question isn't so good with names--only regaining their shine when his friend traded them away to their surprisingly-shrewd rightful owner.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Solo_Mid_Battle_by_Terrik: Players from CIS will fight for the RAR.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Somos_Doteros_Tournament: An amateur tournament on sudamerica. Its focused on new teams who never participated in a tournament.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Somos_Gamer_Cup: Amateur tournament to test all the skill and strategy of Peru teams.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Songs_of_the_Caravan_Musi: Let the melodies of caravan life serenade you across the shifting sands of Druud with an acoustic homage to Artifact.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sorcerer_of_the_Black_Poo: Includes all of the items in the 'Dead Winter' set for Lich plus a loading screen:
DOTA_Item_Desc_Soul_Diffuser: By this blade shall you know her, bringer of death, bearer of your final moments of mortal terror.  She who renders your soul diffuse, your body lifeless dark, mere meat and viscera.  In a flash of movement, she slices your soul's tether, and frees you to learn the truth of the last great mystery.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Soul_Serpent: Unearthed from a Dead Reckoning Chest in recognition of The Revenant Muerta's arrival.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Soul_Shredder: While he'll shred with proper style when a soul hangs in the balance, on his own time Doom generally prefers to dabble in areas more torturously avant-garde.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Soul_Shredder_Bundle: While he'll shred with proper style when a soul hangs in the balance, on his own time Doom generally prefers to dabble in areas more torturously avant-garde.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Southamerican_Championshi: 24 South American teams: 16 qualified and 8 invited, compete for a  prize pool of $1,500.  Organized by TTesports, MyRevenge and DreamliveTV in partnership with AzubuTV.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Souvinir_of_the_Bone_Ru: Even skulls get lonely up in the ruins.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sovereign_of_the_Hive: Includes all of the items in the 'Sovereign of the Hive' set for Nyx Assassin plus a loading screen.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sovereign_of_the_Kray_Leg: Contains the Sovereign of the Kray Legions set for Sand King, including the Loading Screen
DOTA_Item_Desc_Spade_of_the_Gluttonous: Though crafted in symbolic likeness to the great wheel books of the ruined city, the Spade of the Gluttonous whistles no song but the song of death.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Span_of_Black_Nihility: Beneath the wings of Black Nihility lies terrible darkness. Those in their shadow must supplicate and despair.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Span_of_Sorrow: Like a shadow that chills the noonday sun, the span of the demon marauder is sure to darken any day.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Spanish_Dota_2_Pro_Series: The Spanish Dota 2 Pro Series is the first  professional league for Dota 2 in Spain created with the 8 best teams from Spain!
The finals of the Dota 2 Pro Series are the biggest event of Dota 2 in Spain. The live event will take place in Madrid from June 27th-29th.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Spark_of_the_Lightning_Lo: These items were created in partnership with Team Empire, who receive a portion of every purchase.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sparrowhawk_Bow: Strong, but light as a feather, this bow of the sparrowhawk will fly your arrows true to their targets.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sparrowhawk_Cape: In addition to being stylish, this cape of the sparrowhawk manages the trick of also being camouflaging, provided that you're standing next to a flock of sparrowhawks.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sparrowhawk_Hood: It takes a spectacular hood to tame your fiery red hair.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sparrowhawk_Quiver: Proving that every part of the sparrowhawk can be turned into a stylish item for Lyralei to wear, this quiver speaks to the utility of sparrowhawks as a species.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sparrowhawk_Wings: Tired of your shoulders being devoid of sparrowhawk feathers?  Then this item is for you.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Spaulder_of_Burning_Turmo: Within the astral turmoil, heat bends and matter swirls.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Spaulder_of_the_Steppe: Many a centaur was gored with this spiny spaulder.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Spaulder_of_the_Wandering: Seeking to restore the mantras of the Guardian Flame far beyond the embers of his ignition pyre in the Wailing Mountains, Xin loosed his remnants into the fury of a passing storm, casting them out in search of all who might still carry his spark.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Spaulders_of_The_Howling_: Bone-carved shoulder spaulders display the ceremonial markings of the Frosted Winds tribe.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Spaulders_of_the_Exact_Ma: Created in partnership with YYF, who receives a portion of every purchase.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Spaulders_of_the_Fracture: 'Hey your plumage looks nicer than mine. Wanna trade?'
DOTA_Item_Desc_Spaulders_of_the_Lost_Vig: Were there any Vigil Knights still alive to tell the tale, they might share a favorite yarn of the "Lost" Vigil patrol, a mystery with endless variations. Though most believed the missing knights lost at sea, some insisted there had been sightings recorded by the elders of Ashkavor--that the knights had been seen in the mountains that guard the unforgiving jungle lands of Fellstrath--a region already feared long before the destruction of Ashkavor made any journey into those lands impossible.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Spaulders_of_the_Wyrmforg: The demasted figurehead of the Wyrmforge is just one of many lost relics gathered by the One for safe keeping and occasional good use.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Spear_of_Teardrop_Ice: The two teardrop gems pressed into the haft ensure the spear's icy edge never thaws.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Spear_of_the_First_Hunt:
A kit's first tools must come from the remains of its prey.

This item can be upgraded with the 'Kit of the First Hunt Style Unlock' granted to players who complete at least 40 stars on the Path of the Saboteur.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Spear_of_the_Golden_Mane: To wield such a prized spear, one must have courage and ferocity befitting the honors of the Golden Mane.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Spear_of_the_Herald: An ancient weapon from an unknown craftsman, it was said to have been forged for he whom destiny calls worthy. Each swing heralds another step toward a new age.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Spear_of_the_Wildwings_Bl: It is unfortunate that a few rogue Wildkin must spoil the proud race's reputation, but when it is time to hunt those few rascals down, Enchantress bears a spear granted her by the wisest of the Wildwing race.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Spectator_Gem: Adding this gem to an item will enable that item to track games viewed for a league or team.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Spectral_Conservator: In her myriad manifestations, Spectre finds herself adapting to the exigencies of war. Slowly, she has converged on a more suitable form.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Spectral_Hunter: Unearthed from a Dead Reckoning Chest in recognition of The Revenant Muerta's arrival.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Spectral_Light: When moving between certain dark angles of creation, it is important that one not be mistaken for prey. The sigils on this headpiece serve as a warning to some interdimensional predator, but an invitation to others less visible.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Spectrolite_Staff: A staff bearing an array of spectrolite mana focusing crystals set in gold.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Speed_Boot_Shell_Style_Up: This International 2017 reward enables an upgraded shell to be unlocked for Hermes the Hermit Crab in the style menu.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Speed_Demon: This imp has trained all his life for this moment. He is SO ready to go. He will deliver your loot on time or suffer eternal damnation in the sixty-four planes of the Lesser Hells.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Spell_Surveyor: The Spell Surveyor is always on the lookout for spells that might be stolen!
DOTA_Item_Desc_Spellbinders_Catalytic_Ma: When Rubick dons his catalytic mantle, things really start happening.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Spellbinders_Forgotten_Gr: Rubick completely forgot about this greatstaff until just this moment!
DOTA_Item_Desc_Spellbinders_Mask_of_Shap: Feeling ferocious, or simply for a lark, Rubick likes to take this old thing out and show it off from time to time.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Spellbinders_Tattered_Clo: It is difficult in battle for even a great mage to entirely avoid treading on his cloak. Eventually it begins to show wear.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Spellbreaker_of_Yoskreth: The sovereign of Yoskreth insisted that their champion be given the finest guard they could forge.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Spetum_of_the_Disciplined: While a sharp point may make a weapon dangerous, it takes a disciplined arm to make it deadly.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Spider_of_Purple_Nightmar: Includes all of the items in the 'Spider of Purple Nightmare' set for Witch Doctor:
DOTA_Item_Desc_Spidering_of_the_Gluttons: Though the endless march of adventuring fools certainly disturbed the safety of her spiderlings, the constant supply of fresh treasure hunters did wonders for Arachnia's figure.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Spiked_Bracers_of_the_Rav: To kill a ravager is a sacred rite for the ursa, and every piece of the carcass must be put to use.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Stoneshard_Bracers: Earthshaker's might is bound in majesty.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Stoneshard_Crown: As the molten earth cooled, its will was manifested in the Stoneshard Crown; but there was no coronation until Earthshaker's arrival.

DOTA_Item_Desc_StormStealers_Armor: All the sweeter for being stolen, Razor wears an armor alive with the energy of the storms he has angered.
DOTA_Item_Desc_StormStealers_Belt: Paraded with pride, Razor flaunts the power he draws from electric skies.
DOTA_Item_Desc_StormStealers_Helm: Razor hides his face beneath this helm, that no lightning-lashing storm may recognize him.
DOTA_Item_Desc_StormStealers_Whip: With a power seized from nature at its nastiest, Razor lashes the Narrow Maze's victims toward their end.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Storm_Spirit_Announcer_Pa:
This pack replaces the Default announcer and Mega-Kills announcer with the boisterous theatrics of Storm Spirit.
	
	Announcer available in English, Chinese, and Korean languages. Killing Spree available in English and Korean languages.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Stormcharge_Dragoon:
Astride the focused storm, Disruptor stalks the boundaries of battle, ready to strike down his enemies and lead his tribe's return to a place of distinction and honor.

Contains the Stormcharge Dragoon set for Disruptor, including the Loading Screen.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Stormthrasher: The power of the summer squalls lays a thrashing on the enemies of Disruptor.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Stormwrought_Arbiter: Contains the Stormwrought Arbiter set for Sven, including the Loading Screen
DOTA_Item_Desc_Strange_Modifier_Double_S: This pack contains a Runesmith's Chisel and a Double Shackles Gem. The chisel can be used to add a socket to any item and the Double Shackles Gem can be placed in a socket.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Strange_Modifier_Quad_Rav: This pack contains a Runesmith's Chisel and a Quad Ravages Gem. The chisel can be used to add a socket to any item and the Quad Ravages Gem can be placed in a socket.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Strange_Modifier_Wards_Pu: This pack contains a Runesmith's Chisel and a Wards Purchased Gem. The chisel can be used to add a socket to any item and the Wards Purchased Gem can be placed in a socket.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Strap_of_Black_Nihility: Magnificent is the stature of the creatures of the primordial night, and so must also be the garments that adorn them.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Strap_of_the_Iron_Will: None may challenge the breaker's will.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Strength_of_the_Demon_Sto: This bundle contains all of the items in 'Strength of the Demon Stone' set for Earth Spirit plus loading screen:
DOTA_Item_Desc_Strifemaul_of_Hells_Ambas: He who speaks for Hell may carry the Strifemaul to further emphasize the important points of his argument.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Strongback_the_Swift: Whether you're lost in strange lands with pressing ceremonial business elsewhere, or just in need of an extra flask of clarity on the battlefield, you can usually count on Strongback, a stalwart wayfarer who frequently lives up to his name. Though his best days are perhaps behind him, Strongback will always be remembered as the hero of The International 2017. Or at least the hero of two other wannabe heroes who would have missed it all were it not for him.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Stumpy_the_Hearty: Stumpy isn't very good in battle, but he's more than happy to haul around your loot and he's always there when you need him.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Stuntwood_Sanctuary_of_th:
On less robust trees, the creeping vines of a stuntwood sproutling would signal a slow, starving death. The fae folk consider the vines and their issue as invasive species to be killed on sight. For Treant Protector, however, the sproutlings are a bit of harmless company whose vines offer a patch of thorny armor on his flanks.
	
	This item was received after witnessing First Blood at The International 2017.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Stuntwood_Symbiont: If a host tree survives the stuntwood's parasite stage, and the sproutlings choose to bond with it, their tendrils develop an alternate source of nutrients that nourish tree and vine alike.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sturdy_Bracers_of_the_Exi: To stand strong and steadfast alone against the world.. with no master to guide him.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Style_Cup_55: Players from CIS will fight for an item prize pool.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Style_of_the_Battleranger:
To some authorities, the line between ranger and ruffian is nearly nonexistent.

This item can be upgraded with the 'Bindings of the Battleranger Style Unlock' granted to players who complete all fifteen Three-Star objectives on the Path of the Spellbinder.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Style_of_the_Fearful_Aria: Created in partnership with EternaLEnVy, who receives a portion of every purchase.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Style_of_the_Fervent_Cons: As the young orphan outgrew adolescence and his mastery of the Turstarkuri scrolls improved, he became eager to test his blades and begin his longed-for crusade to rid the world of magic, ultimately finding first opportunity as a volunteer in the failed defense of Bakhwarren.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Style_of_the_Glacier_Dust:
A cool look from the heart of winter!

These Player Items are created in partnership with your favorite player, who receives a portion of every purchase.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Style_of_the_Occult_Prote: A fashion for those who vow to protect the mysteries.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Stylish_Wizards_Topnot: Few wizards can be considered to be stylish, but the Invoker is not like other wizards.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Sufferwood_Sapling: Nature is not a unified cause or philosophy. Feared by all that is green, the tainted Sufferwood hosts a consciousness bent on dominating everything that grows, sending forth blooming horrors to corrupt the wilds to its purpose.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Suit_of_the_Darkbrew_Enfo: 'You gonna do what the little guy says, or we collectin' with interest?'
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sullen_Harvest: The hooded figure that waits beyond the veil pays close mind to the path of the Necrophos. For where Rotund'jere's footsteps fall, the reaper's work will surely follow.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sullen_Hollow: Idly drumming phantom phalanges, Sullen Hollow barely restrains its impatience to lash out and administer tainted browbeatings to the foes of Necrophos.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sullen_Rampart: In a lost corner of the underworld, endless damned souls scrape and claw to reach the top of their unfathomable mass, none comprehending that no such summit exists, and only by the whims of their tormentor himself might a chosen few briefly see the light of day again.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sullen_Sanctum: Even those stout enough to feign resistance to Rotund'jere's foul air must blanch at the following flocks of messengers, awing from the spirit realm and eagerly awaiting the needs of inevitable passage.

DOTA_Item_Desc_Summers_Bounty: Who would want to run away from such a beautiful spear?
DOTA_Item_Desc_Summers_Charm: Bedizened with oaken branches, Enchantress easily blends into the rich summer shade.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Summers_Light: Wearing these luminous pauldrons, Enchantress honors the glory of the summer sky.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Summers_Mirth: Mirth and merriment bedeck the lovely Enchantress. Ivy is cool in summer and who cares about winter anyway?
DOTA_Item_Desc_Summers_Warmth: Every warm summer day must eventually give way to the cool breezes of evening. This light covering is more than enough to ward off goosebumps.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Summertime_Madness_Champi: Watch 24 South African teams battle it out in the first annual Summertime Madness Dota 2 Championship
DOTA_Item_Desc_Summon_Penguin: Summons a friendly penguin who slides around.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sunbreeze_Birthright: While Mireska happily left nearly every trapping of her old life behind when she fled Revtel, she knew the only thing that might displease her father more than losing the family birthright in the fire would be to imagine it in the hands of his delinquent daughter.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sunday_Evening_Amateur_Le: The Sunday Evening Amateur League is based in the Pacific Timezone of North America.  Players of all skill levels are formed into teams that compete for roughly three months.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sunday_Evening_Cup_Series: The Sunday Evening Cup Series (SECS) began in December 2009 and is the longest running Dota tournament series to date. SECS provides an open competitive platform for North and South American teams to gain real tournament experience.

SECS is back for Season 2! SECS has been around since 2009 and provides an open competitive platform for North and South American teams to gain real tournament experience.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sunken_Emblem:
Equippable by all heroes, the Sunken Emblem imbues its chosen bearers with an exclusive emblem featuring the Aegis of Champions and custom ambient effect.

This exceedingly rare prize was awarded for landing the winning shot in Slark's Riptide Rumble during The International 2017 Battle Pass season.

Only one Sunken Emblem can be active on a team, so in matches with multiple players with Sunken Emblems, the active Sunken Emblems are determined by players' Battle Pass levels. Expires prior to The International 2018.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sunken_Gaoler_Set_Style_U: This International 2017 Battle Pass reward enables an upgraded style to be unlocked on the Sunken Gaoler set for Slardar through the style menu. You can use this item multiple times to unlock styles on all of the items in the set.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sunrise_Challenge: The biggest Far East e-sports festival. Check out the latest news on sunrisecup.ru
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sunt_CDEC_New_Star_Cup: New Star is the continuation of traditional selection mode, the new team through the online registration will challenge pro teams which include DK, iG, LGD, VG and fight for 100000RMB price pool.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Super_Battle_of_the_Citie: 32 teams across Russian cities compete for a prize of $2000!
DOTA_Item_Desc_Support_TI10_Cavern_Crawl: This item can be used to unlock an alternate style for the Echoes of Ultoria Divine Path item set for Spirit Breaker.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Supreme_Black_Orc_Warboss: Contains the Supreme Black Orc Warboss set for Axe, including the Loading Screen
DOTA_Item_Desc_Surgical_Precision: Bored with careless slaughter, the butcher takes aim at a new occupation, though he brings the same talent for slaughter.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sven_TI7_Immortal_Sword: Amongst the debris of a sunken galley that once sailed beneath the Vigil banner, the Rogue Knight lay hands on a prized relic worthy of setting the Outcast Blade aside.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Swag_Cup_Season_1: 32 teams from the CIS will battle for a prize of 100$
DOTA_Item_Desc_Swamp_Fins: Nobody is certain whether this display means the Tidehunter is angry or in heat.  Either way, none have survived to ask.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sweaty_Cup: Semi-pro teams and amateurs compete in this tournament for 16,000 Rubles!
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sweaty_Cup_2: 32 semi-pro and professional teams participate in the 2nd season of the Sweaty Tournament with a $1,200 prize pool. This bundle gives access to view games from the Sweaty Cup 2 Tournament and the Deep Observer ward.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sweaty_Cup_2_Ticket: 32 semi-pro and professional teams participate in the 2nd season of the Sweaty Tournament with a $1,200 prize pool. This ticket only gives access to view games from the Sweaty Cup 2 Tournament.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sweep_of_Black_Nihility: The presence of primordial night lingers even as darkness passes.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sweep_of_Forsaken_Beauty: Silken cloths sweep the ground where Medusa wanders.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Swift_Claw: You may flee from his rage. You may leave his echoing roar far behind. And you may think yourself safe, perhaps in a clearing or canyon, with no sign of your pursuer. Then, suddenly, his claws find you, and it is the last you know.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Swift_Pathfinder: Contains the Roving Pathfinder set for Windranger, including the Loading Screen.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Swine_Arsenal: Techies Demolitions built hundreds of custom-built explosives to use with The Swine, but Spleen thought they were so adorable he couldn't bear to part with them as they were loading the cannon onboard the galley.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Swine_Helmet: When constructing The Swine, Techies Demolitions also forged some stylish headgear for its crew.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Swine_Powder_Barrel: Safely firing The Swine requires a custom mix of flammable powders, which Squee completely forgot to mention to the crew of the doomed galley who purchased the cannon.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Swine_Visor: For some reason, the galley captain who commissioned The Swine didn't want the headgear that came with it. His loss.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Swooping_Elder: Contains the Swooping Elder set for Gyrocopter, including the Loading Screen.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sword_of_Impending_Transg: A sword ever being forged, red hot, glowing with the heat of all the seven hells.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sword_of_the_Admirable_Ad: An exceptional specimen, surely the Captain's first pick of the loot. The hilt is dressed in worked gold and exotic stones. The blade blessed with a strangely glowing enchantment.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sword_of_the_Drake: One of only a dozen swords in existence known to have slain more than one dragon.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sword_of_the_Flameguard: A heavily weighted sword fashioned in the two-handed style of the Flameguard sect of the Vigil Knights.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sword_of_the_Freelancer: "Bitter the orphans journey--and lonely the orphan's grave."
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sword_of_the_Mono_Militis: The Mono Militis are one of several sects among the Vigil Knights. Adherents have tasked themselves with hunting down those who have strayed from the teachings of the Vigil Codex.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sword_of_the_One_True_Kin: In an age lost even to his own memory, Ostarion fed his lust for eternal life not with spectral essence, but a nigh-unending harvest of bone. The walls of his palace were formed of fired bone; the streets paved with bones of every sort of creature and every enemy. And those of the flesh who entered this domain took great care, for the King was first and foremost a collector, and nothing moved in the Empire of Bone without summoning the gaze of his unblinking eyes.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sword_of_the_Seventy_Seve: Here we have a weapon truly worthy of a man such as Kunkka. Exotic and well-balanced, this cutlass cuts an image as smartly as it cuts a man.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sword_of_the_Smoldering_S: In life, the warrior-poet's later-day accomplishments were even more impressive than those of his youth, as the wisdom of his years finally grew to match the purity of his martial arts.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sword_of_the_Warriors_Ret: A weapon that once belonged to Sven's father, it was years before the son discovered its transformative properties.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sylnashar_the_Winged_Axe: Lost for centuries, the winged axe known as Sylnashar was once the favored weapon of an ancient king.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sylvan_Cascade: A cape woven from the finest wind-strewn filaments of enchanted ephemera, this is a garment of both rare beauty and unexpected utility.  For she who wears the cape of the Sylvan Cascade, the wind will be always at her back.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sylvan_Guards_Boots: The guardians of the forest paths walk in perfect silence, betrayed not by their cunning footwear.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sylvan_Guards_Bow: Drow has nothing to learn from the Sylvan Guard, but from time to time she relieves one of them of their bow, that she might test its quality. Even by her standards, this one is adjudged very fine.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sylvan_Guards_Cape: Stealth is of utmost importance to those who number themselves among the Sylvan Guard. Even Drow finds this an acceptable cape for moving unseen through the wooded ways.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sylvan_Guards_Cuffs: In her youth, Drow was tempted once or twice to throw over her lonely ways and join the Sylvan Guard. These cuffs were a large part of the attraction.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sylvan_Guards_Dress_Armor: It must be admitted: Drow admires the Sylvan Guard. When from time to time she puts on their gear, and pretends to adopt their ways, she can hardly suppress her joy in having an excuse to don this stylish armor.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sylvan_Guards_Finery_Set: All the finery of the Sylvan Guard, complete!
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sylvan_Guards_Hair: While not a member of the Sylvan Guard, Drow spies upon them in their marches, and occasionally admires their passing fashions.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Sylvan_Guards_Quiver: The archers of the Sylvan Guard shoot only arrows crafted specifically for their use. When Drow uses their gear, such arrows are de rigeur.

The intruders are like succulent shelled insects upon whose innards she's gorged, all the while growing curious of the adornments that drape their bodies, until that day when a blacksmith found his way into her web.  Armor he promised her, the finest in the land, if only she would set him free. And so a deal was struck, and the blacksmith measured, and toiled, taking as his materials the finest steel to be found among the husked corpses of silk-wrapped knights.  When the new armor was finished, the spider kept her promise and set the blacksmith free.  Then she watched her brood devour him. Contains all of the items in the 'Brood Queen' set for Broodmother:

DOTA_Item_Desc_The_Gallows_Understudy_Se:
Far from the temples of the Flayed Twins, Bloodseeker stumbled upon a land that lauded execution above sacrifice, relying on hempen rope and metal blades instead of black stone and the will of bloodthirsty gods. Yet there was something in their crude approach that appealed to him, and so he spent a season studying the executioners, watching from the crowd that turned out for every morbid spectacle, until he realized that the mob itself was the god to whom they made their sacrifices. With a leer that matched those to be seen on the faces of the enrapt audience, he made his way home to share the lessons he had learned with his own bloody masters of the priestly caste.
Includes all items from the Gallows Understudy Set.

If she was to be exiled, then so be it. Enormous, powerful and reclusive, these strange, scarce birds range across the highest peaks of the Prefect mountains, hidden from the world by a constant bank of dark cloud. Their rare sighting are considered ill omens, said to portend of storms soon to follow.
Legends also tell of those few who have dared face the dangerous trials required to harness the power of these creatures for themselves.
For the only way to return after stealing the egg of a stormcrow - a potent source of power - is to wrestle control of one of the enormous black birds and ride it down to the ground, miles below.  Includes all of the items in 'The Stormcrow's Spirit' set for Witch Doctor:

	The Timekeeper TA set draws inspiration from JJ Lin's Timeline World Tour. In the world where man chimes the hour, our days are precious precisely because they are limited. From music to gaming, he weaves his role of The Timekeeper into the Templar Assassin. DOTA_Item_Desc_Tree_Decorations:
Festive trappings for even the bloodiest of battlefields.

This special variant of Frosthaven consumable can be used in normal games of Dota, minus the deleterious effects.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Tree_Punisher: Contains the Tree Punisher set for Timbersaw, including the Loading Screen.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Trek_of_the_Trailblazer: Contains the Trek of the Trailblazer set for Timbersaw, including the Loading Screen.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Tremors_of_the_Tandem_Sto: At first Disruptor discounted the thought that an egg so ancient could possibly issue life. But the device cradling it certainly sparked with energy still. And if his interpretations of the nearby parchments he'd found were correct...
DOTA_Item_Desc_Trials_of_the_Blackguard_: In the early days following his escape from academia, long before he assumed the title of Invoker, the young magus sought to test his growing skill by any means attainable. Like many other young talents burning for a taste of adventure, it was not long before he answered the call to war.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Tribal_Megadon_Mask: All bones are said to tell the deeds of their owners, yet the creature that once held this skull died small and of unknown causes. Thus it is worn into battle as a mask, so that these bones may soon be granted stories of their own.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Tribal_Pathways: Contains the Tribal Pathways set for Warlock
DOTA_Item_Desc_Tribal_Stone_Edge: The weight of stone drives every swing.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Tribal_Stone_Horns: To the elder tribes of the stone hills, all is of hewn rock and carved edge.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Tribal_Stone_Pauldron: Those of the stone hills view the gift of flight as a gift from the heavens, and so arms are made to honor those that soar above.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Tribal_Stone_Set: This bundle contains all of the items in the 'Tribal Stone' set for Beastmaster:
DOTA_Item_Desc_Tribal_Stone_Vambrace: In the stone hills, the elder tribes endure unknown to the rest of the world.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Tribal_Terror: Contains all of the items in the 'Tribal Terror' set for Bloodseeker plus loading screen.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Tribal_Totem_Mask: Not all of the Witch Doctor's enslaved spirits are ancestors. This household totem contains the trapped soul of a swamp dwelling Yando beast.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Tribute_Upgrade_Infuser__: This consumable item unlocks ambient particle effects on the following items available through Fall Season 2015 Compendium Treasures: Leshrac's Spirethorn, Lina's Dress of the Bewitching Flame, Spectre's Crest and Edge of the Flowering Shade, Tusk's Cannon Punch of the Barrier Rogue, Tidehunter's Aquemerald Blade, Ursa's Claws of the Ferocious Heart, Drow's Algid Legacy, Phantom Assassin's Armor of the Fearful Aria, Shadow Shaman's Shade of the Spiteful Eye, Magnus's Slab of Erupting Wrath, Vengeful Spirit's Blade of Flightless Fury, and Batrider's Queen of the Jack Bomber
DOTA_Item_Desc_Tribute_of_the_Piercing_B: Each set within this treasure contains at least one item that can be transformed to include ambient particles by using a Tribute Upgrade Infuser - Fall Season 2015.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Tribute_of_the_Sharpened_: Each set within this treasure contains at least one item that can be transformed to include ambient particles by using a Tribute Upgrade Infuser - Fall Season 2015.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Tricorne_of_the_Drowned: A well crafted tricorne edged in gold.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Trident_of_the_Deep_One: Once the temple's caryatids looked out upon a mountain fastness, but those lofty peaks have long since slumped beneath the waves. No one remembers who carved those guardian figures, or even what that nation called itself. And the statue merely scowled a little when Slardar slipped the ancient trident free of its barnacle-encrusted paws.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Trident_of_the_Sea_Stalke: A trident cursed by a host of sea gods and sealed within in the depths of the Coral Breach for thousands of years.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Trine_Announcer_Pack: This pack replaces the Default announcer and Mega-Kills announcer with the soothing tones of Trine's tale-weaving narrator.
DOTA_Item_Desc_TriniDota_2_League: The top teams of Trinidad and Tobago compete to be crowned champions!
DOTA_Item_Desc_Triumph: Many will fight.  Few will achieve immortality.
DOTA_Item_Desc_Triumph_of_the_Four_Corne: Contains the Triumph of the Four Corners set for Brewmaster, including the Loading Screen
DOTA_Item_Desc_Troll_Warlords_Default_Me: Troll Warlord's Default Melee Off-Hand Weapon

	DotA2  US$ 1,500,000
	Counter Strike: Global Offensive  US$ 1,500,000
	Starcraft II  US$ 400,000
	Hearthstone  US$ 300,000

DOTA_Item_Desc_Winter_Snowdrop: It is little known of Crystal Maiden, that in her long study of the Frozen Arts, she once greatly displeased her Ice Wizard master and to restore herself to his graces and prove worthy of his instruction, she passed a year dwelling in the climes of slush where the Blueheart Glacier spends itself at the edge of the Boiling Sea. Here, where snow had never fallen, Rylai spent months in deep meditation, mastering her powers, before waking one afternoon with a single frigid word upon her lips: 'Snowdrop!' For a moment, the steam that filled the air turned to ice, and the warm precipitation became a softly falling snow. When she returned to her old teacher, she found him waiting with a smile, fully aware of the magic she had wrought, as he presented her this outfit to show her worth and mastery.

In an age now lost to time, the Frozen Witch Yulsaria ruled the whitelands, summoning blizzards and hail storms upon those who displeased her, while an army of ice golems roamed the lands to snuff out all warmth. In time, her southward expansion angered the Eldwurm Slyrak who, in his terrible rage, melted Yulsaria's armies with his endless flame before conquering the Frozen Witch herself. Now, centuries later, shifts in the ice have uncovered yet another shard of her empire: her frosty mantle.

DOTA_Item_Desc_ti8_bristleback_head: And here Rigwarl thought "Crystalback" had a nice ring to it...
DOTA_Item_Desc_treant_ti7_immortal: On less robust trees, the creeping vines of a stuntwood sproutling would signal a slow, starving death. The fae folk consider the vines and their issue as invasive species to be killed on sight. For Treant Protector, however, the sproutlings are a bit of harmless company whose vines offer a patch of thorny armor on his flanks.
DOTA_Item_Desc_troll_ti10_immortal_shoul: Given his abiding distaste for negotiations, barter, and population centers in general, Jah'rakal must display rare restraint with his axework when he decides to acquire something nice.
DOTA_Item_Desc_undying_fall20_immortal_t: Though the Dirge itself makes the Dead God's will known to his followers, there are times when a more direct means of communication with the world of the living is called for, when an emissary is chosen from amongst the many to bear the transformation and come to speak for the lord of horror.
DOTA_Item_Desc_viper_immortal_head_ti7: Though he spurned most of the magics practiced by his naive captor, the inquisitive Netherdrake did take interest in his master's success in the realm of augmentations.
DOTA_Item_Desc_warrior_of_the_steppe_arm: In parade to and from the arena of Omexe, no other fighter dares ride close to the Warrunner.
DOTA_Item_Desc_warrior_of_the_steppe_bac: No centaur shall ever wear a saddle, but a caparison such as this one is looked upon with high regard--provided one has earned it.
DOTA_Item_Desc_warrior_of_the_steppe_bel: Not the fabled plate of Omexe, but the next best thing.
DOTA_Item_Desc_warrior_of_the_steppe_hel: Near the height of his climb through the ranks of the arena, Bradwarden donned this helm, and could be recognized by cheering crowds when the first tip of horn appeared from the arena gates.
DOTA_Item_Desc_warrior_of_the_steppe_tai: In the arenas of Omexe, it would not do to offer an opponent much of a grip.
DOTA_Item_Desc_wavecutter: This fin will slice the water like its owner's blade will slice your throat.
DOTA_Item_Desc_wd_ti10_immortal_weapon: As Awaleb's destructive powers grew, so too did the influence of his healing touch. Indeed, one only need look for the flourishing lands and overgrown fauna to follow the path of his great atrocities.
DOTA_Item_Desc_wd_ti8_immortal_bonkers: Though the origins of Zharvakko's brand of arcanism are somewhat murky, and largely apocryphal, the exploits of the influential healer Awaleb are known far and wide. In an age of famine, disease, and unending violence, Awaleb concluded that the ailments of his people amounted to mere symptoms of a much greater sickness. So he began to turn his legendary cauldron towards the dark arts of harm. His people could always trust his word and prescriptions, but his greater act of service to them was a willing corruption of sacred vows in the name of protection, and the twisted legacy he would leave behind.
DOTA_Item_Desc_wk_ti8_weapon: Though the lifespans of Ostarion's subjects are not eternal, the forever king's dark magic ensures their loyalties will be.
DOTA_Item_Desc_yber_Master_League_Cup_#1: 16 teams from Europe and Russia fight for a 100$ prize pool
DOTA_Item_Desc_zeus_2021_immortal_gold: Though his powers may not be what they once were -- a temporary issue of course -- the god of thunder isn't keen to let his position in the pantheon slip so easily away.

DOTA_Item_League_GEST_Desc: The Gigabyte E-Sports Tournament is sponsored by Gigabyte and hosted by DotaTalk. The winners of six qualifiers from South-East Asia will face off against veteran teams for a cash prize of $1,500 and the chance to compete against two of the best Chinese teams, IG and LGD, for another $1500.
DOTA_Item_League_PremierLeague_Desc: Fueled by joint forces of TwitchTV and SteelSeries, Season 3 is the newest edition of The Premier League. Watch 10 of the best teams from both Europe and North America contend for $6,000 with 5 intense matches every week for 9 weeks. Commentary by TriumphOfMan.
DOTA_Item_League_RaidCall_Desc: The RaidCall Dota 2 League is a $10,000 online Dota 2 tournament series featuring the top Dota 2 teams from around the globe. Broadcast four days a week for over eight weeks, the D2L (as it's commonly called) is commentated live by Ayesee and invited guests.

DOTA_Item_League_StarSeries3_Desc: StarLadder's Star Series is one of the most prestigious Dota 2 leagues, powered by Intel & Asus and casted by v1lat and TobiWan. The keystone of Star Series is the LAN final, held in Kiev CyberSport Arena, Ukraine. Watch the best Dota 2 teams compete for $15,000 and the title Star Series Champion.

DOTA_Seasonal_Quartero_Description: Play Dota and unlock hero cosmetics for free!
DOTA_Seasonal_Fall_2025_Intro:
"Greetings, heroes! I am Quartero the Unburdened! Pay no attention to my untrustworthy face! Focus instead on the words coming from my untrustworthy mouth.

What if I told you I was prepared to lavish you with priceless treasures... for free?

What's the catch? The catch... is that there is no catch! So one catch total."
DOTA_Seasonal_Fall_2025_Description: Play Dota and unlock hero cosmetics for free!
DOTA_Seasonal_Winter_2025_q02_intro_01: "Welcome back to Quartero's Curios... now with new and improved antiques!
DOTA_Seasonal_Winter_2025_q02_intro_02: Quartero's been reading all his fan mail, and the feedback is unanimous!
DOTA_Seasonal_Winter_2025_q02_intro_03: Everybody LOVED the antiques giveaway! And HATED the antiques giveaway!
DOTA_Seasonal_Winter_2025_q02_intro_04: So! This time, Quartero's going to make sure your first antique is an extra super-duper special one!
DOTA_Seasonal_Winter_2025_q02_intro_05: Hand-chosen by yours truly to be one of the highest possible quality.
DOTA_Seasonal_Winter_2025_q02_intro_06: Then it's back to the usual stuff. But! You'll get more chances to win it.
DOTA_Seasonal_Winter_2025_q02_intro_07: Last but not least! Now you'll get to pick your treasure from an assortment of options.
DOTA_Seasonal_Winter_2025_q02_intro_08: Everything else is the same! Play the game and win free one-of-a-kind item sets!
DOTA_Seasonal_Winter_2025_q02_intro_09: Thanks to me, Quartero! The happy goat-man you write angry, viciously insulting mail to."
DOTA_Seasonal_Winter_2025_Description: Play Dota and unlock hero cosmetics for free!
DOTA_Seasonal_Winter_2025_Outro_01: "Tick-tock, hero! Don't let the clock run out on these priceless treasures!
DOTA_Seasonal_Winter_2025_Outro_02: Once that timer hits zero, these item sets will disappear... FOREVER! POSSIBLY! Who's to say! They'll be gone for a while anyway."
DOTA_Seasonal_Spring_2026_q02_intro_01: "Welcome back to Quartero's Curios! The quarterly... quarterly-ish?
DOTA_Seasonal_Spring_2026_q02_intro_02: Who am I kidding, this is Valve, the REGULAR feature where I give you all-new item sets and chances at classic antiques, all for free, and all for doing what you do best: Playing Dota.
DOTA_Seasonal_Spring_2026_q02_intro_03: Let me check with the team quick and see if there are any new announcements for this season.
DOTA_Seasonal_Spring_2026_q02_intro_05: Sometimes when you get five antique options, two of them might be the same.
DOTA_Seasonal_Spring_2026_q02_intro_06: Apparently they fixed that. Nice work, everyone. Anything else?
DOTA_Seasonal_Spring_2026_q02_intro_07: Evidently some of you have been playing long enough that you own... a LOT of shit.
DOTA_Seasonal_Spring_2026_q02_intro_08: So sometimes when you do your antique pull you'll already own everything.
DOTA_Seasonal_Spring_2026_q02_intro_09: Not much we can do about that, unless you want us to start deleting your inventory so you get the thrill of the chase back.
DOTA_Seasonal_Spring_2026_q02_intro_10: No, I didn't think you'd like that. Anyway, now you get shards.
DOTA_Seasonal_Fall_2026_q05_intro_01: "Our story so far! Master thief Blake Sextus found out an evil sorcerer named Galdron had a vault full of priceless treasure!
DOTA_Seasonal_Fall_2026_q05_intro_02: So! He hired yours truly and my sister Quintessa to help him steal it!
DOTA_Seasonal_Fall_2026_q05_intro_03: Did it go well? Ha ha! No. No it did not.
DOTA_Seasonal_Fall_2026_q05_intro_04: Galdron locked Blake and Quintessa in his vault!
DOTA_Seasonal_Fall_2026_q05_intro_05: Now they're about to run out of water, and air, and all those other things you tend to run out of in a sealed vault.
DOTA_Seasonal_Fall_2026_q05_intro_06: If all that sounds confusing, don't worry! It just means you're not a lunatic and you didn't play ten thousand hours of Dota to unlock all that nonsense.
DOTA_Seasonal_Fall_2026_q05_intro_07: If you DID play ten thousand hours of Dota and DID unlock all that, forget what I said about you being a lunatic. I was just trying to make these lazy bums feel better.
DOTA_Seasonal_Fall_2026_q05_intro_08: There's a hundred and twenty-seven heroes in Dota! But you're the REAL one!
DOTA_Seasonal_Fall_2026_q05_intro_09: Anyway, you can now go back and listen through previous seasons any time you like!"
